build-your-own-x.en: For learners who want hands-on practice, this collection guides you through rebuilding databases, compilers, operating systems, and Git from scratch.
build-your-own-x.zh: 面向想动手实践的学习者，这个教程合集带你从零重写数据库、编译器、操作系统和 Git。

awesome.en: A collection of Awesome lists on all kinds of interesting topics, for readers who want to find resource lists by subject.
awesome.zh: 汇集各类有趣主题的 Awesome 清单，方便读者按主题查找相关资源列表。

public-apis.en: A collective list of free APIs for developers looking for available interfaces to use in their projects.
public-apis.zh: 面向需要查找可用接口的开发者，汇总免费 API 清单，方便快速找到可用接口。

freecodecamp.en: A free open-source curriculum for learners who want to study math, programming, and computer science with hands-on practice.
freecodecamp.zh: 面向想免费学习数学、编程和计算机科学的学习者，提供公开源码的完整课程与边学边练的认证体系。

free-programming-books.en: A categorized list of freely available programming books for learners who need free study material.
free-programming-books.zh: 面向需要免费学习资料的读者，按语言和主题分类整理免费编程书单。

openclaw.en: For users who need an AI agent that actually performs tasks across any operating system and platform.
openclaw.zh: 面向需要 AI 真正动手执行任务、并跨任意操作系统与平台使用的用户。

system-design-primer.en: For engineers preparing for system design interviews who want to learn how to design large-scale systems, with Anki flashcards included.
system-design-primer.zh: 面向准备系统设计面试的工程师，帮助学习如何设计大规模系统，并附有 Anki 记忆卡片。

developer-roadmap.en: Developer Roadmaps offers interactive roadmaps and guides that help developers plan what to learn at each career stage.
developer-roadmap.zh: Developer Roadmaps 提供交互式路线图和指南，帮开发者规划各阶段该学什么。

coding-interview-university.en: A complete computer science study plan for people preparing to become software engineers and face interviews.
coding-interview-university.zh: 一份完整的计算机科学学习计划，帮助想成为软件工程师的人系统准备面试。

awesome-selfhosted.en: For people who want to host their own services, this list organizes free software network services and web applications by purpose.
awesome-selfhosted.zh: 面向想自建服务的人，这份目录按用途归类自由软件网络服务与网页应用。

superpowers.en: A skills framework for coding agents, giving them structured methods for brainstorming, TDD, and debugging.
superpowers.zh: 面向编码智能体的技能框架，为头脑风暴、TDD 与调试提供结构化方法。

rea.en: Rea helps reverse engineers and security researchers use agents to analyze anything, from app behavior down to native binaries.
rea.zh: Rea 帮逆向工程师和安全研究人员用智能体分析从应用行为到原生二进制文件。

awesome-python.en: A curated list that helps Python developers find which tool to use for a specific task.
awesome-python.zh: 面向 Python 开发者，帮助按具体需求查找该用哪个工具的清单。

deepseek-harness.en: A plugin-based harness for developers who build and organize DeepSeek agent workflows, where each part is a plugin.
deepseek-harness.zh: 面向搭建 DeepSeek 智能体工作流的开发者，以插件化方式组织各个环节。

project-based-learning.en: For learners who prefer hands-on practice, this curated list of project-based tutorials ranges from building a calculator to building an operating system.
project-based-learning.zh: 面向动手实践的学习者，这份项目制教程合集涵盖从写计算器到写操作系统的项目。

skills.en: A set of skills for engineers, taken directly from the author's .agents directory, to reuse in your own setup.
skills.zh: 面向工程师的技能集合，直接取自作者的 .agents 目录，可在自己的配置中复用。

996-icu.en: For those who want to count stars and contribute, this repository also invites pressing F to pay respect to developers.
996-icu.zh: 面向想数 star 和贡献的人，这个仓库也邀请按 F 向开发者致敬。

the-book-of-secret-knowledge.en: A resource collection for developers and learners who need quick references, cheatsheets, and handy CLI or web tools in one place.
the-book-of-secret-knowledge.zh: 面向开发者和学习者，把速查表、手册、技巧与实用 CLI/Web 工具资源集中在一处，方便随时查阅。

hermes-agent.en: Hermes Agent is an AI agent for users who want an agent that grows with them.
hermes-agent.zh: Hermes Agent 是面向希望智能体随自己一同成长的用户的 AI 智能体。

react.en: A JavaScript library for developers building web and native user interfaces, helping them create interactive UIs from reusable components.
react.zh: 面向开发者的 JavaScript 库，用于构建 Web 和原生用户界面，帮助以可复用组件创建交互界面。

linux.en: For kernel developers, it provides the Linux kernel source tree to build, study, and modify the system's core.
linux.zh: 面向内核开发者，提供 Linux 内核源代码树，用于构建、研究与修改系统内核。

opencode-2.en: An open source coding agent for developers who want an open tool to assist with coding tasks.
opencode-2.zh: 开源编码智能体，面向希望使用开源工具辅助编码任务的开发者。

python.en: A collection of algorithms implemented in Python, for learners and developers who want reference code to study or reuse.
python.zh: 为学习者和开发者提供用 Python 实现的各类算法参考代码，便于学习或复用。

opencode.en: An open source coding agent for developers who want to work with AI assistance directly in the terminal.
opencode.zh: 面向开发者的开源编码智能体，可在终端里直接与 AI 协作完成编码工作。

ossu.en: A free curriculum for self-taught learners who want a full computer science education.
ossu.zh: 面向想自学完整计算机科学课程的自学者，提供免费的学习路线。

freedomain.en: FreeDomain offers free domain registration and practical DNS learning resources for anyone who wants to get online.
freedomain.zh: FreeDomain 为所有想上网建站的人提供免费域名注册和实用 DNS 学习资源。

andrej-karpathy-skills.en: For developers using Claude Code, this single CLAUDE.md file targets common LLM coding pitfalls.
andrej-karpathy-skills.zh: 面向使用 Claude Code 的开发者，这个 CLAUDE.md 文件针对常见的 LLM 编码陷阱。

yt-dlp.en: yt-dlp is a feature-rich command-line audio and video downloader for users who need to save media from many sites.
yt-dlp.zh: yt-dlp 是功能丰富的命令行音视频下载工具，适合需要从众多网站保存媒体的用户。

ecc.en: For developers using Claude Code, Codex, Opencode or Cursor: it optimizes agent harness performance with skills, memory and security.
ecc.zh: 为 Claude Code、Cursor 等用户优化智能体运行框架性能。

tensorflow.en: Tensorflow is an open source machine learning framework for everyone, helping developers build and train machine learning models.
tensorflow.zh: Tensorflow 是面向所有人的开源机器学习框架，帮助开发者构建和训练机器学习模型。

firecrawl.en: Firecrawl turns web pages into clean Markdown so AI agent developers can feed models without manual cleanup.
firecrawl.zh: Firecrawl 把网页抓成干净的 Markdown，让 AI agent 开发者无需手动清洗就能喂给模型。

javascript-algorithms.en: For developers learning algorithms: a collection of JavaScript implementations of algorithms and data structures, with explanations and further reading links.
javascript-algorithms.zh: 面向学习算法的开发者：用 JavaScript 实现的算法与数据结构集合，附讲解和延伸阅读链接。

n8n.en: For teams automating workflows: a fair-code platform with visual building, custom code, native AI capabilities, and 400+ integrations, self-hosted or cloud.
n8n.zh: 面向自动化流程的团队：可视化搭建结合自定义代码，内置 AI 能力，可自托管或云端。

vscode.en: A free, lightweight code editor for developers, with extensions, debugging, and Git built in.
vscode.zh: 面向开发者的免费轻量代码编辑器，内置扩展、调试与 Git 支持。

markitdown.en: A Python tool for developers and writers who need to convert files and Office documents into Markdown.
markitdown.zh: 面向开发者和写作者的 Python 工具，用于将文件和 Office 文档转换为 Markdown。

claw-code.en: For developers exploring agent-driven development, Claw Code is a Rust museum exhibit that Gajae-Code and LazyCodex build and maintain without human intervention.
claw-code.zh: 面向开发者的 Rust 博物馆展品，由智能体全程开发与维护，无需人工干预。

awesome-go.en: A curated list that helps Go developers find useful frameworks, libraries and software for their projects.
awesome-go.zh: 为 Go 开发者整理框架、库和软件清单，帮助他们查找可用工具。

ohmyzsh.en: A community-driven framework for zsh users that manages configuration, with optional plugins and themes to extend the shell.
ohmyzsh.zh: 一个面向 zsh 用户的社区驱动框架，用于管理配置，并提供可选插件和主题来扩展 shell。

autogpt.en: AutoGPT gives builders and curious users an accessible agent they can use and extend, so they can focus on what matters.
autogpt.zh: AutoGPT 面向希望使用和二次开发智能体的用户，提供可访问的工具，让人专注真正重要的事。

python-100-days.en: A 100-day Python learning resource for beginners who want to go from novice to master.
python-100-days.zh: 面向想从新手进阶到熟练的初学者的 Python 100 天学习资源。

vue.en: For developers working with Vue 2, this repository hosts the Vue 2 codebase; Vue 3 is maintained at vuejs/core.
vue.zh: 供 Vue 2 开发者使用，本仓库是 Vue 2 代码库；Vue 3 请见 vuejs/core。

hellogithub.en: For people curious about open source, HelloGitHub shares interesting, entry-level GitHub projects to help them discover and get started.
hellogithub.zh: 面向对开源感兴趣的人，HelloGitHub 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目，帮助发现与上手。

ollama.en: For developers who want to run models like Qwen and Gemma locally, Ollama starts them with one command.
ollama.zh: 面向想在本地运行 Qwen、Gemma 等模型的开发者，Ollama 用一条命令即可启动，断网也能用。

anthropic-skills.en: For developers using Claude who need reusable skill packages to extend agent behavior.
anthropic-skills.zh: 面向使用 Claude 的开发者，提供可直接安装复用的技能包以扩展智能体能力。

you-dont-know-js.en: A book series on the JavaScript language with 2 published editions, for developers who want to read about JS.
you-dont-know-js.zh: 面向想阅读 JavaScript 语言相关内容的开发者的丛书，已出版 2 版。

flutter.en: Flutter helps developers build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond with ease and speed.
flutter.zh: Flutter 帮助开发者为移动端及其他平台轻松快速地构建精美应用。

cs-notes.en: A notes collection covering technical interview fundamentals, Leetcode, operating systems, computer networks, and system design for candidates preparing for interviews.
cs-notes.zh: 为技术面试准备者整理基础知识、Leetcode、操作系统、计算机网络与系统设计。

gitignore.en: For developers setting up Git repositories, this collection of .gitignore templates helps keep unwanted files out of version control.
gitignore.zh: 面向配置 Git 仓库的开发者，这套 .gitignore 模板集合帮助将不需要的文件排除在版本控制之外。

bootstrap.en: A framework for web developers who build responsive, mobile-first sites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
bootstrap.zh: 面向 Web 开发者，用 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 构建响应式、移动优先的网站。

ponytail.en: For developers using AI agents, Ponytail makes the agent reason like a lazy senior dev and favor writing less code.
ponytail.zh: 面向使用 AI 智能体的开发者，Ponytail 让智能体像懒散的资深开发者一样思考，倾向少写代码。

transformers.en: A model-definition framework for developers working on text, vision, audio, and multimodal machine learning models, supporting both inference and training.
transformers.zh: 面向文本、视觉、音频和多模态任务的开发者，提供支持推理与训练的模型定义框架。

awesome-chatgpt-prompts.en: A free, open-source place for users to share, discover, and collect community prompts, and for organizations to self-host with complete privacy.
awesome-chatgpt-prompts.zh: 面向找提示词的用户与重视隐私的团队：可发现、收集社区提示词，免费开源、可自托管。

sd-webui.en: A web UI for Stable Diffusion text-to-image, with a broad plugin and model ecosystem for people generating images from prompts.
sd-webui.zh: 面向需要文生图的用户，提供 Stable Diffusion 的网页界面，并拥有丰富的插件与模型生态。

agency-agents.en: Gives developers a team of specialized AI agents, each with personality and processes, to cover frontend, community, and review tasks.
agency-agents.zh: 为开发者提供各具个性与流程的专职 AI 智能体，覆盖前端、社区与现实检验等任务。

the-art-of-command-line.en: A one-page guide for people who want to learn and master the command line.
the-art-of-command-line.zh: 面向想学习并掌握命令行的人，用一页纸提供命令行知识。

dify.en: A platform for teams building LLM apps: drag-and-drop workflows, then publish as an API.
dify.zh: 面向需要开发 LLM 应用的团队，拖拽编排工作流后发布成 API。

javaguide.en: A Java and backend interview guide for developers preparing for interviews, covering computer fundamentals, databases, distributed systems, high concurrency, system design, and AI application development.
javaguide.zh: 面向准备面试的开发者的 Java 与后端面试指南，涵盖计算机基础、数据库、分布式、高并发、系统设计与 AI 应用开发。

langflow.en: Langflow helps developers build and deploy AI-powered agents and workflows.
langflow.zh: Langflow 帮助开发者构建和部署由 AI 驱动的智能体与工作流。

open-webui.en: A user-friendly, self-hosted AI interface for teams that supports Ollama, OpenAI API, knowledge bases and shared accounts.
open-webui.zh: 面向团队的自托管 AI 界面，支持 Ollama 与 OpenAI API 等多模型、知识库和账号管理。

scrcpy.en: scrcpy lets developers and testers view and control an Android device from a computer, with no app needed on the phone.
scrcpy.zh: scrcpy 让开发者和测试人员在电脑上查看并控制安卓设备，手机端无需安装应用。

clash-verge-rev.en: A Tauri-based GUI client for Windows, macOS and Linux users who want a tailored proxy experience.
clash-verge-rev.zh: 基于 Tauri 的图形界面客户端，供 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 用户获得定制的代理体验。

langchain.en: A platform for developers building LLM apps and agents, offering ready-made building blocks for models, tools, memory, and retrieval.
langchain.zh: 面向构建 LLM 应用和智能体的开发者，提供模型、工具、记忆、检索等现成积木。

javascript.en: A JavaScript style guide for developers who want consistent code style across a project.
javascript.zh: 面向 JavaScript 开发者的风格指南，用于统一项目中的代码风格。

system-prompts.en: A collection of system prompts from AI coding tools, for developers who want to learn how to write agent prompts.
system-prompts.zh: 汇集多家 AI 编程工具的系统提示词，供想学习如何编写 agent 提示词的开发者参考。

spec-kit.en: A toolkit for developers who want to get started with SDD or any other process.
spec-kit.zh: 面向希望上手 SDD 或任何其他流程的开发者，提供入门工具包。

awesome-llm-apps.en: For developers who want free, open source examples of AI agents, agent skills, and RAG apps, this collection offers over 100 ready references.
awesome-llm-apps.zh: 面向需要免费开源示例的开发者，该项目提供 100 多个 AI 智能体、智能体技能和 RAG 应用参考。

comfyui.en: ComfyUI gives AI image creators a node-based interface and local backend for building diffusion workflows by connecting nodes.
comfyui.zh: ComfyUI 用节点连线搭建扩散模型工作流，适合需要复杂流程的 AI 出图用户。

tech-interview-handbook.en: Curated coding interview preparation materials for busy software engineers.
tech-interview-handbook.zh: 为忙碌的软件工程师精心整理的编程面试准备材料。

next-js.en: A React framework for developers who build web applications with React.
next-js.zh: 面向使用 React 构建 Web 应用的开发者的 React 框架。

iptv.en: A collection of publicly available IPTV channels from around the world, for users who want a ready list of open channels.
iptv.zh: 汇集来自世界各地的公开 IPTV 频道，适合需要现成公开频道列表的用户。

ui-ux-pro-max-skill.en: An AI skill for developers and designers who need design intelligence to build professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
ui-ux-pro-max-skill.zh: 面向开发者和设计师的 AI 技能，提供设计智能，帮助跨多个平台打造专业 UI/UX。

free-for-dev.en: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings with free tiers, for DevOps and infrastructure developers seeking free services.
free-for-dev.zh: 面向 DevOps 和基础设施开发者，汇总提供免费套餐的 SaaS、PaaS 和 IaaS 服务清单。

powertoys.en: Microsoft PowerToys is a set of utilities for Windows users who want more productivity and customization.
powertoys.zh: 微软 PowerToys 是面向 Windows 用户的实用工具集合，用于提升效率与自定义体验。

youtube-dl.en: A command-line program for users who need to download videos from YouTube.com and other video sites.
youtube-dl.zh: 面向需要通过命令行从 YouTube.com 和其他视频网站下载视频的用户。

go.en: Go is a programming language for developers who write software.
go.zh: Go 是一门编程语言，供开发者编写软件使用。

moneyprinterturbo.en: For creators who need quick short videos, it turns a topic or keyword into an HD video through an automated AI workflow.
moneyprinterturbo.zh: 面向需要快速产出短视频的创作者，它通过自动化 AI 工作流把主题或关键词生成高清短视频。

fucking-algorithm.en: For developers preparing for coding interviews, it explains LeetCode solutions and the reasoning behind each approach.
fucking-algorithm.zh: 面向准备编程面试的开发者，讲解 LeetCode 题解的同时说明背后的思路。

llama-cpp.en: A C/C++ LLM inference engine for developers who want to run quantized large models locally on laptops.
llama-cpp.zh: 面向需要在笔记本本地运行量化大模型的开发者，提供 C/C++ 实现的推理引擎。

claude-code.en: A terminal-based agentic coding tool for developers who want to run routine tasks, explain complex code, and handle Git workflows via natural language.
claude-code.zh: 终端智能体编码工具，帮开发者用自然语言执行例行任务、解释代码、处理 Git 工作流。

codex.en: A lightweight coding agent for developers who work in the terminal and want coding help without leaving the command line.
codex.zh: 面向在终端中工作的开发者，提供轻量级编程智能体，让你无需离开命令行即可获得编程协助。

hello-algo.en: A tutorial for learners studying data structures and algorithms, with animated diagrams, runnable code, and implementations in Python, Java, C++, and other languages.
hello-algo.zh: 面向学习数据结构与算法的读者，提供动画图解、可一键运行的代码，以及 Python、Java、C++ 等多语言实现。

excalidraw.en: For people sketching flowcharts, prototypes, or architecture diagrams, Excalidraw is a hand-drawn style virtual whiteboard for team collaboration.
excalidraw.zh: 面向画流程图、原型和架构图的人，Excalidraw 是支持多人协作的手绘白板。

30-seconds-of-code.en: For developers who want to improve their skills, 30 Seconds Of Code offers short coding articles.
30-seconds-of-code.zh: 面向希望提升开发技能的开发者，30 Seconds Of Code 提供编程短文。

kubernetes.en: Kubernetes helps teams run containerized applications in production by providing container scheduling and management.
kubernetes.zh: Kubernetes 面向需要运行容器化应用的团队，提供生产级的容器调度与管理。

rustdesk.en: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application for users who want to self-host their connections, offering an alternative to TeamViewer.
rustdesk.zh: RustDesk 是专为希望自托管连接的用户设计的开源远程桌面应用，可作为 TeamViewer 的替代方案。

shadcn-ui.en: React developers get copy-and-paste accessible components they can customize and own in their own repository.
shadcn-ui.zh: 面向 React 开发者，提供可复制粘贴的无障碍组件，代码归你所有、可自由定制。

react-native.en: For developers who know React, it offers a way to build native mobile applications using the same component model.
react-native.zh: 面向熟悉 React 的开发者，用同一套组件模型构建原生移动应用。

awesome-design-md.en: For developers using coding agents: it supplies brand design system DESIGN.md files to drop into a project so the agent can generate a matching UI.
awesome-design-md.zh: 面向使用编程智能体的开发者：提供品牌设计系统的 DESIGN.md 文件，放入项目后即可让智能体生成匹配的 UI。

awesome-hacking.en: A collection of various awesome lists for hackers, pentesters and security researchers seeking curated security resources.
awesome-hacking.zh: 为黑客、渗透测试人员和安全研究人员收集的各类优质列表合集，便于查找安全资源。

generative-ai-for-beginners.en: A 21-lesson course for beginners who want to start building with generative AI.
generative-ai-for-beginners.zh: 面向想入门生成式 AI 开发的初学者，用 21 节课带你上手。

electron.en: For developers who know JavaScript, HTML, and CSS: build cross-platform desktop apps with these web technologies.
electron.zh: 给熟悉 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 的开发者：用这些技术构建跨平台桌面应用。

rust.en: Rust helps developers build reliable and efficient software.
rust.zh: Rust 帮助开发者构建可靠且高效的软件。

node.en: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime for developers who need to run JavaScript code.
node.zh: Node.js 是面向开发者的 JavaScript 运行时，用于运行 JavaScript 代码。

free-programming-books-zh-cn.en: A curated list of free Chinese programming books for learners and developers seeking no-cost study material.
free-programming-books-zh-cn.zh: 面向中文学习者和开发者，汇集免费计算机编程中文书籍，方便查找免费学习资料。

godot.en: Godot is a multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine for developers who want to build games across platforms.
godot.zh: Godot 是一款多平台 2D 和 3D 游戏引擎，面向需要跨平台开发游戏的开发者。

pi.en: A toolkit for developers building AI agents, offering a unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, and coding agent CLI.
pi.zh: 面向开发者的 AI 智能体工具包，提供统一的 LLM API、智能体循环、TUI 和编程智能体 CLI。

immich.en: For people who want their own photo library, Immich is a self-hosted service for managing photos and videos.
immich.zh: 面向希望自建照片库的用户，Immich 是自托管的照片和视频管理方案。

browser-use.en: Open-source Python library for developers building AI browser agents, plus a cloud option with stealth browsers and a hosted agent API.
browser-use.zh: 开源 Python 库，帮助开发者构建能自动点击、填表、翻页和抓数据的 AI 浏览器代理，另提供云端托管选项。

tradingagents.en: A multi-agent LLM framework for developers building financial trading systems.
tradingagents.zh: 面向构建金融交易系统的开发者，提供多智能体大语言模型框架。

awesome-mac.en: For macOS users who need to find quality software, this project collects and organizes it by category for easy search.
awesome-mac.zh: 面向需要查找优质 macOS 软件的用户，本项目收集并按类别整理，方便搜索和使用。

v2rayn.en: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS that gives users a graphical way to run Xray, sing-box and others.
v2rayn.zh: 面向 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 用户，通过图形界面运行 Xray、sing-box 等内核的客户端。

supabase.en: For developers building web, mobile, and AI applications, Supabase provides a dedicated Postgres database.
supabase.zh: 面向构建 Web、移动端和 AI 应用的开发者，Supabase 提供专属 Postgres 数据库。

three-js.en: A JavaScript 3D library for developers who need to add 3D work to their projects.
three-js.zh: 面向需要处理 3D 内容的开发者，提供 JavaScript 3D 库。

typescript.en: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript for developers who want to compile to clean JavaScript output.
typescript.zh: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，供开发者编译为简洁的 JavaScript 输出。

d3.en: D3 is a JavaScript library for developers who need to build data visualizations with SVG, Canvas and HTML.
d3.zh: D3 是一个 JavaScript 库，面向需要用 SVG、Canvas 和 HTML 制作数据可视化的开发者。

caveman.en: For developers running coding agents, Caveman is a skill and proxy that cuts 65% of tokens by speaking like a caveman.
caveman.zh: 面向编程智能体开发者，Caveman 用穴居人式说话减少 65% 的 token 消耗。

agent-skills.en: For teams building AI coding agents, it provides production-grade engineering skills.
agent-skills.zh: 面向构建 AI 编程智能体的团队，提供生产级工程技能。

whisper.en: For developers who need multilingual speech transcription, Whisper is an OpenAI speech recognition model trained with large-scale weak supervision.
whisper.zh: 面向需要多语言语音转写的开发者，Whisper 是 OpenAI 基于大规模弱监督训练的语音识别模型。

tauri.en: For developers with a web frontend who want to build desktop and mobile apps with smaller size and security in mind.
tauri.zh: 面向已有 Web 前端的开发者，用于构建体积更小、更安全、更快的桌面与移动应用。

papers-we-love.en: For computer science community members who want papers to read and discuss with others.
papers-we-love.zh: 面向计算机科学社区成员，提供可供阅读与讨论的论文。

frp.en: For developers and operators who need to reach a local server behind NAT or a firewall, frp is a fast reverse proxy that exposes it to the internet.
frp.zh: 面向需要访问 NAT 或防火墙后本地服务的开发者和运维人员，frp 是一款快速反向代理，可将该服务暴露到公网。

deno.en: A modern runtime for developers who write JavaScript and TypeScript.
deno.zh: 面向编写 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 的开发者，提供现代运行时。

axios.en: For browser and Node.js developers, it is a Promise-based HTTP client for sending HTTP requests.
axios.zh: 面向浏览器和 Node.js 开发者，它是基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端，用于发起 HTTP 请求。

paperclip.en: An open-source app for people who manage agents at work, giving them one place to handle that work.
paperclip.zh: 面向在工作中管理智能体的人的开源应用，让他们在一处完成这些管理工作。

orca.en: Orca helps developers run and manage a fleet of coding agents with their own subscription, on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
orca.zh: Orca 帮开发者用自己的订阅运行并管理多个编程智能体，支持桌面、移动与远程运行时。

llms-from-scratch.en: For learners who want to build a ChatGPT-like LLM in PyTorch step by step from scratch.
llms-from-scratch.zh: 面向想用 PyTorch 从零一步步实现类似 ChatGPT 的 LLM 的学习者。

gemini-cli.en: An open-source AI agent for terminal users, bringing Gemini's capabilities to the command line so they can work where they already are.
gemini-cli.zh: 面向终端用户的开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 能力带入命令行，让开发者无需离开终端即可使用。

weekly.en: A weekly publication for technology enthusiasts, released every Friday.
weekly.zh: 面向科技爱好者的周刊，每周五发布。

nodebestpractices.en: A best practices list for Node.js developers, offering guidance on common coding and project decisions.
nodebestpractices.zh: 面向 Node.js 开发者的最佳实践清单，帮助了解常见的编码与项目决策。

pytorch.en: A Python library for developers building tensor computations and dynamic neural networks with GPU acceleration.
pytorch.zh: 面向开发者的 Python 库，用于构建张量计算与动态神经网络，并提供 GPU 加速。

taste-skill.en: Agent skills for developers building with coding agents, using art direction, reference images and a browser check in place of generic AI pages.
taste-skill.zh: 面向使用编程智能体开发的开发者，以艺术指导、参考图和浏览器检查取代千篇一律的 AI 页面。

fastapi.en: FastAPI is a high-performance framework for developers who need to learn quickly, code fast, and ship to production.
fastapi.zh: FastAPI 是面向开发者的高性能框架，易学习、编码快，可用于生产环境。

claude-mem.en: A context layer for agent users that captures session activity, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context into future sessions.
claude-mem.zh: 面向智能体使用者的上下文工具：捕获会话中的操作，用 AI 压缩，并把相关上下文注入未来会话。

howtocook.en: A cooking guide for programmers who want to prepare simple home meals.
howtocook.zh: 面向程序员的居家烹饪指南，帮助解决日常做饭问题。

open-design.en: For design and product teams that need one local-first, open-source workspace to build motion, prototypes, sites, apps, and dashboards with AI agents.
open-design.zh: 面向设计与产品团队，在本地优先的开源工作区中与 AI 智能体协作创作原型与网站。

terminal.en: For Windows command-line users, it brings the new Windows Terminal and the original console host together in one place.
terminal.zh: 面向 Windows 命令行用户，将全新 Windows Terminal 与原版控制台主机集中到同一处。

create-react-app.en: For developers who want a modern web app: run one command to set up the project.
create-react-app.zh: 面向需要搭建现代 Web 应用的开发者：运行一条命令即可完成项目初始化。

angular.en: Angular helps web developers build and deliver web apps with confidence.
angular.zh: Angular 帮助 Web 开发者自信地构建并交付 Web 应用。

neovim.en: A Vim fork for developers who want an extensible, usable terminal editor with Lua configuration and async plugins.
neovim.zh: 面向需要可扩展终端编辑器的开发者：Vim 重构版，支持 Lua 配置与异步插件。

every-programmer-should-know.en: A collection of mostly technical topics for software developers who want to broaden their knowledge.
every-programmer-should-know.zh: 面向希望拓宽知识的软件开发者，汇集以技术类为主的知识合集。

ant-design.en: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library for developers building business interfaces.
ant-design.zh: Ant Design 是一套企业级 UI 设计语言和 React 组件库，供开发者构建业务界面。

material-ui.en: A React component library for developers who want to build interfaces following Google's Material Design.
material-ui.zh: 面向希望按 Google Material Design 构建界面的开发者，提供 React 组件库。

autoresearch.en: For ML researchers who want AI agents to run single-GPU nanochat training research automatically, reducing manual experiment work.
autoresearch.zh: 面向希望 AI 智能体在单 GPU 上自动开展 nanochat 训练研究的机器学习研究者，减少手动实验工作。

ruview.en: For developers and care teams, RuView turns ordinary WiFi signals into presence and vital-sign data without using any camera video.
ruview.zh: RuView 为开发者与照护团队提供无摄像头的 WiFi 存在与生命体征监测。

app-ideas.en: A collection of application ideas for developers who want practice projects to improve their coding skills.
app-ideas.zh: 一组应用创意集合，供想通过练习项目提升编程技能的开发者使用。

tailwindcss.en: A utility-first CSS framework for developers who want to build UIs quickly.
tailwindcss.zh: 面向需要快速构建 UI 的开发者，一个工具类优先的 CSS 框架。

deep-live-cam.en: A tool for creators who need real time face swap and one-click video deepfake from a single image.
deep-live-cam.zh: 面向需要仅凭一张图片完成实时换脸和一键视频深度伪造的创作者。

thefuck.en: For command-line users, it corrects the previous console command you typed.
thefuck.zh: 面向命令行用户，帮助纠正你上一条输入的控制台命令。

web-dev-for-beginners.en: A 24-lesson, 12-week course for beginners who want to get started as web developers.
web-dev-for-beginners.zh: 为想入门 Web 开发的初学者提供 24 节课、为期 12 周的课程。

awesome-mcp-servers.en: A collection of MCP servers, organized by use, helping agent builders find ready-made tools to connect to their agents.
awesome-mcp-servers.zh: MCP 服务器大全按用途分类，帮智能体开发者找到现成工具接入自己的智能体。

opencut.en: OpenCut gives video editors an open-source alternative to CapCut.
opencut.zh: OpenCut 为视频剪辑用户提供一个开源的 CapCut 替代品。

localsend.en: For people moving files between phones and computers on one local network, it sends files directly without an internet account.
localsend.zh: 面向需要在手机与电脑之间互传文件的用户，在同一局域网内直接发送，无需联网账号。

bun.en: Bun combines a JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager, giving developers one tool instead of several.
bun.zh: Bun 把 JavaScript 运行时、打包器、测试运行器和包管理器合为一体，让开发者用一个工具替代多个工具。

manim.en: Built for math educators and content creators, it renders animated visuals for explanatory math videos.
manim.zh: 面向数学教学者和内容创作者，为解释性数学视频渲染动画画面。

puppeteer.en: A JavaScript API for developers who need to control Chrome and Firefox programmatically.
puppeteer.zh: 面向需要以编程方式控制 Chrome 和 Firefox 的开发者提供的 JavaScript API。

vllm.en: A high-throughput, memory-efficient inference and serving engine for teams deploying large language models.
vllm.zh: 面向部署大语言模型的团队，提供高吞吐、内存高效的推理与服务引擎。

ghidra.en: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering framework for developers and security researchers who analyze compiled code.
ghidra.zh: Ghidra 是一个软件逆向工程框架，供开发者和安全研究人员分析编译后的代码。

nvm.en: A POSIX-compliant bash script for developers who need to switch between multiple active Node.js versions.
nvm.zh: 面向需要在多个活跃 Node.js 版本间切换的开发者，提供 POSIX 兼容的 bash 脚本。

stirling-pdf.en: Stirling PDF lets users edit PDFs on any device anywhere, with merge, split, convert, OCR and watermark tools.
stirling-pdf.zh: Stirling PDF 让用户在任何设备上编辑 PDF，支持合并、拆分、转换、OCR 和加水印。

sherlock.en: For people checking their own exposure, it finds social media accounts by username across social networks.
sherlock.zh: 面向需要排查自身账号暴露情况的用户，按用户名在各社交网络中查找账号。

java-design-patterns.en: A collection of design patterns implemented in Java, helping Java developers find pattern examples to reference in their own code.
java-design-patterns.zh: 面向 Java 开发者，提供用 Java 实现的设计模式示例，便于查找并参考到自己的代码中。

odysseus.en: A self-hosted AI workspace for developers who want to run their AI tooling on their own infrastructure.
odysseus.zh: 面向希望在自己基础设施上运行 AI 工具的开发者，提供自托管的 AI 工作区。

impeccable.en: A design vocabulary for coding agent users, helping steer AI output with polish and catch AI slop before shipping.
impeccable.zh: 面向 AI 编程工具使用者，用一套设计语言引导输出更精致，并在发布前发现 AI 生成的粗糙设计。

clean-code-javascript.en: A reference of Clean Code concepts adapted for JavaScript, for developers who want to apply clean code principles.
clean-code-javascript.zh: 面向 JavaScript 开发者，汇集适配 JavaScript 的整洁代码概念，便于应用整洁代码原则。

ragflow.en: RAGFlow is an open-source RAG engine for developers building LLM apps, combining deep document parsing, Agent capabilities and answers with citations.
ragflow.zh: RAGFlow 是面向 LLM 应用开发者的开源 RAG 引擎，提供深入文档解析、Agent 能力与带引用溯源的回答。

uptime-kuma.en: A self-hosted monitoring tool for people running their own sites: it watches HTTP, ping and ports, and sends alerts when something goes down.
uptime-kuma.zh: 给自建站点的用户：这款自托管监控工具盯着 HTTP、Ping 和端口，异常时发通知。

openhands.en: OpenHands is an AI software engineering agent that writes code, runs commands, and fixes bugs for developers.
openhands.zh: OpenHands 是 AI 软件工程代理，为开发者写代码、跑命令、改 bug。

zed.en: Zed is a high-performance multiplayer code editor for developers who want fast startup and responsive collaborative coding.
zed.zh: Zed 是面向开发者的高性能协作代码编辑器，启动和响应快，便于多人协同编写代码。

home-assistant.en: Home Assistant is an open source home automation hub for people who want local control and privacy. It brings devices from different brands into one interface.
home-assistant.zh: Home Assistant 是面向重视本地控制与隐私的用户的智能家居中枢。它把不同品牌的设备统一到一个界面。

ml-for-beginners.en: A 12-week, 26-lesson, 52-quiz course teaching classic machine learning to everyone.
ml-for-beginners.zh: 面向所有人，用12周、26节课和52个测验讲解经典机器学习。

storybook.en: For frontend teams, Storybook lets you build, document, and test UI components in isolation.
storybook.zh: 面向前端团队，Storybook 可在隔离环境中构建、记录和测试 UI 组件。

django.en: For Web developers working to deadlines, Django is a Web framework that helps teams build their Web applications on schedule.
django.zh: 面向有截止日期的 Web 开发者，Django 是一个帮助团队按时构建 Web 应用的 Web 框架。

opencv.en: An open source computer vision library for developers who need to build computer vision applications.
opencv.zh: 面向需要构建计算机视觉应用的开发者，提供开源计算机视觉库。

uv.en: A fast Python package and project manager for developers who want quicker installs and simpler project setup.
uv.zh: 面向希望加快安装速度、简化项目配置的开发者，提供快速的 Python 包与项目管理。

paddleocr.en: For AI developers, PaddleOCR turns PDFs and images into structured data and supports over 100 languages.
paddleocr.zh: 面向 AI 开发者，PaddleOCR 把 PDF 和图像转为结构化数据，支持 100 多种语言。

archify.en: Archify turns any idea, plan, or codebase into an interactive diagram as a skill for Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents.
archify.zh: Archify 可将任何想法、计划或代码库转化为交互式图表，适用于 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体。

mcp-servers.en: For developers building AI agents, MCP Servers provide official Model Context Protocol servers to safely read files, query databases, and call APIs.
mcp-servers.zh: 面向 AI 智能体开发者，提供官方服务器集合，让模型安全地读文件、查库和调用 API。

system-design-101.en: A visual guide for developers preparing for system design interviews, explaining complex systems in simple terms.
system-design-101.zh: 面向准备系统设计面试的开发者，用可视化和简单术语讲解复杂系统。

voicestudio.en: An open-source, fully local ElevenLabs alternative for creators who need voice cloning, dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation in 646 languages.
voicestudio.zh: 面向创作者的开源本地语音工具：克隆、配音、听写、转写与有声书创作，支持 646 种语言。

mermaid.en: Lets people who write documentation create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and gantt charts from text, similar to markdown.
mermaid.zh: 让写文档的人用文本生成流程图、时序图和甘特图，方式类似 markdown。

awesome-for-beginners.en: A list of beginner-friendly projects that helps newcomers find projects that are easy to start with.
awesome-for-beginners.zh: 一份适合初学者的项目列表，帮助新手找到容易上手的项目。

bitcoin.en: The Bitcoin Core integration/staging tree, for developers who work on the Bitcoin Core codebase.
bitcoin.zh: 面向参与 Bitcoin Core 代码开发的开发者的集成/暂存代码树。

scrapling.en: Scrapling is a web scraping framework for developers who need to handle everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl.
scrapling.zh: Scrapling 是一个 Web 抓取框架，适合需要从单次请求扩展到大规模爬取的开发者。

syncthing.en: Syncthing is an open source tool for users who need continuous file synchronization directly between devices, without a central server.
syncthing.zh: Syncthing 是一款开源工具，适合需要在设备之间直连持续同步文件、不经过中心服务器的用户。

vue-element-admin.en: A Vue admin dashboard template for developers building back-office management interfaces.
vue-element-admin.zh: 面向开发者的 Vue 后台管理界面模板，用于搭建后台管理页面。

hugo.en: Hugo is a framework for building websites, aimed at users who need a framework-based site-building workflow.
hugo.zh: Hugo 是面向需要构建网站的用户提供的网站构建框架。

nextchat.en: NextChat is a zero-config AI chat assistant for people who want to chat with many models without an API key or setup.
nextchat.zh: NextChat 是零配置 AI 聊天助手，适合想免 API 密钥、免配置使用多种模型聊天的人。

svelte.en: Svelte is a web development tool for developers building user interfaces, aiming to make web development approachable for everyone.
svelte.zh: Svelte 是一款面向构建用户界面的开发者的 Web 开发工具，旨在让所有人都能轻松进行 Web 开发。

gin.en: Gin is a Go HTTP web framework for developers building REST APIs, web apps, and microservices, offering a Martini-like API with httprouter-based performance.
gin.zh: Gin 是 Go 的高性能 HTTP Web 框架，面向构建 REST API、Web 应用和微服务的开发者。

laravel.en: Laravel is a web application framework with expressive, elegant syntax, aimed at developers who want to build web applications without handling small tasks themselves.
laravel.zh: Laravel 是一个语法优雅、表达力强的 Web 应用框架，面向希望无需为琐事操心、专注构建 Web 应用的开发者。

hello-agents.en: A tutorial for learners who want to understand agent principles and build agents from scratch.
hello-agents.zh: 面向希望理解智能体原理并从零动手构建智能体的学习者。

worldmonitor.en: For analysts tracking global events, it aggregates AI-powered news, geopolitical and infrastructure data in one real-time situational awareness dashboard.
worldmonitor.zh: 面向跟踪全球动态的分析人员，实时态势感知界面聚合 AI 新闻、地缘政治与基础设施信息。

understand-anything.en: For developers using AI coding assistants, it turns any code into an interactive knowledge graph they can explore, search, and ask questions about.
understand-anything.zh: 面向使用 AI 编程助手的开发者，把任何代码转化为可探索、搜索和提问的交互式知识图谱。

llm-course.en: A course for people starting with large language models, offering roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
llm-course.zh: 面向大语言模型初学者，提供路线图和 Colab 笔记本的入门课程。

deer-flow.en: DeerFlow is an open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness for developers who need agents that research, code, and create across tasks lasting minutes to hours.
deer-flow.zh: DeerFlow 是开源的长任务智能体框架，面向需要让智能体自主搜资料、写代码、出报告的开发者。

cs-video-courses.en: A curated list of computer science courses with video lectures for learners who want structured self-study resources.
cs-video-courses.zh: 面向希望自学计算机科学的人，汇集带视频讲座的课程列表。

realworld.en: A fullstack Medium.com clone demo for developers comparing React, Angular, Node, and Django implementations.
realworld.zh: 面向开发者的全栈 Medium.com 克隆演示，提供 React、Angular、Node、Django 等多种实现。

chinatextbook.en: For students and teachers: a collection of PDF textbooks covering primary, middle, high school and university.
chinatextbook.zh: 面向学生和教师：汇集小学、初中、高中到大学的PDF教材。

funnlp.en: For NLP developers and researchers, FunNLP collects Chinese and English corpora, lexicons, and tools in one repository.
funnlp.zh: 面向NLP开发者与研究者，FunNLP汇集中文与英文语料、词库及工具。

fzf.en: A command-line fuzzy finder for developers and terminal users who need to search and pick items from any list quickly.
fzf.zh: 面向开发者和终端用户的命令行模糊查找工具，可从任意列表中快速筛选条目。

vite.en: Vite is frontend tooling for developers who want fast builds and dev server performance.
vite.zh: Vite 是面向需要快速构建和开发服务器性能的开发者的前端工具。

lazygit.en: A terminal UI for developers who use Git but would rather not memorize commands.
lazygit.zh: 面向使用 Git 但不想背命令的开发者，提供终端里的图形界面。

animate-css.en: Animate.css is a cross-browser CSS animation library for web developers who want ready-made animations without writing custom keyframes.
animate-css.zh: Animate.css 是跨浏览器 CSS 动画库，适合希望直接使用现成动画、无需编写自定义关键帧的网页开发者。

mirofish.en: MiroFish is a simple, universal swarm intelligence engine for users who need to predict anything.
mirofish.zh: MiroFish 是一个简洁通用的群体智能引擎，面向需要预测万物的用户。

mineru.en: Converts PDFs and Office documents into Markdown or JSON for LLM and agent workflows.
mineru.zh: 把 PDF 和 Office 文档转成适合大模型读取的 Markdown 或 JSON，方便智能体流程使用。

payloadsallthethings.en: A curated list of useful payloads and bypass techniques for Web application security testing, aimed at pentesters and CTF players.
payloadsallthethings.zh: 一份实用的 payload 与绕过技巧列表，面向 Web 应用安全测试的渗透测试人员和 CTF 参与者。

omniroute.en: For developers using AI coding tools who need one free gateway to many models with quota-aware fallback.
omniroute.zh: 为使用 AI 编码工具的开发者提供单一免费网关，接入多模型并支持配额感知回退。

rtk.en: For developers running LLM agents on dev commands, a single Rust CLI proxy that cuts token consumption by 60-90% with zero dependencies.
rtk.zh: 面向运行 LLM 代理执行开发命令的开发者：单文件 Rust 代理减少 60-90% token 消耗。

spring-boot.en: Spring Boot lets Java developers build Spring-powered, production-grade applications and services with minimal setup effort.
spring-boot.zh: Spring Boot 让 Java 开发者以最少的配置工作，创建由 Spring 驱动的生产级应用与服务。

firacode.en: A free monospaced font for developers, using programming ligatures to combine multi-character code symbols.
firacode.zh: 面向开发者的免费等宽字体，通过编程连字把多字符代码符号组合显示。

mall.en: Mall is an e-commerce system for developers, with a storefront and admin backend built on Spring Boot and MyBatis, deployed with Docker.
mall.zh: Mall 是电商系统，含前台商城与后台管理，基于 Spring Boot 与 MyBatis，用 Docker 部署。

netdata.en: For lean teams, Netdata offers out-of-the-box system monitoring with real-time charts at second-level granularity.
netdata.zh: 面向精简团队，Netdata 提供开箱即用的系统监控，安装后即可获得秒级粒度的实时图表。

screenshot-to-code.en: For developers, it turns a screenshot into clean HTML, Tailwind, React, or Vue code.
screenshot-to-code.zh: 面向开发者，将截图转换为整洁的 HTML、Tailwind、React 或 Vue 代码。

hackingtool.en: For hackers, an all-in-one tool that gathers hacking utilities in one place.
hackingtool.zh: 面向黑客的一体化工具，将多种黑客工具集中在一处。

d2l-zh.en: A runnable, discussable deep learning book for Chinese readers, used by 500+ universities in 70+ countries.
d2l-zh.zh: 面向中文读者、可运行可讨论的深度学习教材，被 70 多国 500 多所大学用于教学。

lobe-chat.en: Teams needing multi-model chat and agent operations can use LobeChat's polished chat with plugins, knowledge base, voice, and 7×24 scheduling.
lobe-chat.zh: 多模型聊天和代理运营用户，LobeChat提供插件、知识库、语音与7×24调度。

ruflo.en: For developers building multi-agent systems, Ruflo deploys swarms, coordinates workflows, and integrates vector RAG with Claude Code.
ruflo.zh: 面向构建多智能体系统的开发者，Ruflo 可部署智能体集群、协调自主工作流，并集成向量 RAG。

awesome-public-datasets.en: For researchers and analysts, it points to open datasets by topic, helping them find data for projects.
awesome-public-datasets.zh: 面向研究人员和分析师，按主题汇总开放数据集，帮助查找项目所需数据。

github-readme-stats.en: For developers who want to show activity on their GitHub profile, it generates stats images for READMEs dynamically.
github-readme-stats.zh: 为想要在 GitHub README 展示数据的开发者动态生成统计信息。

ventoy.en: For people who need multiple systems on one USB drive: copy images in and boot, with no repeated formatting.
ventoy.zh: 给需要在 U 盘里放多个系统镜像的人：拷贝进去就能启动，不用反复格式化。

hoppscotch.en: For developers testing and debugging APIs, Hoppscotch offers an open-source ecosystem across web, desktop, and CLI, with offline, on-prem, and cloud options.
hoppscotch.zh: 面向 API 开发者，提供网页、桌面与 CLI 的开源调试环境，支持离线与云端。

prompt-engineering-guide.en: For developers learning prompt engineering, it collects guides, papers, lessons, notebooks and resources on prompts, context, RAG and AI agents.
prompt-engineering-guide.zh: 面向学习提示工程的开发者，汇集指南、论文、课程与笔记本，覆盖提示、上下文、RAG 与 AI 智能体。

code-server.en: A browser-based VS Code for developers who want to write and edit code directly in a web browser.
code-server.zh: 面向希望在浏览器中直接编写和编辑代码的开发者，提供浏览器版的 VS Code。

advanced-java.en: A question-and-answer reference for experienced Java backend developers, covering core interview topics such as high concurrency, distributed systems, high availability, microservices, and massive data processing.
advanced-java.zh: 面向资深 Java 后端开发者的面试问答参考，涵盖高并发、分布式、高可用、微服务、海量数据处理等核心进阶知识。

obs-studio.en: OBS Studio is free, open source software for live streaming and screen recording. It suits streamers and creators who need multi-scene switching and mixed audio/video sources.
obs-studio.zh: OBS Studio 是免费开源的录屏和直播推流软件，适合需要多场景切换和多路音视频混合的主播与创作者。

caddy.en: A multi-platform web server for developers who want automatic HTTPS and a minimal configuration file.
caddy.zh: 面向需要自动 HTTPS 和极简配置文件的开发者的 Web 服务器。

career-ops.en: For job seekers: it scans job boards, scores each job 1-5 against your CV, tailors ATS-friendly resumes, and tracks applications locally in your AI coding CLI.
career-ops.zh: 面向求职者：扫描招聘网站，对照简历为职位打 1-5 分，定制 ATS 简历与求职信，并在本地跟踪申请进度。

awesome-claude-skills.en: For Claude AI users, it curates Claude Skills, resources, and tools to customize their workflows.
awesome-claude-skills.zh: 面向 Claude AI 用户，精选 Claude Skills、资源和工具，用于定制工作流。

ai-agents-for-beginners.en: A Microsoft course of 18 lessons for beginners who want to learn to build AI agents from scratch.
ai-agents-for-beginners.zh: 微软推出的 18 课入门课程，帮助零基础学习者从零开始学会构建 AI 智能体。

elasticsearch.en: Developers use Elasticsearch, a free and open source distributed RESTful search engine, to add search to applications.
elasticsearch.zh: 开发者用免费开源的分布式 RESTful 搜索引擎 Elasticsearch，为应用添加搜索功能。

learn-claude-code.en: For developers who want a minimal, Bash-only agent harness to learn how a Claude Code–like setup works from scratch.
learn-claude-code.zh: 面向想从零了解类 Claude Code 智能体框架的开发者：只需 Bash 即可运行。

models.en: For developers seeking TensorFlow model implementations and examples, this provides reference models and examples.
models.zh: 面向需要 TensorFlow 模型实现与示例的开发者，提供可参考的模型和示例。

appflowy.en: For teams managing projects and wikis, AppFlowy combines docs, boards, and database views in an AI collaborative workspace.
appflowy.zh: 面向需要管理项目和知识库的团队，AppFlowy 把文档、看板和数据库视图整合在 AI 协作空间里。

30-days-of-python.en: A step-by-step guide for learners who want to study Python over 30 days at their own pace.
30-days-of-python.zh: 一份分步指南，供想按自己节奏学习 Python 的学习者使用。

cpython.en: CPython is the Python programming language for developers who need it.
cpython.zh: CPython 是面向需要使用 Python 编程语言的开发者的 Python 编程语言。

unsloth.en: Unsloth gives users a local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, supporting GGUF, MLX, and multiple model families.
unsloth.zh: 面向需要本地运行和训练 LLM 与扩散模型的用户，提供支持 GGUF、MLX 及多种模型家族的界面。

gpt4all.en: GPT4All lets users run local LLMs on any device, is open-source, and is available for commercial use.
gpt4all.zh: GPT4All 让用户可在任意设备上运行本地 LLM，开源且可商用。

headroom.en: For developers building coding agents and RAG pipelines, Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM.
headroom.zh: Headroom 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 分块进入 LLM 前进行压缩，帮智能体开发者减少 token 用量。

tesseract.en: Tesseract is an open source OCR engine for developers who need to extract text from images.
tesseract.zh: Tesseract 是开源 OCR 引擎，面向需要从图像中提取文字的开发者。

font-awesome.en: A toolkit of SVG, font, and CSS resources for developers and designers who need icons in interfaces.
font-awesome.zh: 面向开发者和设计师的 SVG、字体与 CSS 工具包，用于在界面中使用图标。

imgui.en: Dear ImGui gives C++ developers a bloat-free graphical user interface with minimal dependencies.
imgui.zh: Dear ImGui 为 C++ 开发者提供无冗余的图形界面，且依赖极少。

redis.en: For developers building real-time data-driven applications, Redis provides caching, a data structure server, and document and vector querying.
redis.zh: 面向构建实时数据驱动应用的开发者，Redis 提供缓存、数据结构服务器以及文档与向量查询能力。

openai-cookbook.en: For developers building with the OpenAI API, it offers runnable examples and guides to get started.
openai-cookbook.zh: 面向使用 OpenAI API 的开发者，提供可直接运行的示例与指南，帮助快速上手。

leetcodeanimation.en: A tool for LeetCode learners that shows solutions to LeetCode questions in animation form.
leetcodeanimation.zh: 面向 LeetCode 学习者的工具，以动画形式呈现题目解题思路。

cs-self-learning.en: A self-study guide for people learning computer science on their own.
cs-self-learning.zh: 面向自学计算机的人，提供一份自学指南。

llamafactory.en: LlamaFactory helps researchers and engineers fine-tune over 100 LLMs and VLMs in one unified, efficient workflow.
llamafactory.zh: LlamaFactory 帮助研究人员和工程师在统一高效的流程中微调 100 多个 LLM 与 VLM。

apollo-11.en: Developers and historians can study the original Apollo 11 guidance computer source code for the command and lunar modules.
apollo-11.zh: 供开发者与历史爱好者查阅指令舱和登月舱所用的 Apollo 11 制导计算机原始源代码。

json-server.en: For frontend developers and prototypers who need a mock REST API without writing backend code.
json-server.zh: 面向前端开发者和原型制作者，无需编写后端代码即可获得模拟 REST API。

ai-engineering-from-scratch.en: A learning resource for people new to AI engineering, covering how to study, build, and ship AI projects for others.
ai-engineering-from-scratch.zh: 面向 AI 工程初学者的学习资源，涵盖学习、构建并为他人交付 AI 项目。

superset.en: A data visualization and data exploration platform for analysts and teams working with data.
superset.zh: 面向数据分析人员的数据可视化与数据探索平台。

awesome-scalability.en: A curated reference for engineers building large-scale systems, covering patterns for scalability, reliability, and performance.
awesome-scalability.zh: 面向构建大规模系统的工程师，汇集可扩展性、可靠性与性能方面的模式参考。

tabby.en: A terminal for users who want a more modern terminal experience.
tabby.zh: 一款面向希望获得更现代终端体验的用户的终端工具。

awesome-react.en: A curated collection of resources about the React ecosystem, for developers looking for React-related material in one place.
awesome-react.zh: 面向 React 开发者，汇总 React 生态相关资源，方便在一处查找所需内容。

hyperframes.en: Hyperframes lets agent developers write HTML and render it into video, so agents can produce video from markup.
hyperframes.zh: Hyperframes 面向智能体开发者，让智能体编写 HTML 并直接渲染成视频。

flask.en: Flask is a Python micro framework for developers who need to build web applications.
flask.zh: Flask 是一个 Python 微框架，适合需要构建 Web 应用的开发者使用。

openbb.en: OpenBB is an open data platform built for analysts, quants and AI agents.
openbb.zh: OpenBB 是面向分析师、量化研究人员和 AI 智能体的开放数据平台。

front-end-checklist.en: A checklist for modern web development, usable by humans and AI agents working on front-end tasks.
front-end-checklist.zh: 面向现代 Web 开发的清单，供人类和 AI 智能体在前端开发中使用。

awesome-machine-learning.en: A curated list for developers seeking Machine Learning frameworks, libraries and software in one place.
awesome-machine-learning.zh: 面向需要集中查找机器学习框架、库和软件资源的开发者。

awesome-cpp.en: For C++ and C developers, it lists frameworks, libraries, and resources in one curated collection.
awesome-cpp.zh: 面向 C++ 和 C 开发者，将框架、库与资源整理成一份精选清单。

photocraft.en: PhotoCraft is an open-source photo editor written from scratch in pure Rust, for users who want a Rust-built tool to edit photos.
photocraft.zh: PhotoCraft 是一款从零开始用纯 Rust 编写的开源照片编辑器，面向需要编辑照片的用户。

anime.en: A JavaScript animation engine for developers who need to create web animations in code.
anime.zh: 面向开发者的 JavaScript 动画引擎，用于在代码中创建网页动画。

the-algorithm.en: Source code of the X Recommendation Algorithm, for developers who want to study how it works.
the-algorithm.zh: X 推荐算法的源代码，供开发者查阅和研究。

affine.en: AFFiNE is an open-source, privacy-first knowledge base for people who want docs, whiteboards and tables in one workspace.
affine.zh: AFFiNE 是开源、隐私优先的知识库，适合需要把文档、白板和表格放在同一工作区的人。

stable-diffusion.en: A latent text-to-image diffusion model for developers who need to generate images from text prompts.
stable-diffusion.zh: 一个潜在文本到图像扩散模型，供开发者根据文本提示生成图像。

awesome-vue.en: A curated list of Vue.js resources for developers seeking libraries, tools, and learning materials.
awesome-vue.zh: 面向 Vue.js 开发者的资源清单，汇集相关库、工具与学习资料。

seclists.en: SecLists gives security testers one collection of assessment lists, including usernames, passwords, URLs, payloads, and more.
seclists.zh: SecLists 为安全测试人员集中提供评估用列表，包括用户名、密码、URL、敏感数据模式和模糊测试载荷等。

strapi.en: Strapi is an open-source headless CMS for developers who need a customizable content backend with automatic API generation.
strapi.zh: Strapi 是开源无头 CMS，适合需要可定制内容后台并自动生成 API 的开发者。

union.en: Union is a trust-minimized, zero-knowledge bridging protocol for DeFi users and projects that need censorship-resistant, secure cross-chain transfers.
union.zh: Union 是面向 DeFi 用户和项目的信任最小化零知识跨链桥协议，用于抗审查、安全的跨链转移。

openspec.en: OpenSpec helps developers using AI coding assistants apply spec-driven development, so requirements are defined before code is written.
openspec.zh: OpenSpec 帮助使用 AI 编码助手的开发者采用规范驱动开发，在写代码前先明确需求。

strix.en: Strix is an open-source AI penetration testing tool for developers who need to find and fix vulnerabilities in their applications.
strix.zh: Strix 是开源 AI 渗透测试工具，面向需要发现并修复应用漏洞的开发者。

mole.en: For Mac and PC users who want a clean, light system: an open-source CLI with native Mac and Windows apps.
mole.zh: 面向希望保持 Mac 和 PC 干净轻快的用户：开源 CLI，并提供原生 Mac 和 Windows 应用。

reveal-js.en: Reveal.js is an HTML presentation framework for people who build presentations with web technologies.
reveal-js.zh: Reveal.js 是一个 HTML 演示文稿框架，适合用网页技术制作演示的人。

moby.en: The Moby Project is a collaborative project for the container ecosystem to assemble container-based systems.
moby.zh: Moby 项目是一个面向容器生态的协作项目，用于组装基于容器的系统。

act.en: For developers using GitHub Actions who want to run their workflows locally instead of only on GitHub.
act.zh: 面向使用 GitHub Actions 的开发者，解决只能依赖 GitHub 运行工作流、无法在本地运行的问题。

awesome-courses.en: A list of university courses for learning computer science, for learners seeking course materials.
awesome-courses.zh: 面向学习计算机科学的人，整理大学课程清单，帮助找到学习资源。

protobuf.en: Developers use Protobuf, Google's data interchange format, to define structured data schemas and exchange serialized data between services.
protobuf.zh: 开发者使用 Google 的数据交换格式 Protobuf 定义结构化数据模式，并在服务之间交换序列化数据。

metagpt.en: A multi-agent framework for developers: product manager, architect, and engineer agents turn one-line requirements into code.
metagpt.zh: 面向开发者的多智能体框架：产品经理、架构师和工程师 agent 把一句话需求变成代码。

gpt-academic.en: Gpt Academic offers a practical interface for GPT and GLM models, with paper reading, polishing and writing tools for researchers.
gpt-academic.zh: Gpt Academic 为 GPT、GLM 等大模型提供实用交互接口，面向论文阅读、润色与写作场景。

cline.en: For developers, Cline is an autonomous coding agent offered as an SDK, IDE extension, or CLI assistant.
cline.zh: 面向开发者，Cline 是自主编码智能体，可作为 SDK、IDE 扩展或命令行助手使用。

ppt-master.en: For people who need presentations fast, it turns documents or topics into native PowerPoint decks with real shapes and animations.
ppt-master.zh: 面向需要快速做演示的人，可将文档或主题转换为带原生形状和动画的 PowerPoint 文稿。

openmontage.en: Turns AI coding assistants into a video production studio for developers, with 12 pipelines, 100+ tools and 700+ skill files.
openmontage.zh: 面向用 AI 编码助手的开发者，提供 12 条流水线、100+ 工具与 700+ 技能文件。

swift.en: A programming language for developers who need a language to write software.
swift.zh: 一种编程语言，供需要编写软件的开发者使用。

oh-my-openagent.en: Oh My Openagent lets you type the "mass ulw" keyword in your prompt to handle graph engineering.
oh-my-openagent.zh: Oh My Openagent：在提示词中输入“mass ulw”关键词，即可进行图工程。

howtolivebetter.en: A guide for people planning life decisions: it lists cost, benefit, evidence level and sources for health, money, legal and career topics.
howtolivebetter.zh: 面向做人生决策的人，列出健康、理财、法律等主题的成本、收益、证据等级和出处。

ai-for-beginners.en: A 12-week, 24-lesson curriculum that helps anyone start learning AI from the beginning.
ai-for-beginners.zh: 一套 12 周、24 节课的课程，帮助任何人从零开始学习 AI。

vaultwarden.en: A lightweight Rust implementation of a Bitwarden-compatible server for users who want to self-host their password vault on a small machine.
vaultwarden.zh: 面向希望在小机器上自建密码库的用户，Bitwarden 兼容服务端的轻量 Rust 实现。

docling.en: Docling helps developers and researchers turn PDF and Office documents into structured data for large language models.
docling.zh: Docling 面向开发者和研究人员，把 PDF 和 Office 文档解析成结构化数据，供大模型使用。

ansible.en: Ansible is an IT automation platform for deploying and maintaining applications and systems, using SSH with no agents to install.
ansible.zh: 面向应用与系统部署维护的 IT 自动化平台，基于 SSH，无需在被管节点安装代理。

up.en: A bilingual lifelong learning guide by Han Xiankai for people navigating AI, learning, startups, wealth, love and life in the AI era.
up.zh: 韩先凯撰写的中英双语终身学习指南，面向希望在AI时代学习AI、创业、财富、爱情与人生的人。

express.en: Express is a fast, unopinionated, minimalist web framework for node, helping developers build web applications and APIs.
express.zh: Express 是面向 Node 的快速、无主张、极简 Web 框架，帮助开发者构建 Web 应用和 API。

ublock-origin.en: A fast, lean blocker for Chromium and Firefox users who want to block ads, trackers and malicious domains.
ublock-origin.zh: 面向 Chromium 与 Firefox 用户的高效拦截器，快速轻量，可拦广告、追踪和恶意域名。

mediacrawler.en: A crawler toolkit for developers and researchers who need to collect posts, videos, articles, and comments from Chinese social platforms.
mediacrawler.zh: 面向开发者和研究者的爬虫工具，用于采集国内社交平台上的帖子、视频、文章和评论。

remotion.en: For developers who know React, it makes videos with code and helps batch-generate data visualizations and templated videos.
remotion.zh: 面向会 React 的开发者，用代码做视频，便于批量生成数据可视化和模板化视频。

open-interpreter.en: A local coding agent that lets open models write and run code on your machine for files, spreadsheets, and batch image edits.
open-interpreter.zh: 一个本地代码智能体，让开放模型在你的电脑上编写并执行代码，处理文件、表格和批量改图。

claude-code-best-practice.en: A practice resource for developers moving from vibe coding to agentic engineering with Claude Code.
claude-code-best-practice.zh: 面向从氛围编程转向智能体工程的开发者，提供用好 Claude Code 的实践参考。

ripgrep.en: For developers who search code across many files, ripgrep recursively finds regex matches while respecting .gitignore rules.
ripgrep.zh: 面向需要在多文件中搜索代码的开发者，ripgrep 可递归查找正则匹配并遵循 .gitignore。

system-prompts-leaks.en: For AI developers and researchers, it collects documented system prompts from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and other models, updated regularly.
system-prompts-leaks.zh: 面向 AI 开发者与研究者，收录 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok 等模型的系统提示词，并定期更新。

mem0.en: For AI agent and app developers, Mem0 provides drop-in memory infrastructure so context persists across sessions.
mem0.zh: 面向智能体与应用开发者，Mem0 提供即插即用的记忆基础设施，让上下文持久保留。

scikit-learn.en: Scikit-learn is a Python tool for developers who need to do machine learning.
scikit-learn.zh: Scikit-learn 是面向 Python 开发者的机器学习工具。

chart-js.en: For web developers who need simple charts, Chart.js draws HTML5 charts with the canvas tag.
chart-js.zh: 面向需要简单图表的网页开发者，Chart.js 使用 canvas 标签绘制 HTML5 图表。

ai-job-search.en: A Claude Code framework for job seekers who want local control: it evaluates postings, tailors CVs, writes cover letters, and preps interviews.
ai-job-search.zh: 面向希望本地掌控求职流程的求职者，基于 Claude Code 评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。

anything-llm.en: For teams that want a local-first agent: it turns company documents into a conversational knowledge base and connects to various models.
anything-llm.zh: 面向本地优先智能体的团队：把公司文档变成可对话知识库，可接入多种模型。

prometheus.en: Prometheus is an open-source monitoring system and time series database for collecting metrics from services and infrastructure, helping operators observe system health.
prometheus.zh: Prometheus 是开源监控系统与时序数据库，用于采集服务和基础设施指标，帮助运维人员观察系统健康状况。

annotated-deep-learning-paper-implementa.en: A resource for learners and researchers who want annotated deep learning paper implementations with side-by-side notes, covering transformers, optimizers, GANs, and reinforcement learning.
annotated-deep-learning-paper-implementa.zh: 面向学习者和研究者，提供带对照笔记的深度学习论文实现，涵盖 Transformer、优化器、GAN 和强化学习等主题。

daily-stock-analysis.en: For investors tracking several markets, it combines multi-source quotes, news, a decision dashboard, and automated alerts via LLM analysis.
daily-stock-analysis.zh: 面向需要跟踪多个市场的投资者，用 LLM 汇总多源行情与实时新闻，提供决策看板并自动推送。

java.en: A Java code collection of common algorithms, for developers who want reference implementations while learning or reviewing.
java.zh: 一个用 Java 实现常见算法的代码合集，适合想在学习或复习时参考实现的学习者与开发者。

design-resources-for-developers.en: A curated list for developers seeking design and UI resources, collecting stock photos, templates, CSS frameworks, UI libraries, and tools in one place.
design-resources-for-developers.zh: 为开发者汇总精选的设计与 UI 资源，包括图库、模板、CSS 框架、UI 库和工具，方便集中查找。

docusaurus.en: Docusaurus helps teams build and maintain open source documentation websites with less effort.
docusaurus.zh: Docusaurus 帮助团队轻松搭建和维护开源文档网站，适合需要持续更新文档的项目。

33-js-concepts.en: A list of 33 JavaScript concepts that every developer should know, for learners reviewing core JavaScript topics.
33-js-concepts.zh: 整理了每位开发者都应了解的 33 个 JavaScript 概念，适合学习者梳理核心知识点。

ladybird.en: For users and developers who want a browser engine built from scratch, offering an independent alternative to Chromium-based browsers.
ladybird.zh: 面向希望摆脱 Chromium 依赖的用户和开发者，提供从零编写的独立浏览器引擎。

alacritty.en: A cross-platform OpenGL terminal emulator for users who want fast, simple terminal performance configured through config files.
alacritty.zh: 面向追求速度的用户，跨平台 OpenGL 终端，仅通过配置文件设置。

nocodb.en: NocoDB is a free, self-hostable tool that turns any database into an Airtable-style table interface for teams.
nocodb.zh: NocoDB 是免费且可自托管的工具，能把任意数据库变成 Airtable 式的表格界面，方便团队使用。

traefik.en: Traefik is a cloud native application proxy for teams running containerized services, keeping routing ready as containers start.
traefik.zh: Traefik 是面向运行容器化服务的团队的云原生反向代理，容器启动时路由自动就绪。

ffmpeg.en: For developers working with audio and video, FFmpeg handles transcoding, cutting, subtitle adding and compression.
ffmpeg.zh: 面向需要处理音视频的开发者，FFmpeg 负责转码、剪切、加字幕与压制。

winutil.en: A Windows utility for users and admins who want one place to install programs, apply tweaks, run fixes, and manage updates.
winutil.zh: 面向 Windows 用户和管理员的实用工具，集中完成程序安装、系统调整、问题修复和更新管理。

v2rayng.en: V2rayNG is a V2Ray client for Android users, with support for the Xray core and the v2fly core.
v2rayng.zh: V2rayNG 是面向 Android 用户的 V2Ray 客户端，支持 Xray 核心与 v2fly 核心。

last30days-skill.en: For AI agent users who need fast, sourced research, it scans Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web, then writes a grounded summary.
last30days-skill.zh: 面向需要快速调研的 AI 智能体用户，它检索 Reddit、X、YouTube 等平台与网络，并生成有依据的摘要。

minimind.en: For learners and developers who want to train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in about 2 hours.
minimind.zh: 面向想从零训练 64M 参数大模型的学习者和开发者，约 2 小时即可完成。

ai-hedge-fund.en: Ai Hedge Fund is an AI hedge fund team project for developers interested in AI-driven investment teams.
ai-hedge-fund.zh: Ai Hedge Fund 是一个 AI 对冲基金团队项目，面向关注 AI 投资团队的开发者。

nanogpt.en: For developers who want a simple repository to train and finetune medium-sized GPT models.
nanogpt.zh: 面向需要简单代码库来训练和微调中型 GPT 模型的开发者。

awesome-chatgpt-prompts-zh.en: A Chinese guide to ChatGPT prompting for users who want practical usage tips across scenarios and clearer instruction control.
awesome-chatgpt-prompts-zh.zh: 一份 ChatGPT 中文调教指南，面向希望获得多场景使用方法、让模型更好听从指令的用户。

tldr.en: A community-maintained cheatsheet site that gives console users the most common command examples instead of full manuals.
tldr.zh: 面向命令行用户的社区速查手册，提供最常用的命令示例，而非完整手册。

git.en: A publish-only mirror of Git's source code for contributors who submit improvements as mailing-list patches.
git.zh: 面向贡献者的 Git 源代码只读镜像，改进需按提交流程转为邮件列表补丁。

memos.en: For people who want to collect everyday thoughts in a personal timeline, Memos is a self-hosted open-source note-taking app that keeps data under your control.
memos.zh: 适合想随手记录碎片想法的人，Memos 是自建开源笔记应用，用时间线汇集内容并掌控数据。

openpilot.en: For developers and car owners, openpilot is a robotics operating system that upgrades driver assistance in 300+ supported cars.
openpilot.zh: 面向开发者和车主，openpilot 是机器人操作系统，可为 300+ 受支持车型升级驾驶辅助。

context7.en: Context7 gives AI agents and the developers who build them up-to-date documentation for their work.
context7.zh: Context7 为 AI 智能体和开发它们的工程师提供最新文档。

drawio-desktop.en: For people who want draw.io as a desktop app: this is the official Electron build of draw.io.
drawio-desktop.zh: 面向想在桌面端使用 draw.io 的用户：这是 draw.io 的官方 Electron 构建版本。

termux.en: Termux is a terminal emulator app for Android users, offering a Linux environment extendible by a variety of packages.
termux.zh: Termux 是面向安卓用户的终端模拟器应用，提供可由多种软件包扩展的 Linux 环境。

magisk.en: Android users who need root access can use this tool, which supports modules and root hiding.
magisk.zh: 面向需要 root 的安卓用户，支持模块化扩展和隐藏 root。

socket-io.en: Socket.io gives developers a way to build bidirectional, low-latency communication across platforms.
socket-io.zh: Socket.io 为开发者提供跨平台的双向低延迟通信能力。

marktext.en: A simple, elegant markdown editor for writers who want a clean editing interface on Linux, macOS and Windows.
marktext.zh: 面向需要简洁优雅写作界面的用户，这款 Markdown 编辑器可在 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 上使用。

ghostty.en: A cross-platform terminal emulator for developers who want native UI and GPU acceleration.
ghostty.zh: 面向需要原生界面与 GPU 加速的开发者的跨平台终端模拟器。

coolify.en: Coolify is an open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku, and Netlify for deploying static sites, databases, full-stack apps, and one-click services on your servers.
coolify.zh: 面向需要自托管的开发者，Coolify 可在自有服务器部署静态站点、数据库、全栈应用及一键服务。

trendradar.en: TrendRadar helps analysts and teams cut information overload by aggregating multi-platform trends and RSS with AI filtering and alerts.
trendradar.zh: 面向舆情与趋势关注者，聚合多平台热点与RSS，用AI筛选并推送，缓解信息过载。

litellm.en: For developers building AI agents: route 100+ LLM APIs through one OpenAI-format gateway with cost tracking, guardrails, and logging.
litellm.zh: 面向开发者：一套 OpenAI 格式调用上百个大模型 API，记录成本与日志。

diagram-design.en: A diagram design tool for AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor, offering 45 diagram types as self-contained HTML and SVG.
diagram-design.zh: 为 AI 编程助手提供 45 种图表类型的出版物级设计，输出自包含 HTML 和 SVG。

humanizer.en: Humanizer is an agent skill for writers and editors who want to remove signs of AI-generated writing from text.
humanizer.zh: Humanizer 是一款智能体技能，面向希望从文本中去除 AI 生成痕迹的写作者和编辑。

pake.en: For developers who want a desktop app from a website, Pake packages it in one command on macOS, Windows and Linux.
pake.zh: 面向想用一条命令把网页变成轻量桌面应用的开发者，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。

penpot.en: Penpot is an open-source design platform for product teams that need scalable collaboration.
penpot.zh: Penpot 是面向产品团队的开源设计平台，用于支持可扩展的协作。

awesome-flutter.en: For Flutter developers who need a curated list of libraries, tools, tutorials and articles.
awesome-flutter.zh: 面向 Flutter 开发者，提供整理好的库、工具、教程与文章清单。

plane.en: Plane is an open-source project management platform for teams that need to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage in one place.
plane.zh: Plane 是开源项目管理平台，适合需要集中管理任务、迭代、文档与问题分流的团队。

free-claude-code.en: Gives developers free access to Claude Code, Codex, and other coding harnesses from the terminal, IDE, app, or browser.
free-claude-code.zh: 让开发者在终端、IDE 或浏览器免费使用 Claude Code 等编码框架。

chinese-independent-developer.en: For people curious about Chinese indie developers: a project list showing what they are building.
chinese-independent-developer.zh: 面向想了解中国独立开发者的人：一份项目列表，展示大家都在做什么。

pi-hole.en: Pi-hole gives home network users a DNS-level ad blocker that filters ads for every device on the network.
pi-hole.zh: Pi-hole 为家庭网络用户提供 DNS 级广告拦截，为网络中所有设备过滤广告。

pocketbase.en: Open source single-file realtime backend with built-in auth, database, and admin panel, for developers who want to skip backend setup.
pocketbase.zh: 开源单文件实时后端，自带认证、数据库和后台管理，适合想省去后端搭建的开发者。

autogen.en: A programming framework for developers building agentic AI, letting multiple agents discuss until a problem is solved.
autogen.zh: 面向开发者的编程框架，用多个 agent 互相讨论来推进问题解决。

gods-eye-view.en: For developers and analysts exploring open spatial data, it offers a browser-based satellite view on a photorealistic 3D globe.
gods-eye-view.zh: 面向开发者和分析人员，在浏览器中以逼真 3D 地球查看实时开源空间数据。

redux.en: For JavaScript developers, Redux is a library for predictable global state management.
redux.zh: Redux 是面向 JavaScript 开发者的库，用于可预测的全局状态管理。

win11debloat.en: A lightweight PowerShell script for Windows 10 and 11 users who want to remove pre-installed apps, disable telemetry, and declutter their system.
win11debloat.zh: 适合 Win10/Win11 用户：用轻量 PowerShell 脚本移除预装应用、关闭遥测并精简系统。

bat.en: A cat clone for command-line users who want syntax highlighting and Git markers when reading files.
bat.zh: 面向命令行用户的 cat 替代工具，在查看文件时提供语法高亮和 Git 标记。

rclone.en: A command-line tool for people who need to sync, mount, or migrate files across dozens of cloud storage services.
rclone.zh: 面向需要在几十种云存储之间同步、挂载或迁移文件的用户的命令行工具。

nuxt.en: A full-stack framework for Vue developers.
nuxt.zh: 面向 Vue 开发者的全栈框架。

architect-awesome.en: A technology map for backend architects, showing topics relevant to the role.
architect-awesome.zh: 面向后端架构师的技术图谱，帮助了解该角色相关的技术主题。

crewai.en: CrewAI is a framework for developers who orchestrate role-playing autonomous AI agents that collaborate on complex tasks.
crewai.zh: CrewAI 是给需要让多个带角色的自主智能体像团队一样协作、完成复杂任务的开发者使用的框架。

awesome-rust.en: A curated list of Rust code and resources for developers looking for Rust libraries and learning material.
awesome-rust.zh: 面向寻找 Rust 代码与学习资料的开发者，整理了一份精选的 Rust 代码与资源清单。

starship.en: A minimal, customizable prompt for any shell that shows git branch and language versions for developers.
starship.zh: 面向使用任意 shell 的开发者，提供简洁可定制的提示符，自动显示 git 分支和语言版本。

spring-framework.en: Spring Framework is listed under dev-tools; the given description contains only its name.
spring-framework.zh: Spring Framework 归入开发工具分类，给定描述中仅有名称。

mkcert.en: mkcert is a zero-config tool for developers who need locally trusted HTTPS certificates for any names they choose.
mkcert.zh: mkcert 是一款零配置工具，帮助开发者为任意名称生成本地可信的 HTTPS 开发证书。

twenty.en: An open alternative to Salesforce with a modern interface, designed for AI-ready teams.
twenty.zh: 面向需要开源 Salesforce 替代方案的团队，提供现代界面并面向 AI。

mempalace.en: A free, open-source memory system for AI agents and developers who need to give their applications persistent memory.
mempalace.zh: 面向 AI 智能体开发者的免费开源记忆系统，用于为应用提供记忆能力。

jquery.en: jQuery is a JavaScript library for developers who need a JavaScript library in their projects.
jquery.zh: jQuery 是一个 JavaScript 库，面向在项目中使用 JavaScript 库的开发者。

github-cheat-sheet.en: For Git and GitHub users, this cheat sheet lists cool features in one place.
github-cheat-sheet.zh: 面向 Git 和 GitHub 用户，这份速查表集中列出两者的有趣功能。

meilisearch.en: Developers building site or app search can use Meilisearch's fast search engine API, an open-source alternative to Algolia.
meilisearch.zh: 为网站或应用接入搜索的开发者，可用 Meilisearch 的快速搜索 API，这也是 Algolia 的开源替代方案。

llama.en: Inference code for Llama models, aimed at developers who need to run these models.
llama.zh: 面向需要运行 Llama 模型的开发者，提供这些模型的推理代码。

i-have-adhd.en: A skill for developers using coding agents, keeping the agent from burying the answer and making output ADHD-friendly.
i-have-adhd.zh: 一项面向使用编码智能体的开发者的技能，防止智能体把答案埋在冗长输出中，让结果更易读。

voicebox.en: Voicebox is an open-source AI voice studio for creators who need to clone voices, dictate text, and generate audio.
voicebox.zh: Voicebox 是开源 AI 语音工作室，面向需要克隆声音、口述文字和创作音频的用户。

shadowsocks-windows.en: A C# port of Shadowsocks, giving Windows users a C# implementation of the Shadowsocks proxy.
shadowsocks-windows.zh: Shadowsocks 的 C# 移植版本，为 Windows 用户提供 C# 实现的 Shadowsocks 代理。

nanochat.en: A low-cost ChatGPT-style tool for developers who want an affordable setup.
nanochat.zh: 面向希望低成本搭建类 ChatGPT 环境的开发者。

jellyfin.en: Jellyfin is a free software media system for people who want to run their own media server, offering a server backend and API to organize and stream their library.
jellyfin.zh: Jellyfin 是面向想自建媒体服务器的人的自由软件媒体系统，提供服务器后端与 API，用来整理和播放自己的媒体库。

motrix.en: A full-featured download manager for users who need HTTP, BitTorrent, magnet and Baidu Netdisk downloads in one clean interface.
motrix.zh: 一款界面清爽的全能下载器，适合需要在一个工具里完成 HTTP、BT、磁力和百度网盘下载的用户。

cli-anything.en: CLI-Anything makes software agent-native, giving agents a CLI-Hub at clianything.cc to work with tools.
cli-anything.zh: CLI-Anything 让软件成为智能体原生应用，并提供 CLI-Hub（clianything.cc）供智能体使用。

joplin.en: A privacy-focused note taking app for users who want synced notes across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.
joplin.zh: 面向需要跨平台同步笔记并注重隐私的用户，支持端到端加密。

marketingskills.en: Gives Claude Code and AI agent users ready-made marketing skills across CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
marketingskills.zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 AI 智能体的营销技能，覆盖 CRO、文案写作、SEO、数据分析和增长工程。

n8n-workflows.en: For anyone looking for n8n workflows, it collects all workflows the author could find, including those from the n8n site.
n8n-workflows.zh: 面向需要查找 n8n 工作流的人，收集作者能找到的所有工作流，也包括来自 n8n 官网的。

openmanus.en: For developers, OpenManus is an upcoming open tool described as purely open ground without fortresses.
openmanus.zh: 面向开发者，OpenManus 是即将推出的开放工具，定位为不设堡垒的开阔地。

awesome-claude-code.en: A curated resource collection for Claude Code users seeking skills, agents, status lines, developer tooling, and plugins in one place.
awesome-claude-code.zh: 帮助 Claude Code 用户集中查找技能、代理、状态栏、开发工具与插件等精选资源。

goose.en: For developers who want an extensible AI agent that can install, execute, edit, and test with any LLM.
goose.zh: 给需要本地运行、可接任意模型和 MCP 工具的开发者：Goose 能安装、执行、编辑并测试代码。

vibevoice.en: VibeVoice is an open-source frontier voice AI for developers who want voice capabilities in their own projects.
vibevoice.zh: VibeVoice 是开源前沿语音 AI，面向希望在自有项目中引入语音能力的开发者。

hindsight.en: For AI agent developers, Hindsight offers agent memory that learns, addressing the problem of agents that do not keep experience.
hindsight.zh: 面向智能体开发者，Hindsight 提供会学习的智能体记忆，解决智能体难以保留经验的问题。

ai-agent-book.en: Open-source book repository for people learning AI agent design principles and engineering practice, with full text, compiled PDF, and per-chapter code.
ai-agent-book.zh: 为学习 AI Agent 设计原理与工程实践者，提供全书正文、编译版 PDF 与各章配套代码的开源仓库。

whisper-cpp.en: A C/C++ port of OpenAI's Whisper model for developers who want local speech transcription without an internet connection.
whisper-cpp.zh: Whisper 的 C/C++ 实现，适合需要在本地离线完成语音转写的开发者。

scientific-agent-skills.en: For researchers using AI agents, it provides 177 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, and medicine.
scientific-agent-skills.zh: 为使用 AI 智能体的科研人员提供 177 个经验证技能和 100+ 个科学数据库。

bmad-method.en: A method for teams doing agile, AI-driven development, offering a structured approach to organizing that work.
bmad-method.zh: 面向采用敏捷 AI 驱动开发的团队，提供一种组织这类工作的结构化方法。

dive.en: A CLI tool for developers to explore each layer of a Docker image and see what makes it large.
dive.zh: 面向开发者的命令行工具，逐层查看 Docker 镜像内容，找出体积膨胀的原因。

cliproxyapi.en: For developers who want one API, CLIProxyAPI wraps coding CLIs and exposes OpenAI, Gemini, Claude and Codex compatible endpoints.
cliproxyapi.zh: 供开发者把多种编程工具封装为兼容 OpenAI 等格式的 API，省去逐个对接。

academic-research-skills.en: A skill set for Claude Code users who need a guided workflow from research through writing, review, revision, and finalization.
academic-research-skills.zh: 面向 Claude Code 用户的技能集，提供从研究、写作、评审、修改到定稿的流程指引。

chrome-devtools-mcp.en: Chrome DevTools Mcp gives coding agents access to browser debugging tools, helping developers inspect and troubleshoot web pages.
chrome-devtools-mcp.zh: Chrome DevTools Mcp 让编码智能体使用浏览器调试工具，帮助开发者检查和排查网页问题。

multica.en: Multica is an open-source, self-hostable tool for teams that want humans and AI agents to work together as one team.
multica.zh: Multica 是开源且可自托管的工具，让人类与 AI 智能体像一个团队一样协作。

anthropic-cookbook.en: A notebook collection for developers learning to use Claude, with practical examples of tool use, RAG, and vision.
anthropic-cookbook.zh: 面向学习使用 Claude 的开发者，提供工具调用、RAG 与视觉等实战示例笔记本。

fooocus.en: Fooocus is an open-source text-to-image tool for people who want good results without tuning parameters, letting them focus on prompting and generating.
fooocus.zh: Fooocus 是开箱即用的文生图工具，面向不想调参数的用户，让用户专注于提示词和生成。

awesome-openclaw-skills.en: A categorized collection of 5,400+ OpenClaw skills from the official registry, for users who need to find relevant skills faster.
awesome-openclaw-skills.zh: 从官方注册表筛选并分类的 5,400+ 个 OpenClaw 技能合集，帮助用户更快找到相关技能。

dbeaver.en: For developers and data teams: a free universal database tool and SQL client that manages dozens of databases in one interface.
dbeaver.zh: 面向开发者和数据团队：免费通用数据库工具与 SQL 客户端，一个界面管理几十种数据库。

nature-skills.en: For researchers preparing manuscripts, it supports academic wording and scientific figures aligned with Nature style conventions.
nature-skills.zh: 面向准备论文的研究人员，提供符合 Nature 学术表达与科研绘图规范的写作与制图支持。

security-audit-skill.en: For coding agents running security audits: it performs multi-phase audits and returns independently verified, machine-readable findings.
security-audit-skill.zh: 面向执行安全审计的编码智能体：多阶段审计，输出经独立验证、机器可读的发现项。

upscayl.en: Upscayl helps Linux, macOS and Windows users upscale low-resolution images with local AI processing.
upscayl.zh: Upscayl 面向 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 用户，用本地 AI 把低清图片放大为高清。

pretext.en: Pretext helps developers measure and lay out text quickly and accurately, solving text layout problems in their projects.
pretext.zh: Pretext 帮助开发者快速、准确地测量和布局文本，解决项目中的文本排版问题。

tldraw.en: For React developers who need an infinite canvas: the tldraw SDK helps them build sketching and brainstorming apps.
tldraw.zh: 面向需要无限画布的 React 开发者：tldraw SDK 可用于构建草图与脑暴应用。

skills-2.en: Skills is a developer tool that offers skills for designers and engineers.
skills-2.zh: Skills 是一款面向设计师和工程师、提供相关技能的工具。

spotube.en: Spotube is an open source music streaming app for desktop and mobile users who want a free client to play their music.
spotube.zh: Spotube 是开源音乐流客户端，适合想在桌面和移动端收听音乐的用户。

mastodon.en: For communities that want their own microblogging server, Mastodon offers self-hosted instances connected across a wider network.
mastodon.zh: 适合想自主运营微博客社区的人：Mastodon 支持自建实例，并与全球网络互联。

shannon.en: For security and development teams, Shannon analyzes source code, identifies attack vectors, and runs real exploits to prove vulnerabilities before production.
shannon.zh: 面向安全与开发团队，Shannon 分析源代码、识别攻击向量并执行真实漏洞利用，在上线前证明漏洞确实存在。

localai.en: For developers who want to run models locally, LocalAI offers an open-source engine with an OpenAI-compatible API and no GPU requirement.
localai.zh: 为本地部署模型的开发者提供开源引擎与 OpenAI 兼容 API，改地址即可用。

dsh-our-free-model.en: For dsh users who want frontier models without login, sign-up or API keys, this plugin adds access for free with no usage cap.
dsh-our-free-model.zh: 面向想在 dsh 中直接用前沿模型的用户，装此插件即可免登录、免注册、免 API Key，完全免费且不限量。

container.en: A Swift-written tool for Mac users, especially on Apple silicon, to create and run Linux containers using lightweight virtual machines.
container.zh: 帮 Mac 用户用轻量级虚拟机创建运行 Linux 容器，Swift 编写，优化 Apple silicon。

metabase.en: An easy-to-use open source BI and embedded analytics tool that lets everyone, including non-technical teams, work with data.
metabase.zh: 面向非技术同事的开源 BI 与嵌入式分析工具，拖拽即可生成报表。

aider.en: Aider is a terminal-based AI pair programming tool that reads and writes files in your repository and commits changes for developers.
aider.zh: Aider 是终端里的 AI 结对编程工具，直接读写仓库文件并提交，面向需要在本地改代码的开发者。

obsidian-skills.en: Lets Obsidian users and agent builders teach their agent to use the Obsidian CLI and open formats like Markdown, Bases, and JSON Canvas.
obsidian-skills.zh: 帮 Obsidian 用户教智能体用 CLI 和 Markdown 等开放格式。

cal-com.en: Cal.com is scheduling infrastructure for anyone who needs to share bookable times as a link, so people can pick a slot without back-and-forth messages.
cal-com.zh: Cal.com 是面向需要把可预约时间以链接形式分享出去的人的日程预约系统，让对方直接选时间，省去反复沟通。

slidev.en: Slidev helps developers who write technical talks turn Markdown files into presentation slides, with code highlighting and animations supported.
slidev.zh: Slidev 面向需要写技术演讲的开发者，用 Markdown 文件生成演示文稿，并支持代码高亮和动画。

open-code-review.en: A code review tool for development teams: deterministic pipelines plus an LLM Agent give precise line-level comments and built-in multi-language rules.
open-code-review.zh: 面向开发团队的代码审查工具：确定性流水线加 LLM Agent，提供精确行级评论与内置多语言规则集。

anyps5.en: A tool for users who need to automatically port PS5 executables to Linux and Windows.
anyps5.zh: 面向需要将 PS5 可执行文件自动移植到 Linux 和 Windows 的用户。

deeptutor.en: DeepTutor provides lifelong personalized tutoring for learners who want individualized instruction over time.
deeptutor.zh: DeepTutor 面向希望长期获得个性化指导的学习者，提供终身个性化辅导。

gitnexus.en: A zero-server code intelligence engine for developers who need code intelligence without running a server.
gitnexus.zh: 面向开发者的零服务器代码智能引擎，无需运行服务器即可使用代码智能。

nanobot.en: A lightweight open-source Python framework for people who want to self-host a personal AI agent with a WebUI, memory, tools, and MCP.
nanobot.zh: 给想自托管个人 AI 智能体的用户：开源 Python 框架，内置 WebUI、工具与记忆。

discourse.en: A free, open and simple community discussion platform for teams that want to host their own product community forum.
discourse.zh: 免费、开放、简单的社区论坛系统，适合需要自建产品官方社区论坛的团队。

umi-ocr.en: Umi-OCR gives users free offline OCR for screenshots, batches of images, and PDFs, with watermark/header removal and QR code tools.
umi-ocr.zh: Umi-OCR 为需要离线文字识别的用户提供截屏、批量图片与 PDF 识别，可排除水印页眉页脚并生成二维码。

bruno.en: Bruno is an open source IDE for developers who need to explore and test APIs, storing requests as plain text files for version control.
bruno.zh: Bruno 是开源 API 调试工具，把请求保存为纯文本文件，方便开发者纳入 git 管理。

codebase-memory-mcp.en: Local code intelligence for developers and AI agents, connecting code, docs and infrastructure in a persistent graph so agents can work with context.
codebase-memory-mcp.zh: 面向开发者和 AI 智能体的本地代码智能，将代码、文档和基础设施连接成持久图谱，让智能体在上下文中工作。

paperless-ngx.en: For people buried in paper and PDFs, Paperless-ngx scans, indexes and archives documents so you can search their full text.
paperless-ngx.zh: 适合被纸质文件和 PDF 淹没的人：Paperless-ngx 把文件扫描、索引并归档，之后可按全文搜索查找。

pandoc.en: Pandoc is a universal markup converter for writers and researchers who need to move documents between dozens of markup formats.
pandoc.zh: Pandoc 是一款万能文档转换器，帮助写作者和研究人员在几十种标记格式之间互转文档。

helix.en: Helix is a modal text editor for developers who want multiple selections and built-in LSP support out of the box.
helix.zh: Helix 是一款模态文本编辑器，适合希望开箱即用获得多选与内置 LSP 支持的开发者。

rsshub.en: RSSHub lets people who track content turn almost any website into an RSS feed, serving as a base for distribution and monitoring.
rsshub.zh: RSSHub 让需要追踪内容的人把几乎所有网站变成 RSS 源，作为内容分发和监控的底座。

siyuan.en: SiYuan is an open-source, self-hosted knowledge workspace for people who want local data, block-level references, and AI agent collaboration.
siyuan.zh: SiYuan 是开源、自托管的知识工作空间，适合需要块级引用、数据存本地并与智能体协作的用户。

mitmproxy.en: A TLS-capable intercepting HTTP proxy for penetration testers and software developers, useful for debugging apps and APIs.
mitmproxy.zh: 面向渗透测试人员和软件开发者的交互式抓包改包工具，用于调试 App 和接口。

librechat.en: A self-hosted chat platform for teams that need one interface to switch between OpenAI, Claude, and local models.
librechat.zh: 面向需要在一个界面切换 OpenAI、Claude 与本地模型的自托管团队聊天平台。

herdr.en: A runtime for developers whose coding agents need a place to run.
herdr.zh: 面向需要为编码智能体提供运行环境的开发者，提供其所依托的运行时。

rocketchat.en: A self-hosted IM platform for teams that need control over their messaging, with federation and many integrations.
rocketchat.zh: 面向需要自主掌控通信的团队，提供自托管即时通讯，支持联邦和大量集成。

omarchy.en: An opinionated Linux setup for users who want a modern, beautiful desktop environment.
omarchy.zh: 面向想要美观、现代桌面环境的用户的个性化 Linux 方案。

lossless-cut.en: For video editors who need quick cuts, LosslessCut trims clips without re-encoding, so quality stays intact.
lossless-cut.zh: 给需要快速剪片的视频创作者：LosslessCut 无需重新编码即可剪切素材，画质不受影响。
