logseq.en: For people who want a privacy-first, open-source platform for knowledge management and collaboration, with outlines, bidirectional links, and local plain-text storage.
logseq.zh: 面向需要隐私优先、开源知识管理与协作的人，提供大纲式双向链接笔记和本地纯文本存储。

hyperswitch.en: Hyperswitch is an open source payments platform for businesses that need to connect multiple payment, payout, fraud, and tokenization providers.
hyperswitch.zh: 开源支付编排平台，面向需对接多家支付、代付、风控与令牌化服务商的企业。

zen-browser.en: A Firefox-based browser with a sidebar and workspace layout, for people who want a calmer internet experience.
zen-browser.zh: 基于 Firefox 的浏览器，采用侧边栏和工作区布局，适合想要更平静上网体验的人。

agentic-awesome-skills.en: For AI agent builders needing local control: discover skills in a catalog, let agents choose, validate stacks, and plan.
agentic-awesome-skills.zh: 面向 AI 智能体开发者：在本地完成技能目录发现、智能体自主选择、技术栈验证与规划。

claude-howto.en: For developers learning Claude Code, this visual guide offers example-driven explanations and copy-paste templates from basics to advanced agents.
claude-howto.zh: 面向学习 Claude Code 的开发者，这份可视化指南以示例讲解从基础概念到高级智能体，并提供可复制模板。

claude-plugins-official.en: Claude Code users seeking reliable plugins can browse this Anthropic-managed directory of quality plugins.
claude-plugins-official.zh: 面向需要可靠插件的 Claude Code 用户，提供由 Anthropic 官方管理的高质量插件目录。

headscale.en: For teams that want to build their own virtual network, Headscale is an open source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server.
headscale.zh: 面向想自建虚拟内网的用户，Headscale 是 Tailscale 控制服务器的开源自托管实现。

reactive-resume.en: An open-source resume builder for job seekers who want a private, customizable and portable way to create resumes.
reactive-resume.zh: 开源在线简历生成器，适合注重隐私、需要可定制并导出 PDF 的求职者使用。

jan.en: For people who want a ChatGPT-like assistant on their own computer, Jan is an open source desktop app that runs 100% offline.
jan.zh: 面向想在电脑上用对话式 AI 的用户，Jan 是开源桌面端工具，完全离线运行，下载即用。

sub2api.en: For developers juggling several AI subscriptions, Sub2API is an open-source relay that unifies Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok access and supports shared plans.
sub2api.zh: 为多订阅用户提供开源中转，统一接入 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok，并支持拼车分摊成本。

jsoncrack.en: For developers working with JSON, YAML, XML or CSV data, this open-source app turns those formats into interactive graphs so data structure is easier to see.
jsoncrack.zh: 面向需要处理 JSON、YAML、XML 或 CSV 数据的开发者，这款开源应用能把数据转成可交互图形，方便看清结构。

agent-browser.en: A browser automation CLI for AI agents, giving them a command-line way to automate browser tasks.
agent-browser.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的浏览器自动化命令行工具，让智能体通过命令行完成浏览器自动化任务。

colibri.en: For developers who want to run frontier MoE models on hardware they already own, with a pure C, zero-dependency engine that streams experts from disk.
colibri.zh: 面向想在自有硬件上运行前沿 MoE 模型的开发者：纯 C、零依赖，专家从磁盘流式加载。

fd.en: A simple, fast, and user-friendly alternative to 'find' for command-line users.
fd.zh: 为命令行用户提供一个简单、快速、易用的 find 替代品。

langgraph.en: For developers building agent workflows who need state graphs with loops, branching, and human-in-the-loop steps.
langgraph.zh: 面向构建智能体流程的开发者，用状态图组织循环、分支和人工介入。

reverse-skill.en: For security researchers and authorized pentesters, it routes requests to reverse engineering skills and bootstraps toolchains on demand.
reverse-skill.zh: 面向逆向工程与授权渗透测试人员，按需路由安全技能并自举工具链。

kronos.en: Kronos is a foundation model for the language of financial markets.
kronos.zh: Kronos 是面向金融市场语言的基础模型。

agno.en: For developers building agents, Agno offers a lightweight multimodal framework with low instantiation and memory use.
agno.zh: 面向构建智能体的开发者，Agno 是轻量多模态框架，实例化和内存占用都较省。

sunshine.en: A self-hosted game stream host for Moonlight, letting you stream PC games to other devices.
sunshine.zh: 面向想把电脑游戏串流到其他设备的玩家，是 NVIDIA GameStream 的开源替代。

freellmapi.en: For developers testing LLM ideas, it pools 34 free providers and 635 model endpoints behind one /v1 endpoint with routing and failover.
freellmapi.zh: 面向做 LLM 实验的开发者，把 34 家免费提供商、635 个模型端点汇聚到一个 /v1 端点，并提供路由与故障转移。

puter.en: For users who need a free, open-source, self-hostable desktop in the browser, Puter includes file management, an app store, and a terminal.
puter.zh: 面向需要免费、开源、可自托管浏览器桌面的人，提供文件管理、应用商店和终端。

openhuman.en: For developers running many AI agents on small budgets: an open-source agent harness that runs 500+ agents on a $10 VPS.
openhuman.zh: 面向预算有限、需运行大量智能体的开发者：这个开源运行框架可在 10 美元 VPS 上跑 500 多个智能体。

openmaic.en: OpenMAIC gives learners a one-click, immersive multi-agent classroom experience.
openmaic.zh: OpenMAIC 为学习者提供一键开启的沉浸式多智能体课堂体验。

hallmark.en: A design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex users that helps avoid generic AI-style design output.
hallmark.zh: 为 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 用户提供设计技能，帮助避免 AI 套路化设计。

wshobson-agents.en: For developers using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other harnesses who want a shared marketplace of agentic plugins.
wshobson-agents.zh: 给使用 Claude Code 的开发者：提供插件与子智能体市场，装完即有几十个专精角色。

codewhale.en: Codewhale is an open-source terminal agent in Rust for developers who want to use any provider or model from the command line.
codewhale.zh: Codewhale 是用 Rust 编写的开源终端智能体，面向希望在命令行中使用任意提供商或模型的开发者。

appsmith.en: A platform for developers to build admin panels, internal tools, and dashboards, integrating with 25+ databases and any API.
appsmith.zh: 面向开发者的平台，用于搭建管理后台、内部工具和仪表盘，可连接 25 种以上数据库和任意 API。

openviking.en: OpenViking is a self-evolving context database for AI agent developers, unifying agent memory, knowledge RAG and skills.
openviking.zh: OpenViking 是面向 AI 智能体开发者的自演化上下文数据库，统一智能体记忆、知识 RAG 与技能。

outline.en: A markdown-compatible knowledge base for growing teams, offering realtime collaboration and full-text search.
outline.zh: 面向成长型团队的 Markdown 兼容知识库，支持实时协作与全文搜索。

awesome-cursorrules.en: A collection of rule files for Cursor users who want custom editor behavior.
awesome-cursorrules.zh: 面向 Cursor 用户的规则文件合集，用于自定义编辑器行为。

it-tools.en: For developers, IT-Tools offers a handy collection of online tools like encoding, hashing, UUID, and regex with great UX.
it-tools.zh: 面向开发者：IT-Tools 提供编码解码、哈希、UUID、正则等便捷在线工具，体验良好。

croc.en: A command-line tool for developers and IT staff who need to send files securely between two computers.
croc.zh: 面向开发者和运维人员的命令行工具，用于在两台电脑之间安全传输文件。

tooljet.en: Open-source foundation for teams that need to build internal tools, dashboards, business apps, workflows and AI agents visually or from a prompt.
tooljet.zh: 面向需要搭建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用、工作流和 AI 智能体的团队，可可视化构建或通过提示词生成。

awesome-copilot.en: A community collection of instructions, agents, skills, and configurations for developers who want to get more out of GitHub Copilot.
awesome-copilot.zh: 面向希望更充分利用 GitHub Copilot 的开发者，汇集社区贡献的指令、智能体、技能与配置。

posthog.en: PostHog gives developers analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, and error tracking to diagnose problems and ship fixes.
posthog.zh: PostHog 为开发者提供行为分析、会话回放、功能开关、实验与错误追踪，帮助定位问题并修复。

oh-my-claudecode.en: A multi-agent orchestration layer for Claude Code, built for teams that need to coordinate agents on shared work.
oh-my-claudecode.zh: 面向 Claude Code 的多智能体编排层，适合需要协作调度多个智能体的团队使用。

marker.en: For people who need PDFs as clean text, Marker converts them to Markdown and JSON quickly with high accuracy, keeping formulas and tables.
marker.zh: 给需要把 PDF 转成 Markdown 和 JSON 的人用，速度快、精度高，公式和表格都能保留。

sharex.en: A free open-source app for anyone who needs to capture or record screen areas with a single keystroke, then upload images, text, or files.
sharex.zh: 面向需要一键截屏或录屏，并把图片、文本、文件上传到多个目标的免费开源工具。

photoprism.en: A photo app for people with large photo libraries, using AI to organize images with automatic classification, face and place recognition.
photoprism.zh: 面向照片数量庞大的用户，借助 AI 自动分类并提供人脸和地点识别来整理照片。

newpipe.en: A libre lightweight streaming front-end for Android, letting users watch YouTube in the background, without ads, and download videos.
newpipe.zh: 一款开源轻量的安卓流媒体前端，让用户在安卓上后台播放、免广告观看视频并可下载。

voxcpm.en: VoxCPM2 is a tokenizer-free TTS model for developers who need multilingual speech generation, creative voice design, and realistic voice cloning.
voxcpm.zh: 无分词器 TTS，面向需要多语言语音生成、创意音色设计与逼真克隆的开发者。

drawdb.en: Developers who need to design database schemas can draw ER diagrams in the browser and export table creation SQL.
drawdb.zh: 需要设计数据库结构的开发者，可在浏览器里画关系图并导出建表 SQL。

novu.en: Novu is an open-source communication infrastructure for agents and products, helping teams manage email, SMS, push, and in-app notifications.
novu.zh: Novu 是面向智能体与产品的开源通信基础设施，帮助团队统一管理邮件、短信、推送和站内通知。

postiz.en: An agentic scheduling tool for social media teams that plan and publish posts across channels.
postiz.zh: 面向需要跨渠道规划并发布内容的社媒团队，提供排期与自动分发。

pageindex.en: PageIndex is a document index for builders of vectorless, reasoning-based RAG systems.
pageindex.zh: PageIndex 是面向无向量、基于推理的 RAG 构建者的文档索引。

prompt-optimizer.en: For people who write prompts, it helps improve prompt wording so AI gives better results.
prompt-optimizer.zh: 面向需要编写提示词的用户，帮助优化提示词表达，以获得更好的 AI 结果。

ui-tars-desktop.en: An open-source multimodal AI agent stack for developers who need to connect AI models with agent infrastructure.
ui-tars-desktop.zh: 面向需要连接 AI 模型与智能体基础设施的开发者，提供开源多模态 AI 智能体栈。

mattermost.en: Mattermost is an open source, self-hosted collaboration platform for development teams that need secure channels, file sharing, and bots.
mattermost.zh: 面向开发团队的自托管开源协作平台，提供安全频道、文件共享与机器人。

sing-box.en: For users needing one proxy core: sing-box is a universal proxy platform whose single core supports various protocols.
sing-box.zh: 面向需要统一代理内核的用户：sing-box 是通用代理平台，一个内核支持各种协议。

umami.en: For teams that want privacy-first web and product analytics, Umami brings traffic, campaigns, behavior, conversions, and revenue together without cookies or surveillance.
umami.zh: 面向重视隐私的团队，Umami 汇总流量、活动、行为、转化和收入，无需 Cookie。

lapce.en: Lapce is a code editor written in Rust for developers who want a lightweight editor with built-in LSP support and remote development.
lapce.zh: Lapce 是一款用 Rust 编写的代码编辑器，面向希望使用轻量编辑器并需要内置 LSP 与远程开发的开发者。

langextract.en: A Python library for developers to extract structured information from unstructured text using LLMs, with source grounding and interactive visualization.
langextract.zh: 面向开发者，用 LLM 从非结构化文本提取结构化信息，并提供精准溯源与交互式可视化。

project-nomad.en: For learners and educators without reliable internet, Project NOMAD runs Wikipedia, books, courses, maps, and optional local AI on owned hardware offline.
project-nomad.zh: 为无稳定网络者提供离线知识服务器，自有硬件上运行 Wikipedia、书籍与课程。

dspy.en: DSPy is a framework for developers who build LLM systems by programming rather than prompting.
dspy.zh: DSPy 是面向开发者的框架，用编程而不是调提示词来构建 LLM 系统。

prompt-eng-tutorial.en: An interactive course from Anthropic that teaches developers prompt engineering through nine chapters with hands-on exercises.
prompt-eng-tutorial.zh: 面向开发者，Anthropic 官方交互式课程，九章带练习，帮助学习提示工程。

sqlmap.en: sqlmap automates SQL injection detection and database takeover for penetration testers.
sqlmap.zh: sqlmap 面向渗透测试人员，自动检测并利用 SQL 注入漏洞，可接管数据库。

portainer.en: A graphical management panel for teams running Docker and Kubernetes who want a simpler way to handle containers.
portainer.zh: 面向使用 Docker 和 Kubernetes 的团队，用图形面板简化容器与集群的管理操作。

httpie.en: A command-line HTTP client for developers and API users, making HTTP requests easier to read and send with JSON support and colors.
httpie.zh: 面向开发者和 API 使用者的命令行 HTTP 客户端，借助 JSON 支持与色彩让请求的发送和阅读更轻松。

directus.en: A flexible backend for developers who want to turn an existing SQL database into a headless CMS, admin panel, or app with instant APIs and auth.
directus.zh: 面向需要把现有 SQL 数据库快速变成无头 CMS、管理后台或应用后端的开发者，提供即时 API 与认证。

playwright-mcp.en: An MCP server for Playwright, aimed at developers who want to use Playwright through an MCP server.
playwright-mcp.zh: 面向希望以 MCP 服务器方式使用 Playwright 的开发者。

trilium.en: Trilium is a hierarchical note tool for people building a personal knowledge base, where notes can be scripted for long-term accumulation.
trilium.zh: Trilium 是层级式笔记工具，适合长期积累个人知识库的用户，笔记之间可脚本化。

trivy.en: Trivy helps security and development teams find vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, and SBOM information across containers, Kubernetes, code repositories, and clouds.
trivy.zh: 面向安全与开发团队，帮助在容器镜像、代码仓库和依赖中查找已知漏洞。

chatwoot.en: Open-source omni-channel desk for support teams that need live chat and email in one place.
chatwoot.zh: 开源全渠道客服台，适合需要统一处理实时聊天与邮件的客服团队。

llmfit.en: For users choosing local AI models, Llmfit checks hundreds of models and providers with one command to find what runs on their hardware.
llmfit.zh: 面向挑选本地 AI 模型的用户，Llmfit 用一条命令检查数百个模型与提供商，找出你的硬件能运行哪些。

dokploy.en: Dokploy is an open source PaaS for teams that want to self-host deployments, certificates and backups with a modern interface.
dokploy.zh: Dokploy 是开源 PaaS，适合希望自托管部署、证书与备份并拥有现代界面的团队。

claude-code-router.en: A local control plane for developers using AI coding agents: it routes requests across models, composes new capabilities, and orchestrates tools in one place.
claude-code-router.zh: 面向使用 AI 编程智能体的开发者，提供本地控制平面：在一处跨模型路由请求、融合新能力并编排工具。

khoj.en: A self-hostable AI second brain for people who need answers from their own docs, web, or notes, with support for custom agents and local or online LLMs.
khoj.zh: 面向需要从自有文档、网页或笔记中获取答案的用户，可自托管，并支持自定义智能体与本地或在线大模型。

gfpgan.en: GFPGAN helps developers and photo editors restore blurred or old face images with a practical face restoration algorithm.
gfpgan.zh: GFPGAN 面向开发者和照片修复用户，用实用的人脸修复算法还原模糊或老照片中的人脸。

perplexica.en: For users who need verifiable answers, an open-source AI answering engine that returns results with cited sources.
perplexica.zh: 面向需要可核实答案的用户，开源 AI 问答引擎，给出带来源引用的回答。

ai-website-cloner-template.en: A template for developers who want to clone a website with one command, using AI coding agents.
ai-website-cloner-template.zh: 面向需要克隆网站的开发者的模板：借助 AI 编码智能体，一条命令即可完成。

nextcloud.en: For people who want to self-host their data, Nextcloud offers file sync plus calendar, online documents and video calls.
nextcloud.zh: 面向想自建存储的人，Nextcloud 把文件同步、日历、在线文档和视频通话放在一起。

real-esrgan.en: For developers and creators, Real-ESRGAN offers practical algorithms for general image and video restoration.
real-esrgan.zh: 面向开发者和创作者，Real-ESRGAN 提供通用的图像与视频修复算法。

ifixai.en: For teams and agents needing independent auditing, IFixAi checks whether an AI agent does what it should, in under 120 seconds.
ifixai.zh: iFixAi 供团队或智能体独立审计 AI 智能体是否在做该做的事，不到 120 秒给出答案。

adguardhome.en: A DNS server for home network users that blocks ads and trackers across all connected devices.
adguardhome.zh: 面向家庭网络用户的 DNS 服务器，为所有联网设备拦截广告和追踪。

skills-3.en: A tool for developers building agents: run npx skills to work with open agent skills.
skills-3.zh: 面向开发智能体的开发者：通过 npx skills 使用开放的智能体技能。

copilotkit.en: CopilotKit is a frontend stack for adding agents and generative UI to products, including sidebar assistants, in-app actions, and React, Angular, mobile, and Slack support.
copilotkit.zh: CopilotKit 帮产品团队为应用加入智能体前端：侧边栏助手、生成式 UI 与应用内动作调用。

linux-command.en: A searchable Linux command reference with manuals and explanations, for users who need quick lookups of 600+ commands.
linux-command.zh: 面向需要快速查阅 Linux 命令的用户，提供 600+ 命令的在线搜索与手册详解。

frigate.en: For IP camera owners who want a local NVR with realtime object detection, so people, vehicles, and animals are identified on their own hardware.
frigate.zh: 面向使用 IP 摄像头的人，提供本地运行的 NVR 与实时目标检测，在自有设备上识别人、车与动物。

vibe-trading.en: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent for users who want an AI agent to handle their trading tasks.
vibe-trading.zh: Vibe-Trading 是面向希望由 AI 智能体处理交易任务的用户的个人交易智能体。

oh-my-pi.en: Oh My Pi is a coding agent for developers, with the IDE wired in and built by Stencil Labs.
oh-my-pi.zh: Oh My Pi 是面向开发者的编码智能体，与 IDE 深度集成，由 Stencil Labs 打造。

heretic.en: Heretic is a tool for people working with language models who want to remove censorship restrictions from them automatically.
heretic.zh: Heretic 面向使用语言模型的人，用于全自动移除模型中的审查限制。

medusa.en: Open-source headless commerce backend for developers and agents building online stores.
medusa.zh: 面向开发者和 agent 的开源 headless 电商后端，用于搭建在线商店。

restic.en: Restic is a backup program for users who need fast, secure backups, using incremental encrypted backups with deduplication to any storage location.
restic.zh: Restic 是一款增量加密备份工具，适合需要快速安全备份的用户，去重效果好，可备份到任意存储位置。

qwenpaw.en: A personal AI assistant for users who want an installable assistant on their own machine or the cloud, connecting to multiple chat apps with extensible capabilities.
qwenpaw.zh: 一款个人 AI 助手，适合希望在自有机器或云端部署、并接入多种聊天应用且可扩展能力的用户。

langfuse.en: Langfuse is an open source platform for LLM application developers to trace, evaluate, and improve their applications.
langfuse.zh: Langfuse 是开源平台，帮 LLM 应用开发者追踪调用、评测效果并改进应用。

bitchat.en: A Bluetooth mesh chat tool for developers and users who want IRC-style group messaging without internet access.
bitchat.zh: 为想在无网络环境下进行 IRC 风格群聊的开发者与用户提供蓝牙 mesh 聊天。

buzz.en: Buzz is a hive mind communication platform for teams and groups that need shared, collective communication.
buzz.zh: Buzz 是一个蜂群思维通信平台，面向需要集体共享沟通的团队与群体。

nuwa-skill.en: Developers can use Nuwa Skill to distill anyone's mental models, decision heuristics and expression DNA into reusable thinking patterns.
nuwa-skill.zh: 开发者可用 Nuwa Skill 蒸馏任何人的心智模型、决策启发式与表达 DNA。

continue.en: A coding agent for developers who want AI help inside VS Code and JetBrains editors.
continue.zh: 面向希望在 VS Code 和 JetBrains 编辑器内获得 AI 编程辅助的开发者。

book-to-skill.en: For developers who study and reference technical books while coding, Book To Skill turns a technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill.
book-to-skill.zh: 面向边工作边查技术书的开发者：把技术书籍 PDF 转化为 Claude Code 技能，随时学习与查阅。

next-ai-draw-io.en: Lets users draw and edit draw.io diagrams through AI chat, delivered as a web app, desktop app, and MCP server for coding tools.
next-ai-draw-io.zh: 与 AI 对话即可绘制和编辑 draw.io 图表，提供 Web 应用、桌面应用和 MCP 服务器。

cyberchef.en: A browser-based tool for analysts and developers who need to encrypt, encode, compress or inspect data without writing scripts.
cyberchef.zh: 面向分析人员与开发者的浏览器工具，无需编写脚本即可完成加解密、编解码、压缩与数据分析。

deepseek-reasonix.en: For developers facing complex software engineering tasks, it provides a reliable coding agent.
deepseek-reasonix.zh: 面向需要处理复杂软件工程任务的开发者，提供可靠的编码智能体。

jq.en: For developers and shell users who need to parse and rewrite JSON directly on the command line.
jq.zh: 面向需要在命令行解析和改写 JSON 的开发者与脚本用户。

carbon.en: For developers who want to share code snippets, Carbon turns source code into beautiful images ready to post.
carbon.zh: 面向需要分享代码片段的开发者，把源代码转换成精美图片，方便发布。

filebrowser.en: File Browser gives users a web interface to upload, delete, preview, and edit files within a specified directory.
filebrowser.zh: File Browser 为用户提供网页界面，可在指定目录中上传、删除、预览和编辑文件。

refine.en: A React framework for developers building internal tools, admin panels, dashboards, and B2B apps without platform lock-in.
refine.zh: 帮开发者用 React 搭建内部工具、管理后台、仪表盘和 B2B 应用，避免平台锁定。

zellij.en: Zellij gives terminal users a workspace with saveable layouts, so developers can organize multiple sessions without extra setup.
zellij.zh: Zellij 为终端用户提供可保存布局的工作区，帮助开发者组织多个会话，开箱即用。

weknora.en: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform that turns raw documents into a queryable RAG, a reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki for teams.
weknora.zh: WeKnora 是开源 LLM 知识平台，帮团队把原始文档变成可查询 RAG、自主推理智能体和自维护 Wiki。

awesome-ai-research-writing.en: It helps AI researchers improve their papers and spend less time on tedious polishing.
awesome-ai-research-writing.zh: 它帮助 AI 研究人员提升论文写作质量，减少繁琐润色所耗的时间。

recordly.en: Recordly lets people without editing skills create polished demo videos, and it runs on Mac, Windows, and Linux.
recordly.zh: Recordly 让没有剪辑技能的人也能制作精美的演示视频，支持 Mac、Windows 和 Linux。

awesome-agent-skills.en: For developers building AI agents, it collects 1000+ agent skills from official teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor.
awesome-agent-skills.zh: 为智能体开发者汇集官方团队与社区的 1000+ 个技能，兼容多种开发工具。

changedetection.en: For people who need to track webpage updates, it alerts them when content changes, useful for price checks and restock monitoring.
changedetection.zh: 适合需要盯网页更新的人，内容一变就通知，可用于比价和补货提醒。

ocrmypdf.en: For people with scanned PDFs, OCRmyPDF adds a searchable text layer to these files.
ocrmypdf.zh: 面向持有扫描版 PDF 的人，OCRmyPDF 能给文件加上可搜索的文字层。

mihomo.en: For users who need rule-based traffic routing and subscription management, Mihomo is a maintained Clash kernel.
mihomo.zh: 面向需要规则分流与订阅管理的用户，Mihomo 是持续维护的 Clash 内核版本。

handy.en: Handy is a free, open source speech-to-text app for people who need offline dictation and extension.
handy.zh: Handy 是一款免费开源的语音转文字应用，适合需要离线输入并可按需扩展的用户。

diffusers.en: Diffusers is a PyTorch library for developers who need to run diffusion models for image, video, and audio generation.
diffusers.zh: Diffusers 是面向开发者的 PyTorch 库，用于运行扩散模型生成图像、视频和音频。

anthropic-cybersecurity-skills.en: A skills library for AI agent builders who need structured cybersecurity knowledge, with 817 skills mapped to six security frameworks.
anthropic-cybersecurity-skills.zh: 面向 AI 智能体开发者的技能库，提供 817 个结构化网络安全技能，并映射至 6 大安全框架。

codex-plugin-cc.en: A dev tool for Claude Code users who want to call Codex from within Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.
codex-plugin-cc.zh: 面向 Claude Code 用户，可在其中调用 Codex 审查代码或委派任务。

nginx-proxy-manager.en: A Docker container that gives self-hosters a web interface to manage Nginx proxy hosts.
nginx-proxy-manager.zh: 面向自建服务的用户，用网页界面管理 Nginx 代理主机，免去手写配置。

chatdev.en: ChatDev lets developers use multiple LLM agents to simulate a company and run the workflow from requirements to code.
chatdev.zh: ChatDev 用多智能体模拟公司，帮开发者自动完成从需求到代码的开发。

laya.en: For developers needing typed text decisions, Laya returns choice, score, and yes/no results in a single forward pass across 100+ languages.
laya.zh: 给需要文本决策的开发者：Laya 单次前向传播返回选择、评分与是/否结果，支持 100+ 语言。

awesome-gpt-image-2.en: For AI image creators, it offers a prompt and case library with 530+ examples and 20+ templates to reuse and compare prompts.
awesome-gpt-image-2.zh: 面向 AI 图像创作者，提供 530+ 案例与 20+ 套模板的提示词库，便于复用与对比。

fish-shell.en: For command-line users, Fish Shell is a user-friendly shell with autocompletion and syntax highlighting out of the box.
fish-shell.zh: 给命令行用户，开箱即带自动补全和语法高亮的友好 shell。

openclaude.en: Openclaude is an AI agent that runs in any environment and works with any model.
openclaude.zh: Openclaude 是可在任何地方运行、可使用任何模型的 AI 智能体，适合需要灵活部署的用户。

agents-course.en: For learners who want to study AI agents, this repository hosts the Hugging Face Agents Course materials.
agents-course.zh: 面向想学习 AI 智能体的学习者，本仓库提供 Hugging Face Agents Course 的课程内容。

pear.en: Pear is a music player extension for people who want to play music while using other tools.
pear.zh: Pear 是音乐播放器扩展，适合在使用其他工具时听音乐的用户。

github-mcp-server.en: GitHub's official MCP server, for AI agent developers who need to connect agents to GitHub via MCP.
github-mcp-server.zh: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器，面向需要通过 MCP 连接 GitHub 的 AI 代理开发者。

vscodium.en: VSCodium gives developers VS Code binaries without Microsoft branding, telemetry, or licensing.
vscodium.zh: VSCodium 为开发者提供去除微软品牌、遥测和许可限制的 VS Code 构建版本。

dsh-desktop.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin developers a modern desktop environment where everything, including the desktop, is a plugin.
dsh-desktop.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件开发者提供桌面端方案：万物皆插件，桌面本身也是插件。

x-algorithm.en: The algorithm that powers the For You feed on X, for developers looking into feed ranking.
x-algorithm.zh: 驱动 X「For You」信息流的算法，面向关注信息流排序的开发者。

knowledge-work-plugins.en: An open source repository of plugins for knowledge workers using Claude Cowork, offering ready-made extensions for their work.
knowledge-work-plugins.zh: 面向知识工作者的开源插件仓库，供在 Claude Cowork 中使用，提供现成插件扩展。

aionui.en: An open-source app for developers running CLI agents, with customizable assistants and team collaboration around the clock.
aionui.zh: 面向使用 CLI 智能体的开发者，这款开源应用支持自定义助手与组队协作，可全天候运行。

oh-my-codex.en: For developers using codex, OmX adds hooks, agent teams, HUDs, and more, so codex is not alone.
oh-my-codex.zh: 面向使用 codex 的开发者，OmX 可添加钩子、智能体团队、HUD 及更多功能，让 codex 不再孤单。

yesplaymusic.en: YesPlayMusic is a third-party NetEase Cloud Music desktop player for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
yesplaymusic.zh: YesPlayMusic 是一款适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的第三方网易云音乐播放器。

gpt-pilot.en: An AI development team for developers: one agent writes code while another reviews, debugs, and runs it.
gpt-pilot.zh: 面向开发者的 AI 开发团队：一个 agent 写代码，另一个负责审查、调试并边写边运行。

strata.en: Strata lets developers run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on consumer hardware via one-click Windows/Linux install, with local OpenAI/Anthropic APIs and optional image input.
strata.zh: 一键在消费级硬件运行 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，本地提供兼容 API。

agent-skills-2.en: A collection of agent skills from Vercel for developers building AI agents that need reusable task capabilities.
agent-skills-2.zh: Vercel 推出的智能体技能合集，面向需要可复用任务能力的 AI 智能体开发者。

claude-code-templates.en: A CLI tool for developers who use Claude Code, helping them configure and monitor it.
claude-code-templates.zh: 面向使用 Claude Code 的开发者，用于配置和监控 Claude Code 的 CLI 工具。

sharp.en: For Node.js developers who need to resize and convert JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and TIFF images in high-performance applications.
sharp.zh: 面向 Node.js 开发者，用于在应用中快速缩放和转换 JPEG、PNG、WebP、AVIF、TIFF 图像。

pentagi.en: A fully autonomous AI agent system for security teams that performs complex penetration testing tasks.
pentagi.zh: 面向安全团队的全自主 AI 智能体系统，用于执行复杂的渗透测试任务。

codexplusplus.en: A tool for CodexApp users that aims to make Codex and other AI agents easier and more comfortable to use.
codexplusplus.zh: 面向 CodexApp 用户的增强工具，旨在让 Codex 及其他 AI Agent 更易用、更舒适。

mcp-for-blender.en: A community plugin for Blender 3D users who want to control the software with an LLM of their choice.
mcp-for-blender.zh: 面向希望用自选 LLM 控制 Blender 3D 的用户，这是一款社区插件。

tradingagents-cn.en: A Chinese-enhanced TradingAgents framework built on multi-agent LLMs for Chinese financial trading, aimed at developers.
tradingagents-cn.zh: 面向开发者，基于多智能体 LLM 的中文金融交易框架，即 TradingAgents 中文增强版。

zeroclaw.en: Zeroclaw is small, autonomous AI assistant infrastructure for users who want to deploy on any OS or platform and swap components freely.
zeroclaw.zh: Zeroclaw 是轻量、自主的 AI 个人助手基础设施，面向希望在任意操作系统与平台部署并自由替换组件的用户。

cloakbrowser.en: A stealth Chromium for AI agent developers who need browser automation that passes bot detection tests, as a drop-in Playwright replacement.
cloakbrowser.zh: 面向 AI 智能体开发者，提供可通过机器人检测测试的隐身 Chromium，可直接替换 Playwright。

antigravity-manager.en: A tool for Antigravity users to manage accounts and switch between them with one click, built with Tauri v2 and React.
antigravity-manager.zh: 面向 Antigravity 用户的账号管理工具，支持一键无缝切换账号，基于 Tauri v2 与 React 构建。

code-review-graph.en: For developers using MCP or CLI AI coding tools, it builds a local code intelligence graph so tools read only what matters.
code-review-graph.zh: 面向使用 MCP 或 CLI 的 AI 编程工具用户，构建本地代码智能图谱，让工具只读取关键内容。

refined-github.en: A browser extension for GitHub users that simplifies the interface and adds useful features.
refined-github.zh: 面向 GitHub 用户的浏览器扩展，简化网页界面并增加实用功能。

devtoys.en: DevToys gives developers a single desktop app for everyday tasks like formatting, encoding, regex testing, hashing, and unit conversion.
devtoys.zh: DevToys 为开发者提供一个桌面应用，集中处理格式化、编解码、正则、哈希和单位换算等日常任务。

shizuku.en: For developers of normal apps: it lets apps call system APIs with adb or root privileges via a Java process started with app_process.
shizuku.zh: 面向普通应用开发者：无需 root，借助 adb 或 root 权限直接调用系统 API。

officecli.en: A free, open-source, single-binary Office suite for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without installing Office.
officecli.zh: 为 AI 智能体的免费开源 Office 套件，单一二进制，无需安装即可读写编辑文件。

k6.en: For developers and testers, k6 is a Go-based load testing tool that runs JavaScript scripts from the command line and fits into CI.
k6.zh: 面向开发和测试人员，k6 是可用 JS 编写压测脚本、在命令行运行、适合接入 CI 的负载测试工具。

nuclei.en: Nuclei is a fast, customizable vulnerability scanner built on a YAML-based DSL, used by security teams to find vulnerabilities in applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations.
nuclei.zh: Nuclei 是基于 YAML DSL 的可定制漏洞扫描器，供安全团队在应用、API、网络、DNS 和云配置中查找漏洞。

awesome-openclaw-usecases.en: For OpenClaw users who want practical ideas, this community collection shares use cases that make daily life easier.
awesome-openclaw-usecases.zh: 面向 OpenClaw 用户，这个社区合集收录了让日常生活更轻松的实用用例。

html2canvas.en: A JavaScript library for front-end developers who need to capture a web page element as an image.
html2canvas.zh: 面向前端开发者的 JavaScript 库，用于把网页元素截图成图片。

frontend-slides.en: For people who need web-based slide decks, this lets a coding agent's frontend skills build beautiful slides.
frontend-slides.zh: 面向需要在网页上做幻灯片的人，借助编程智能体的前端技能来创建精美幻灯片。

flameshot.en: Flameshot is a simple yet powerful cross-platform screenshot tool for users who need quick capture and annotation.
flameshot.zh: Flameshot 是轻量跨平台的截图标注工具，适合需要快速截图并标注的用户。

cli.en: A CLI for developers and AI agents that unifies Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat and Admin commands, built dynamically from Google Discovery Service.
cli.zh: 为开发者与 AI 智能体提供统一命令行，操作 Google Workspace 服务。

cua.en: For developers and researchers building computer-use agents, Cua provides open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks to scale training, evaluation, and data generation.
cua.zh: 面向 computer-use 智能体开发者，Cua 用开源驱动、跨系统沙箱和基准支持训练、评估与数据生成。

serena.en: Serena is an MCP toolkit that gives coding agents semantic retrieval and editing capabilities.
serena.zh: Serena 是面向编程智能体的 MCP 工具包，提供语义检索与编辑能力。

nanoclaw.en: Nanoclaw is a lightweight OpenClaw alternative for users who want container-based security, messaging app connections, memory, and scheduled jobs.
nanoclaw.zh: 面向需要容器隔离运行的开发者，Nanoclaw 是轻量的 OpenClaw 替代品，可连接多种消息应用。

opencli.en: For developers and AI agent users, OpenCLI turns any website into a CLI and lets agents use your logged-in browser.
opencli.zh: 面向开发者和 AI 智能体用户，OpenCLI 将任意网站变成 CLI，并让智能体使用你已登录的浏览器。

deepagents.en: A batteries-included agent harness for developers who want to run AI agents without building the scaffolding themselves.
deepagents.zh: 一个开箱即用的智能体运行框架，面向希望直接运行智能体、无需自行搭建基础框架的开发者。

qmd.en: A mini local CLI search engine for developers who need to search docs, knowledge bases, and meeting notes without leaving their machine.
qmd.zh: 面向需要在本地搜索文档、知识库和会议记录的开发者，提供完全本地运行的迷你命令行搜索引擎。

awesome-ai-agents.en: A curated list of autonomous AI agents for developers and researchers who need to find related projects without searching separately.
awesome-ai-agents.zh: 面向开发者和研究者的自主智能体清单，按类型分类，找同类项目省去逐个搜索。

vorssaint-utils.en: A free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit for users who want quick access to small utilities.
vorssaint-utils.zh: 面向希望快速调用小工具的 macOS 用户，提供免费开源的菜单栏工具包。

gitleaks.en: Gitleaks scans Git repositories for accidentally committed secrets and tokens, helping developers catch leaked credentials before they spread.
gitleaks.zh: Gitleaks 扫描 Git 仓库中误提交的密钥和令牌，帮助开发者在凭证泄露扩散前发现它们。

better-auth.en: An authentication framework for TypeScript developers, used to add authentication to applications.
better-auth.zh: 面向 TypeScript 开发者的认证框架，用于为应用添加认证功能。

openai-agents.en: For developers building multi-agent workflows, it offers an OpenAI-built SDK with handoffs, guardrails, and tracing included.
openai-agents.zh: 面向构建多智能体工作流的开发者，提供内置 handoff、护栏和追踪的 OpenAI 官方 SDK。

netbird.en: NetBird connects people, machines and AI agents across networks with an identity-based Zero Trust platform built on peer-to-peer WireGuard.
netbird.zh: NetBird 用基于身份的零信任平台，通过点对点 WireGuard 把人员、机器和 AI 代理跨网络安全连接起来。

gpt-researcher.en: For users who need deep research, it autonomously investigates any data and writes reports using any LLM provider.
gpt-researcher.zh: 面向需要深度调研的用户，它能自主上网查资料并写出带引用的报告。

seal.en: An Android video and audio downloader for users who want to save media, built on yt-dlp with a clean interface.
seal.zh: 面向想在安卓上保存音视频的用户，基于 yt-dlp，界面清爽。

jitsi-meet.en: For teams and developers who need quick video meetings, it offers no-signup rooms and can be embedded or self-hosted.
jitsi-meet.zh: 面向需要快速开会的团队和开发者，无需注册即可建房间，也可嵌入网页或自行部署。

infisical.en: Infisical is an open-source platform for teams to secure secrets, certificates, access, and AI agents.
infisical.zh: Infisical 是开源平台，帮团队安全管理密钥、证书、访问权限和 AI Agent。

smolagents.en: smolagents is a barebones HuggingFace library for developers who want agents that think in code.
smolagents.zh: smolagents 是 HuggingFace 的极简智能体库，智能体直接写 Python 代码作为动作。

picoclaw.en: A tiny, fast tool deployable anywhere that helps developers automate mundane tasks.
picoclaw.zh: 一款小巧、快速、可随处部署的工具，帮助开发者自动化日常琐事。

tencentdb-agent-memory.en: For teams using AI agents, it turns conversations, docs, and code into four governed, shared memory assets.
tencentdb-agent-memory.zh: 面向使用 AI 智能体的团队，将会话、文档和代码转化为四类可治理共享的记忆资产。

gbrain.en: A brain module for developers building OpenClaw or Hermes agents, offering Garry's opinionated defaults.
gbrain.zh: 面向构建 OpenClaw 或 Hermes 智能体的开发者，提供 Garry 有明确主张的默认配置。

video-use.en: A dev tool for developers who want to edit videos through coding agents instead of manual timeline work.
video-use.zh: 面向希望用编程智能体代替手动时间线操作来编辑视频的开发者。

sim.en: Sim is a collaborative workspace for builders who need to create, deploy, and monitor AI agents and workflows in one place.
sim.zh: Sim 是面向构建者的协作工作区，用于在同一处构建、部署和监控 AI 智能体与工作流。

plausible.en: A privacy-first, cookie-free web analytics tool for site owners who need lightweight traffic insights, self-hosted or in the cloud.
plausible.zh: 面向需要轻量流量洞察的站点所有者，提供隐私优先、无 Cookie 的网站分析，支持自托管或云端使用。

agentmemory.en: A persistent memory tool for AI coding agents, built on real-world benchmarks.
agentmemory.zh: 一款面向 AI 编程智能体的持久记忆工具，基于真实世界基准测试构建。

page-agent.en: A JavaScript in-page GUI agent for developers, letting them control web interfaces with natural language.
page-agent.zh: 面向开发者的 JavaScript 页面内 GUI 智能体，可用自然语言控制 Web 界面。

opendataloader-pdf.en: A PDF parser for developers who need AI-ready data, automating PDF accessibility with an open-source tool.
opendataloader-pdf.zh: 面向需要 AI 可用数据的开发者，这款开源 PDF 解析器可自动化实现 PDF 无障碍访问。

pixelle-video.en: An AI engine for creators who need short videos, automating the short video production workflow.
pixelle-video.zh: 面向需要短视频的创作者，AI 引擎自动完成短视频制作流程。

obscura.en: A headless browser for AI agents and web scraping, giving developers a way to load and fetch web pages.
obscura.zh: 面向 AI 智能体和网页抓取的无头浏览器，帮助开发者加载并获取网页内容。

unlimited-ocr.en: For developers, Unlimited OCR enables one-shot long-horizon parsing.
unlimited-ocr.zh: 面向开发者，Unlimited OCR 支持单次长程解析。

authelia.en: A single sign-on and multi-factor portal that gives self-hosted web apps a unified login for their users.
authelia.zh: 面向自建服务运营者的 SSO 与多因素认证门户，为用户的网页应用提供统一登录入口。

mastra.en: A TypeScript framework for developers building AI applications and agents, covering workflows, memory, evals, and deployment.
mastra.zh: 面向开发者的 TypeScript 智能体框架，涵盖工作流、记忆、评测与部署。

wezterm.en: A GPU-accelerated cross-platform terminal emulator and multiplexer for developers who need fast rendering and Lua-based configuration.
wezterm.zh: 面向需要快速渲染和 Lua 配置的开发者，提供 GPU 加速的跨平台终端与多路复用功能。

hyperfine.en: hyperfine is a command-line benchmarking tool for developers who need to measure and compare how fast two commands run.
hyperfine.zh: hyperfine 是命令行基准测试工具，帮开发者量化比较两条命令的运行快慢。

mindustry.en: For players who enjoy factory building and tower defense, it combines automation and real-time strategy on one map.
mindustry.zh: 适合喜欢工厂建造与塔防的玩家，把自动化生产与即时战略结合在一张地图上。

claude-hud.en: A Claude Code plugin for developers who want visibility into context usage, active tools, running agents, and todo progress.
claude-hud.zh: 一个面向开发者的 Claude Code 插件，帮助查看上下文用量、活动工具、运行中的智能体和待办进度。

crush.en: Crush offers agentic coding for all, aimed at developers who want an agent to help with coding tasks.
crush.zh: Crush 面向所有开发者，用智能体辅助完成编程任务。

guizang-ppt-skill.en: A skill for AI agents that helps users build polished HTML slide decks with magazine or Swiss layouts.
guizang-ppt-skill.zh: 为需要精美 HTML 幻灯片的用户提供 AI 智能体技能，涵盖杂志风与瑞士风版式。

wikijs.en: An open source Markdown wiki for teams that need detailed permissions and multilingual documentation.
wikijs.zh: 基于 Markdown 的开源维基系统，适合需要细致权限和多语言支持的团队。

semantic-kernel.en: A Microsoft SDK for developers who need to add LLM features into existing C# / Python / Java systems.
semantic-kernel.zh: 微软推出的 SDK，面向需要把大模型能力接入现有 C# / Python / Java 系统的开发者。

qwen-code.en: An open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, helping developers work on code without leaving the command line.
qwen-code.zh: 一个驻留在你终端中的开源 AI 编程智能体，帮助开发者在命令行中处理代码工作。

open-lovable.en: For developers who need a React version of an existing site, it clones and rebuilds any website as a modern React app in seconds.
open-lovable.zh: 面向需要把网站转为 React 应用的开发者，几秒内克隆并重建为现代 React 应用。

design-md.en: A format specification that gives coding agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.
design-md.zh: 面向编程智能体的格式规范，让智能体对设计系统获得持久且结构化的理解。

smsforwarder.en: SmsForwarder forwards Android SMS, calls, and app notifications to other channels by rules, for users who need remote access.
smsforwarder.zh: 把安卓手机的短信、来电和通知按规则转发到其他渠道，适合需要远程查看的用户。

cmux.en: Cmux is an open source macOS terminal for developers running AI coding agents, with vertical tabs and notifications for multitasking and organization.
cmux.zh: Cmux 是面向运行 AI 编程智能体的开发者的开源 macOS 终端，提供垂直标签页和通知，便于多任务处理与组织管理。

skills-4.en: A skills catalog for Codex users, offering a single place to find skills for Codex.
skills-4.zh: 面向 Codex 用户的技能目录，提供一个集中查看 Codex 技能的位置。

claude-code-game-studios.en: For game developers using Claude Code: it adds 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a coordination system modeled on real studio hierarchy.
claude-code-game-studios.zh: 为使用 Claude Code 的游戏开发者提供 49 个 AI 智能体、72 个工作流技能及复刻工作室层级的协作系统。

vibe-kanban.en: For developers using Claude Code, Codex or other coding agents, it helps you get more out of those agents.
vibe-kanban.zh: 面向使用 Claude Code、Codex 等编程智能体的开发者，帮助你把智能体的效能发挥得更多。

budibase.en: Teams can build internal tools, approval flows, AI agents and automations with a built-in database, model agnostic.
budibase.zh: 面向需要搭内部工具和审批流的团队，自带数据库和自动化，模型不限。

beads.en: Beads is a memory upgrade for your coding agent, aimed at developers who work with AI coding agents.
beads.zh: Beads 为编程智能体提供记忆升级，面向使用编程智能体的开发者。

nextauth.en: Authentication for the web, for developers building web apps who need to handle user sign-in.
nextauth.zh: 面向 Web 开发者的认证方案，帮助需要处理用户登录的 Web 应用。

claude-task-master.en: An AI-powered task-management system for developers using Cursor, Lovable, Windsurf, Roo, and other tools.
claude-task-master.zh: 面向使用 Cursor、Lovable、Windsurf、Roo 等工具的开发者，提供 AI 驱动的任务管理。

locust.en: Lets developers write scalable load tests in plain Python so they can check how services behave under heavy request volume.
locust.zh: 让开发者用 Python 编写可扩展的压测脚本，用来验证服务在高请求量下的表现。

gdevelop.en: A cross-platform 2D/3D game engine for anyone who wants to build games without writing code.
gdevelop.zh: 面向想制作游戏但不想写代码的人，提供跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎。

ungoogled-chromium.en: For users who want Chromium without Google services or telemetry, this build removes those integrations.
ungoogled-chromium.zh: 给想要 Chromium 但不要谷歌服务和遥测的用户：该构建移除了这些集成。

huly.en: Huly is an all-in-one workbench for teams to manage projects, chat, documents, and HR in one place.
huly.zh: Huly 是面向团队的一体化工作台，把项目管理、聊天、文档和 HR 集中在一处。

kilocode.en: Kilo is an all-in-one agentic engineering platform for developers who want to build, ship, and iterate faster with an open source coding agent.
kilocode.zh: Kilo 是一体化智能体工程平台，面向希望借助开源编程智能体更快构建、交付和迭代的开发者。

symphony.en: Symphony turns project work into isolated, autonomous implementation runs so teams manage work instead of supervising coding agents.
symphony.zh: Symphony 把项目工作转化为相互隔离的自主实现流程，让团队管理工作而非监督编程智能体。

dexter.en: Dexter is an autonomous agent for people doing deep financial research, helping them investigate financial questions with less manual work.
dexter.zh: Dexter 是面向深度金融研究人员的自主智能体，帮助他们减少手工操作地开展金融问题研究。

lazyvim.en: A ready-made Neovim configuration for people who want an IDE-like setup without building one from scratch.
lazyvim.zh: 给想省去配置的 Neovim 用户，提供装完即用的 IDE 式配置。

planning-with-files.en: Persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents and long-running tasks, with crash-proof Markdown plans and session recovery.
planning-with-files.zh: 面向 AI 编程智能体和长时间运行任务的持久化文件规划，提供防崩溃的 Markdown 计划与会话恢复。

grok-build.en: A coding agent harness and TUI for developers who want a fullscreen, mouse-interactive, extensible terminal workflow.
grok-build.zh: 面向需要在终端使用全屏、鼠标交互且可扩展的编码智能体的开发者。

agentic-seek.en: For users who want a local autonomous agent that thinks, browses the web, and codes without API keys or monthly fees.
agentic-seek.zh: 给想本地运行自主智能体、不用 API Key 和月费也能搜索和写代码的用户。

huashu-design.en: For agent users in Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor who want deliverable designs from one prompt: pages, prototypes, PPTX, animations.
huashu-design.zh: 面向 agent 用户：一句话拿回可交付的网页、App 原型、可编辑 PPTX、动画与信息图。

pm-skills.en: For product managers, it offers 100+ agentic skills, commands, and plugins covering discovery to growth.
pm-skills.zh: 面向产品经理，提供 100+ 个智能体技能、命令与插件，覆盖从发现到增长的全流程。

chatterbox.en: An open-source text-to-speech tool for developers who need speech synthesis in their projects.
chatterbox.zh: 面向需要语音合成的开发者，提供开源文本转语音能力。

dbx.en: Dbx is a 25 MB cross-platform database client for developers managing 100+ databases, with built-in AI, MCP Server, CLI, desktop and Docker.
dbx.zh: Dbx 是 25 MB 轻量跨平台数据库客户端，帮开发者管理 100+ 数据库。

floci.en: A lightweight, always-free AWS local emulator alternative for developers who need to run AWS services locally.
floci.zh: 为需要在本地运行 AWS 服务的开发者提供一个轻量、始终免费的本地模拟器替代方案。

aitoearn.en: AiToEarn is a dev-tools project whose stated aim is to use AI to earn, aimed at people exploring AI-based earning.
aitoearn.zh: AiToEarn 是一个 dev-tools 项目，主张用 AI 赚钱，面向想借助 AI 获得收益的人。

plfm-radar.en: An open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz PLFM phased array radar system for developers building radar projects.
plfm-radar.zh: 面向雷达开发者的开源、低成本 10.5 GHz PLFM 相控阵雷达系统。

wg-easy.en: wg-easy offers a web-based admin UI for running WireGuard VPN, letting users add devices by scanning a code.
wg-easy.zh: wg-easy 为运行 WireGuard VPN 的用户提供网页管理界面，扫码即可添加设备。

tvapp.en: For Android TV and TV box users, it gathers film, live, karaoke, tool and game APKs with download, updates and TVBox interface sources.
tvapp.zh: 面向电视盒子用户，整理影视、直播、K歌、工具、游戏等APK并提供下载、更新与TVBox接口源。

agentskills.en: Specification and documentation for Agent Skills, for developers who need to define and document agent skill formats.
agentskills.zh: 面向需要定义和记录智能体技能格式的开发者，提供 Agent Skills 的规范与文档。

focalboard.en: Focalboard is an open source, self-hosted tool for teams and individuals who need kanban boards and tables for project tracking.
focalboard.zh: Focalboard 是开源可自托管的工具，为团队和个人提供看板与表格，用于项目跟踪。

typesense.en: For developers building search experiences, Typesense is an open source, typo tolerant in-memory fuzzy search engine and an easier-to-use alternative to Elasticsearch.
typesense.zh: Typesense 是面向构建搜索体验开发者的开源容错内存模糊搜索引擎，也是更易用的 Elasticsearch 替代。

beszel.en: Lightweight server monitoring for administrators, with historical data, Docker stats, and alerts in a clean interface.
beszel.zh: 面向运维人员的轻量服务器监控工具，提供历史数据、Docker 统计和告警，界面清爽。

12-factor-agents.en: A set of twelve principles for developers building LLM-powered agents, helping them design software reliable enough for production customers.
12-factor-agents.zh: 面向构建 LLM 应用的开发者，提供十二条原则，帮助想清 agent 设计并做出可用于生产环境的软件。

open-autoglm.en: An open phone agent model and framework that aims to make AI phone capabilities available to everyone.
open-autoglm.zh: 一个开放的手机智能体模型与框架，旨在让人人都能用上 AI 手机。

a2a.en: A2A is an open protocol for developers to let opaque agentic applications communicate and interoperate with each other.
a2a.zh: A2A 是开放协议，面向开发者，用于让不透明的智能体应用之间通信与互操作。

hypit.en: Hypit is for creators who want to replicate viral videos: AI agents swap the face, script, and B-roll, then produce many variants in one command.
hypit.zh: Hypit 面向需要复刻爆款视频的创作者，用 AI 智能体完成换脸、换台词、换 B-roll，一条命令产出多个变体。

open-r1.en: For developers seeking a fully open reproduction of DeepSeek-R1.
open-r1.zh: 面向寻求 DeepSeek-R1 完全开源复现的开发者。

authentik.en: Authentik is an identity provider for teams that need to connect their applications and protocols to one authentication layer.
authentik.zh: Authentik 是面向需要把各类应用和协议接入统一认证层的团队的身份认证工具。

distilly.en: For teams building agents or bots, Distilly distills how people think into reusable Skills.
distilly.zh: 面向构建 Agent 或 Bot 的团队，Distilly 将他人的思维方式提炼为可复用的 Skills。

claude-subagents.en: For developers using Claude Code, this collection offers 100+ specialized subagents for many development use cases.
claude-subagents.zh: 面向使用 Claude Code 的开发者，提供 100 多个专用子智能体，覆盖多种开发场景。

zulip.en: Open-source team chat for teams that want focused, topic-organized asynchronous discussions.
zulip.zh: 面向团队的按话题组织的开源聊天工具，让异步讨论保持清晰不串题。

squoosh.en: For web developers and designers who need smaller images without uploading files, it compresses images using browser-based codecs.
squoosh.zh: 面向需要缩小图片体积的网页开发者和设计师，在浏览器内用编解码器压缩图片，无需上传文件。

spotdl.en: Lets Spotify users download playlists and songs with album art and metadata, matching audio from YouTube when available.
spotdl.zh: 为想离线保存 Spotify 歌单和歌曲的用户，下载音频并补全封面与元数据。

awesome-n8n-templates.en: A collection of 280+ ready-to-use n8n workflow templates for people automating email, chat, docs, and AI agent tasks.
awesome-n8n-templates.zh: 面向需要自动化邮件、聊天、文档与 AI 智能体任务的用户，提供 280+ 个即用型 n8n 工作流模板。

stagehand.en: An SDK for developers who need to extract data and interact with sites, writing actions in natural language while keeping Playwright control.
stagehand.zh: 面向需要在网页上提取数据并交互的开发者，用自然语言编写动作，同时保留 Playwright 的可控性。

simple-icons.en: Simple Icons gives developers and designers SVG icons for popular brands, solving the need for clean logo assets in docs and landing pages.
simple-icons.zh: Simple Icons 为开发者和设计师提供常见品牌的 SVG 图标，解决写文档和做落地页时缺少干净图标素材的问题。

llm-council.en: For users with difficult questions, LLM Council lets LLMs work together to answer them.
llm-council.zh: LLM Council 面向需要解答棘手问题的用户，通过协同合作来回答。

monica.en: Monica is a personal CRM for people who want to remember details about friends, family and business contacts.
monica.zh: Monica 是一款个人 CRM，适合希望记录朋友、家人和商务联系人往来细节的人使用。

open-seo.en: Open SEO is an open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs for teams that need keyword research and competitor analysis.
open-seo.zh: Open SEO 是 Semrush 与 Ahrefs 的开源替代，面向需要做关键词研究与竞品分析的团队。

watermarks-remover.en: A privacy-first app for people who own content and need to strip AI watermarks from it.
watermarks-remover.zh: 一款隐私优先的应用，适合拥有内容并需要去除其中 AI 水印的用户。

lucide.en: A community-made open-source icon toolkit for developers and designers who need consistent icons across frontend frameworks.
lucide.zh: 面向开发者和设计师的开源图标工具库，为多种前端框架提供风格统一的图标。

openlist.en: An AList fork for users seeking an alternative amid trust concerns around the original project.
openlist.zh: 面向因信任危机而寻求替代方案的用户，是 AList 的新分支。

activepieces.en: Open source Zapier alternative for teams that want self-hosted AI workflows and agents, with hundreds of integrations and MCP servers.
activepieces.zh: 开源 Zapier 替代，适合希望自托管 AI 与自动化流程的团队，提供数百个集成与 MCP 服务器。

letta.en: Letta is a platform for developers building stateful agents that keep advanced memory and can learn and self-improve over time.
letta.zh: Letta 是面向开发者的有状态智能体平台，让智能体保留记忆并随时间学习和自我改进。

rembg.en: A command-line tool for developers and designers that removes the background from portrait and product images in one step.
rembg.zh: 面向开发者和设计师的命令行工具，一步就能去掉人像和商品图的背景。

editor.en: A 3D architectural editor for designers and AI agents, with a local CLI and MCP tools for practical workflows.
editor.zh: 面向设计师和 AI 智能体的 3D 建筑编辑器，提供本地 CLI 与 MCP 工具支持实用工作流。

agents-md.en: A simple, open format for developers to guide coding agents with project instructions.
agents-md.zh: 一种简单开放格式，供开发者用项目说明指导编码智能体。

gallery.en: A gallery for developers and enthusiasts to explore and try on-device ML and GenAI use cases locally.
gallery.zh: 面向开发者和爱好者的展示库，可在本地浏览并试用端侧 ML 与 GenAI 应用案例。

firefly-iii.en: For individuals managing their own money, Firefly III is a personal finances manager.
firefly-iii.zh: 面向需要管理个人财务的用户，Firefly III 是一款个人财务与记账管理工具。

dub.en: A link attribution platform for marketing and engineering teams that need click analytics, conversion tracking, and link-based traffic routing.
dub.zh: 面向市场和工程团队的链接归因平台，提供点击分析、转化追踪和按链接分流。

nextai-translator.en: For readers and writers who need quick translations, this extension and desktop app translate selected text via ChatGPT API with bilingual display.
nextai-translator.zh: 面向需要读外文的用户，提供划词翻译扩展与桌面版，经 ChatGPT 等接口翻译，支持双语对照。

magpie.en: A menu bar tool that lets you run Codex on DeepSeek and Claude Code on Kimi in one place.
magpie.zh: 菜单栏工具，让 Codex 用 DeepSeek、Claude Code 用 Kimi，模型集中在一处管理。

handbrake.en: For anyone with large video files, HandBrake transcodes and shrinks footage while keeping picture quality, with GPU acceleration.
handbrake.zh: 面向处理大体积视频素材的人：转码压缩并保持画质，支持 GPU 加速。

index-tts.en: Index TTS is an industrial-level controllable zero-shot text-to-speech system for developers who need efficient speech synthesis.
index-tts.zh: Index TTS 是面向开发者的工业级可控、高效零样本文本转语音系统，用于语音合成。

nocobase.en: NocoBase is an open-source AI and no-code platform for teams that need to build business systems fast, working on top of proven infrastructure and a WYSIWYG interface.
nocobase.zh: NocoBase 是开源 AI 无代码平台，面向需要快速搭建业务系统的团队，在成熟基础设施和所见即所得界面上构建。

dockge.en: A self-hosted web manager for Docker Compose users to view logs and edit stack configuration.
dockge.zh: 面向 Docker Compose 用户的自托管网页管理工具，可查看日志并修改栈配置。

fhevm.en: FHEVM is a full-stack framework for developers who want to integrate fully homomorphic encryption into blockchain applications.
fhevm.zh: FHEVM 是一个全栈框架，帮助开发者将全同态加密集成到区块链应用中。

tinyrenderer.en: A short course for learners who want to understand rendering by writing a software renderer from scratch.
tinyrenderer.zh: 面向想通过动手写软件渲染器来理解图形学原理的学习者的简短课程。

tasmota.en: For ESP8266/ESP32 device owners wanting local control: alternative firmware with webUI configuration, OTA updates, timers, rules, and MQTT, HTTP, Serial or KNX support.
tasmota.zh: 给 ESP 设备用户：可本地控制的替代固件，支持网页配置、OTA 升级与定时规则。

navidrome.en: For people who want to stream their own music, Navidrome is a self-hosted personal streaming service that works with Subsonic-compatible clients.
navidrome.zh: 面向想自建音乐流媒体的人，Navidrome 兼容 Subsonic 协议的客户端，可用于连接自己的音乐服务。

openlogi.en: For Logitech mouse users who want local control: OpenLogi remaps buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++, with no account or telemetry.
openlogi.zh: 罗技鼠标用户的本地替代：重映射按键、DPI 与 SmartShift，无需账号、无遥测。

happy.en: For developers already paying for Claude, Codex or Grok: orchestrate these agents in one open-source MIT app.
happy.zh: 面向已付费订阅 Claude、Codex 或 Grok 的开发者，用一个开源（MIT）应用统一编排这些智能体。

rag-anything.en: For developers building retrieval-augmented generation applications, RAG-Anything offers an all-in-one framework.
rag-anything.zh: 面向构建检索增强生成应用的开发者，RAG-Anything 提供一体化框架。

p5js.en: A client-side JavaScript platform for artists, designers, students, and beginners to learn to code and express themselves creatively on the web.
p5js.zh: 面向艺术家、设计师、学生和初学者的浏览器端 JavaScript 平台，用于学习编程并在网页上进行创意表达。

bongocat.en: A cross-platform interactive desktop pet that gives users who want light entertainment a playful cat companion on their screen.
bongocat.zh: 给想在桌面找乐子的用户：这只跨平台互动宠物猫会跟着你敲键盘，纯娱乐治愈。

openwork.en: An open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, powered by opencode, for users who want an open-source option.
openwork.zh: 面向需要开源方案的用户，Openwork 是 Claude Cowork 的开源替代品，由 opencode 驱动。

krayin.en: Krayin CRM is a free, open source CRM built with Laravel for managing customers, leads, and sales.
krayin.zh: Krayin CRM 是基于 Laravel 的免费开源 CRM，用于管理客户、线索和销售。

ds4.en: For developers who run DeepSeek 4 Flash and PRO locally on Metal, CUDA or ROCm hardware instead of remote servers.
ds4.zh: 给需要在 Metal、CUDA 或 ROCm 硬件上本地运行 DeepSeek 4 Flash 与 PRO 的开发者。

deepseek-ocr.en: For developers, DeepSeek OCR addresses optical compression of contexts.
deepseek-ocr.zh: 面向开发者，DeepSeek OCR 处理上下文的光学压缩。

cap.en: An open source Loom alternative for teams and creators who need screen recordings they can share by link.
cap.zh: 开源版 Loom，适合需要录制屏幕并通过链接分享的团队和创作者。

deepinfer.en: DeepInfer is a high-performance, large-scale inference framework for developers running DeepSeek models.
deepinfer.zh: DeepInfer 是面向 DeepSeek 模型的高性能、大规模推理框架，供开发者运行模型推理。

listmonk.en: Listmonk is a self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager for teams that need to run their own email lists from a single binary.
listmonk.zh: Listmonk 是自托管的邮件列表与 Newsletter 管理工具，适合需要以单二进制自行管理邮件列表的团队。

superclaude-framework.en: A configuration framework for Claude Code users, adding specialized commands, cognitive personas, and development methodologies.
superclaude-framework.zh: 面向 Claude Code 用户的配置框架，提供专用命令、认知角色和开发方法论。

heroicons.en: A free MIT-licensed SVG icon set for UI developers who need ready-to-use interface icons.
heroicons.zh: 面向 UI 开发者的免费 MIT 许可 SVG 图标集，两套风格，可直接复制 SVG 使用。

text-to-cad.en: For AI agent builders who want to add CAD abilities, it lets agents help users design physical products with AI.
text-to-cad.zh: 面向需要为智能体加入 CAD 能力的开发者，让智能体用 AI 帮助用户设计实体产品。

anubis.en: For site operators, Anubis weighs incoming HTTP requests to stop AI crawlers.
anubis.zh: Anubis 面向站点运营者，称量传入的 HTTP 请求以阻止 AI 爬虫。

jev-ultrafast.en: A fast, low-cost web agent for developers who need to automate web tasks.
jev-ultrafast.zh: 面向需要自动化网页任务的开发者，提供快速、低成本的网络智能体。

neofetch.en: A command-line tool for users who want to display system information alongside ASCII art logos in the terminal.
neofetch.zh: 一款命令行工具，适合希望在终端展示系统信息与 ASCII 艺术 Logo 的用户。

archon.en: An open-source harness builder for developers who use AI coding, helping make AI-generated code deterministic and repeatable.
archon.zh: 面向使用 AI 编码的开发者，开源执行框架构建器帮助让 AI 编码变得确定且可重复。

saleor.en: For developers building online stores who need a high performance, composable, headless commerce API built on GraphQL.
saleor.zh: 面向搭建在线商店的开发者，提供基于 GraphQL 的高性能、可组合 headless 电商 API。

iopaint.en: A local AI image inpainting tool that lets you remove unwanted objects, defects, or people from photos, and erase or replace items via Stable Diffusion.
iopaint.zh: 一款本地运行的 AI 图片修复工具，可涂抹去除照片中的杂物、瑕疵、人物，并支持擦除或替换画面内容。

brave-browser.en: Brave is a Chromium-based browser for Android, iOS, Linux, macOS and Windows, with ad blocking, rewards and a Tor window.
brave-browser.zh: 面向桌面与移动端的 Chromium 分支，内置广告拦截、奖励和 Tor 窗口。

skyvern.en: Skyvern helps teams automate browser-based workflows with AI, so routine web tasks keep working even when sites change.
skyvern.zh: Skyvern 面向需要自动化网页流程的团队，用 AI 驱动浏览器完成任务，网站改版也不容易失效。

winboat.en: Winboat lets Linux users run Windows apps with seamless integration.
winboat.zh: Winboat 让 Linux 用户运行 Windows 应用，并获得无缝集成体验。

exercises-dataset.en: For fitness app developers, this dataset supplies 1,324 exercises with GIFs, thumbnails, muscle and equipment data, and 6-language instructions.
exercises-dataset.zh: 面向应用开发者，提供 1,324 个动作的 GIF、缩略图、肌群器械数据与 6 语言说明。

claude-seo.en: An SEO skill for Claude Code users, with 26 sub-skills and 19 sub-agents covering technical SEO, schema, GEO/AEO, backlinks and reporting.
claude-seo.zh: Claude Code 的 SEO 技能：26 个子技能、19 个子代理，覆盖技术 SEO、外链与报表。

super-productivity.en: An advanced todo list app for users who need timeboxing, time tracking, and Jira, GitLab, GitHub or Open Project integrations.
super-productivity.zh: 面向需要待办、时间盒和时间追踪，并集成 Jira、GitLab、GitHub 或 Open Project 的用户。

claude-code-2.en: A runnable, buildable, debuggable Claude Code for developers, with production-grade engineering, enterprise reliability, safe non-toxic use, and fixed memory leaks.
claude-code-2.zh: 面向开发者，提供可运行、可构建、可调试的 Claude Code；生产级工程化、企业级可靠性、安全无毒，已修复内存泄露。

chartdb.en: Lets developers and database designers turn a single CREATE query into an ER diagram, so they can visualize schema without connecting to a database.
chartdb.zh: 让开发者和数据库设计者贴一条建表语句就生成 ER 图，不连数据库也能可视化表结构。

codexbar.en: For developers tracking their OpenAI Codex and Claude Code usage, it shows usage stats without requiring a login.
codexbar.zh: 面向需要了解 OpenAI Codex 和 Claude Code 用量的开发者，无需登录即可查看使用统计。

ai-trader.en: AI-Trader provides fully automated, agent-native trading for those building automated trading agents.
ai-trader.zh: AI-Trader 为构建自动化交易智能体的用户提供全自动、智能体原生的交易能力。

singlefile.en: SingleFile is a web extension for anyone who needs to keep a faithful copy of a complete web page, saving it as a single HTML file.
singlefile.zh: SingleFile 是浏览器扩展，适合需要保存完整网页副本的用户，把整页存成单个 HTML 文件。

obsidian-releases.en: For Obsidian users, this repository lists community plugins and themes and tracks releases.
obsidian-releases.zh: 面向 Obsidian 用户，提供社区插件与主题列表，并跟踪版本发布。

cat-catch.en: A browser extension that helps users find video and audio resources on web pages, with m3u8 segment merging for saving web videos locally.
cat-catch.zh: 一款浏览器扩展，帮助用户嗅探网页中的视频音频资源，支持 m3u8 分片合并下载，把网页视频保存到本地。

libretv.en: For people who want a quick video site, LibreTV deploys in a minute via Docker and other methods.
libretv.zh: 面向想快速搭建影视站的人，LibreTV 支持 Docker 等多种部署方式，一分钟即可完成。

witr.en: For developers and admins tracing processes, ports, containers, or files back to what started them, via CLI and TUI.
witr.zh: 面向排查进程、端口、容器或文件启动源头的开发者与运维人员，提供 CLI 与 TUI。

prime-agent.en: Prime Agent is a self-improving RLM agent for developers, built for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks.
prime-agent.zh: Prime Agent 是可自我改进的 RLM 智能体，面向开发者，用于编码工作流和长时间运行的自主任务。

tabler-icons.en: Developers building web projects get over 6200 free MIT-licensed SVG icons to use in their interfaces.
tabler-icons.zh: 为开发网页项目的设计师和开发者提供五千多个免费 SVG 图标，解决界面缺少成套图标的问题。

paseo.en: Paseo lets developers orchestrate multiple coding agents from desktop and mobile, so they can coordinate agent work across devices.
paseo.zh: Paseo 让开发者从桌面端和移动端编排多个编程智能体，便于在不同设备上协调智能体工作。

nemoclaw.en: Lets developers run agents like Hermes, LangChain Deep Agents, and OpenClaw more securely inside NVIDIA OpenShell with managed inference.
nemoclaw.zh: 帮开发者在 NVIDIA OpenShell 中更安全地运行智能体，并使用托管推理。

opcode.en: A GUI app and toolkit for Claude Code users to create custom agents, manage interactive sessions, and run secure background agents.
opcode.zh: 面向 Claude Code 用户的 GUI 应用与工具包，可创建自定义智能体、管理交互式会话并运行安全的后台智能体。

phpmailer.en: PHP developers can use PHPMailer, a classic library for sending email from their applications.
phpmailer.zh: PHP 开发者可用 PHPMailer 这个经典库，在应用中发送邮件。

helium.en: Helium is a web browser for users who want private, fast and honest browsing.
helium.zh: Helium 是一款网页浏览器，面向希望获得私密、快速、诚实浏览体验的用户。

learn-harness-engineering.en: A beginner tutorial for newcomers who want to learn harness engineering from zero to one.
learn-harness-engineering.zh: 面向零基础学习者的 harness engineering 入门教程，帮助从 0 到 1 起步。

dyad.en: A local, open-source AI app builder for power users who want to create apps without relying on hosted alternatives.
dyad.zh: 面向高级用户的本地开源 AI 应用构建器，帮助用户无需依赖托管替代方案即可创建应用。

docmost.en: For teams needing a collaborative wiki, Docmost offers open-source documentation with real-time co-editing.
docmost.zh: 适合需要协作知识库的团队，提供开源文档与实时共同编辑。

adk-python.en: A code-first Python toolkit for developers who need to build, evaluate, and deploy AI agents with flexibility and control.
adk-python.zh: 面向开发者的代码优先 Python 工具包，用于灵活构建、评估和部署 AI 智能体。

ralph.en: For developers working from PRD checklists, Ralph is an autonomous AI agent loop that runs until all items are complete.
ralph.zh: 面向按 PRD 清单开发的团队，Ralph 是自主 AI 智能体循环，反复运行直到所有条目完成。

teable.en: Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business teams that need to work with large datasets, handling millions of rows without lag.
teable.zh: Teable 是面向业务团队的数据库形态表格协作工具，可处理百万行数据而不卡顿。

agents-towards-production.en: A code-first tutorial collection for developers who need to move GenAI agents from prototype to enterprise deployment.
agents-towards-production.zh: 面向开发者的代码优先教程集合，帮助把 GenAI 智能体从原型推进到企业部署。

anatomy.en: An agent skill for developers to create detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of machines and complex systems, generating polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders.
anatomy.zh: 面向开发者，用于创建机器与复杂系统的精细交互式等轴插画，生成精良 SVG，可选 WebGL 与 3D 效果。

coze-studio.en: A visual platform for developers building AI agents, covering creation, debugging, and deployment in one toolset.
coze-studio.zh: 面向智能体开发者的可视化平台，在一套工具中完成智能体的创建、调试与部署。

matomo.en: Self-hosted open-source web and app analytics for teams that want full control of their data and built-in privacy.
matomo.zh: 自托管网站与应用分析工具，帮团队掌控数据、内置隐私保护，可采集、可视化并分析数据。

ai-guide.en: For AI beginners and developers, it gathers tutorials, tools, and news to help you learn AI faster.
ai-guide.zh: 面向 AI 初学者和开发者，汇总教程、工具与资讯，帮你快速上手 AI 技术。

automa.en: Automa is a browser extension for people who want to automate browser tasks by connecting blocks for form filling, data scraping, and scheduled runs.
automa.zh: Automa 是一款浏览器扩展，适合想用拖拽积木块拼出自动化流程的人，可完成填表、抓数据和定时任务。

moli.en: Moli is a lightweight headless browser built in Rust for AI agents that need fast, compatible page access.
moli.zh: Moli 是用 Rust 构建的轻量无头浏览器，面向需要快速、兼容访问网页的 AI 智能体。

skills-5.en: Skills offers developers agent skills for Google products and technologies, so agents can handle tasks on Google's stack.
skills-5.zh: Skills 为开发者提供适用于 Google 产品与技术的 Agent Skills，便于智能体处理相关任务。

dnshe-freedomains.en: DNSHE gives developers free subdomains with Anycast DNS, a REST API, and free renewal within 180 days before expiry.
dnshe-freedomains.zh: DNSHE 为开发者提供免费子域名，支持 Anycast DNS、REST API，并可在到期前 180 天内免费续期。

humanizer-zh.en: For Chinese-speaking Claude Code users who need to remove AI-generated traces from their text.
humanizer-zh.zh: 面向使用 Claude Code 的中文写作者，用于消除文本中的 AI 生成痕迹。

sonic.en: A schema-less search backend for developers who need lightweight full-text search with low RAM use.
sonic.zh: 面向需要低内存全文搜索的开发者，提供无 schema 的轻量搜索后端。

agency-agents-zh.en: For developers and teams using AI coding tools: 277 plug-in expert roles across 20 tools and 20 departments.
agency-agents-zh.zh: 面向 AI 工具开发者：277 个即插即用专家角色，覆盖 20 种工具、20 个部门。

jcode.en: A Rust-based coding agent harness for developers running heavy multi-agent workflows.
jcode.zh: 面向运行重度多智能体开发工作流的开发者，用 Rust 编写的高性能编程智能体运行框架。

wekan.en: Wekan is a FLOSS kanban tool built with Meteor, for teams that need a free board to track their workflow.
wekan.zh: Wekan 是用 Meteor 构建的开源看板工具，适合需要免费看板管理流程的团队。

obtainium.en: Lets Android users install app updates directly from GitHub releases, bypassing app stores for apps they sideload.
obtainium.zh: 面向从 GitHub 侧载安卓应用的用户，直接从发布页获取更新，绕开应用商店。

llm-wiki.en: For people who need to organize and consult their own documents, LLM Wiki automatically builds a persistent, interlinked knowledge base instead of retrieving from scratch.
llm-wiki.zh: 面向需要整理和查阅自有文档的用户，LLM Wiki 自动把资料建成持久、互相关联的知识库。

pydantic-ai.en: A Python framework for developers building AI agents with typed, end-to-end support across models, interfaces, realtime voice, image generation, and embeddings.
pydantic-ai.zh: 面向 Python 开发者的智能体框架，提供端到端类型化支持，覆盖多种模型、接口、实时语音、图像生成与嵌入。

dark-reader.en: Dark Reader is a Chrome and Firefox extension that gives websites a dark theme, with per-site brightness, contrast and grayscale controls for night reading.
dark-reader.zh: Dark Reader 为夜间浏览网页提供深色主题，可逐站调亮度、对比度和灰度。

swe-agent.en: SWE-agent helps developers automatically fix GitHub issues with a language model of their choice.
swe-agent.zh: SWE-agent 面向需要处理 GitHub issue 的开发者，用自选语言模型自动尝试修复。

qmk.en: Open-source firmware for Atmel AVR and Arm USB keyboards, letting users customize keymaps, macros, and layers.
qmk.zh: 开源键盘固件，面向 Atmel AVR 与 Arm USB 键盘用户，可自定义键位、宏和分层。

openstock.en: OpenStock is an open-source, free market platform for people who need real-time prices, personal alerts, and company insights without costly subscriptions.
openstock.zh: OpenStock 是开源免费行情平台，适合追踪实时价格、设置提醒、查看公司洞察且不愿支付昂贵订阅费的用户。

gallery-dl.en: A command-line tool for developers and archivists to download image galleries and collections from several image hosting sites in batches.
gallery-dl.zh: 面向开发者和归档人员的命令行工具，用于从多个图床站点批量下载图集与收藏。

casbin.en: Casbin is an authorization library for developers who need to enforce ACL, RBAC, or ABAC access control models.
casbin.zh: Casbin 是面向开发者的权限控制库，用于实现 ACL、RBAC、ABAC 等访问控制模型。

suna.en: Suna is an open-source AI operating system for users who need one assistant to handle browser actions, files, and data analysis.
suna.zh: Suna 是面向需要统一处理浏览器操作、文件处理与数据分析的用户的通用 AI 助手平台。

gpt-oss.en: OpenAI releases two open-weight language models for developers who need local control.
gpt-oss.zh: OpenAI 发布两个开放权重语言模型，供需要本地控制的开发者使用。

owl.en: OWL is a multi-agent framework for developers who need automated assistance with real-world tasks, including browser use and tool calls.
owl.zh: OWL 是一个多智能体协作框架，面向需要自动化处理真实世界任务的开发者，支持浏览器操作和工具调用。

lively.en: Lively Wallpaper lets Windows users set videos, web pages, or games as animated desktop wallpapers and screensavers for free.
lively.zh: Lively Wallpaper 让 Windows 用户把视频、网页或游戏设为动态桌面壁纸和屏保。

daily-dev.en: daily.dev is a personalized developer news feed for developers who want tech content from across the web in a browser new tab or on mobile.
daily-dev.zh: daily.dev 是面向开发者的个性化资讯流，在浏览器新标签页或手机上聚合各站技术内容。

khazix-skills.en: An open-source AI Skills collection for Claude Code, Codex and 40+ agents, covering goal definition, analysis and writing.
khazix-skills.zh: 开源 AI Skills 合集，帮 Claude Code 等智能体用户定义目标与写作。

agent-zero.en: Agent Zero is an AI framework for developers who need a general autonomous agent that writes code, operates the terminal, and calls its own tools to complete goals.
agent-zero.zh: Agent Zero 是面向开发者的 AI 框架，提供能编写代码、操作终端并自行调用工具完成目标的通用自主智能体。

motion-canvas.en: Motion Canvas helps people making technical explainer and demo videos visualize their ideas with code.
motion-canvas.zh: 面向制作技术讲解与演示视频的人，用代码把想法画成动画。

radix-ui.en: Radix Primitives is an open-source UI component library for developers building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps.
radix-ui.zh: Radix Primitives 是开源 UI 组件库，帮助开发者构建高质量、可访问的设计系统与 Web 应用。

profile-summary.en: Helps developers visualize a GitHub user's languages, repositories and contributions in one profile summary.
profile-summary.zh: 为想了解GitHub用户的开发者提供语言、仓库和贡献的可视化分析。

docker-mailserver.en: For teams that need a self-hosted mail server, docker-mailserver provides a production-ready fullstack mail server running in a container.
docker-mailserver.zh: 面向需要自建邮件服务器的团队，提供容器内运行的生产可用全栈邮件服务器。

moonlight.en: A GameStream client for PCs that lets you stream games to other devices and play with a controller.
moonlight.zh: 一款配 Sunshine 使用的串流客户端，让玩家在沙发上用手柄玩 PC 游戏。

wled.en: Lets ESP32 owners control WS2812B and other digital RGB LEDs over WiFi.
wled.zh: 让 ESP32 用户通过 WiFi 控制 WS2812B 等数字 RGB 灯带。

lichess.en: For chess players who want a free, adless server to play and study games online.
lichess.zh: 面向想免费下棋和复盘的国际象棋玩家，提供无广告的开源对弈平台。

nuclear.en: A streaming music player for listeners who want free music found and aggregated from online sources.
nuclear.zh: 面向想免费听歌的用户，自动从网络聚合音乐资源的流媒体播放器。

abdm.en: A free, open-source download manager for users who want faster multi-threaded downloads without paid software.
abdm.zh: 面向需要更快多线程下载、又不想付费的用户，提供免费开源的下载管理工具。

screenity.en: A free, privacy-friendly browser screen recorder for anyone who needs unlimited recording with on-screen annotation, no cloud uploads.
screenity.zh: 给需要录屏的人：浏览器直接录制，可边录边标注、裁剪导出，不限时长也不上传云端。

calibre-web.en: For Calibre users, Calibre-Web adds a web interface to browse, read and download the eBooks in their library.
calibre-web.zh: 给 Calibre 用户一个网页界面，用来浏览、在线阅读和下载书库里的电子书。

pyxel.en: Pyxel is a retro game engine for Python that lets people write pixel-style games directly in the browser.
pyxel.zh: Pyxel 是复古像素风游戏引擎，让想用 Python 做游戏的人在浏览器里直接编写游戏。

immersive-translate.en: For people reading foreign-language web pages, PDFs, Epubs, subtitles, or TXT files, it offers bilingual translation and supports custom translation interfaces.
immersive-translate.zh: 为需要双语对照阅读外语网页、PDF、Epub、字幕和TXT文件的用户提供翻译。

imagemagick.en: A free, open-source suite for developers and scripters who need to create, edit, convert, and display images in 200+ formats via command-line tools and APIs.
imagemagick.zh: 面向开发者和脚本用户的开源图像处理套件，用命令行工具和 API 创建、编辑、转换和显示 200 多种格式的图片。

bookstack.en: BookStack helps teams writing internal manuals organize documents into books, chapters, and pages; it is now managed on Codeberg.
bookstack.zh: BookStack 面向写内部手册的团队，把文档按书、章、页组织，现托管于 Codeberg。

codeformer.en: CodeFormer is a blind face restoration tool from NeurIPS 2022, using a codebook lookup transformer for users restoring degraded portraits.
codeformer.zh: CodeFormer 是 NeurIPS 2022 提出的人脸修复工具，基于码本查找变换器，适合需要修复退化人像的用户。

semgrep.en: Semgrep is a lightweight static analysis tool for developers and security teams. It finds bug variants across many languages using patterns that look like source code.
semgrep.zh: Semgrep 是面向开发者和安全团队的轻量级静态分析工具，用接近源码的语义模式在多种语言中查找缺陷变体。

koel.en: A music streaming solution for people who want to stream their own music library through a modern interface.
koel.zh: 面向想扫码听自己歌单的用户，提供界面现代的个人音乐流媒体服务。

harper.en: For writers who want grammar checks without sending text online, Harper runs offline in the browser and flags issues fast.
harper.zh: 面向不想把文本上传网络的写作者，Harper 在浏览器本地检查英文语法，速度快。

libretranslate.en: A free, open source machine translation API for teams that need self-hosted translation and can run offline.
libretranslate.zh: 面向需要自托管与离线翻译的团队，提供免费开源的机器翻译 API。

postal.en: A fully featured open source mail delivery platform for teams that want to self-host incoming and outgoing e-mail instead of relying on commercial sending services.
postal.zh: 面向希望自建收件与发件邮件系统的团队，提供完整的开源邮件投递平台，可替代商业发信服务。

openra.en: For players of early Westwood real-time strategy games, this C# engine runs modernized versions on Windows, Linux, BSD and Mac OS X.
openra.zh: 面向早期 Westwood 即时战略游戏玩家，提供可联机、跨平台运行的现代化重制版本。

webgl-fluid.en: A browser-based fluid toy for anyone who wants to stir colorful smoke with the cursor and unwind.
webgl-fluid.zh: 一个浏览器里的流体玩具，适合想用鼠标搅动彩色烟雾、随手解压的人。

alger.en: A third-party music player for users who need local service, desktop lyrics, music downloads, and remote control.
alger.zh: 面向需要本地服务、桌面歌词、音乐下载和远程控制的用户，提供第三方音乐播放器。

openrct2.en: OpenRCT2 is an open source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 for players who want to keep building and running their own amusement parks.
openrct2.zh: OpenRCT2 是过山车大亨 2 的开源重制，面向想继续建造和经营自己游乐场的玩家。

flarum.en: Flarum is simple forum software for people who want to build and run an online community.
flarum.zh: Flarum 是一款轻量论坛软件，适合想搭建和运营在线社区的用户。

open-saas.en: A free JS boilerplate for developers building SaaS apps who need auth, payments, email, and a landing page ready out of the box.
open-saas.zh: 面向需要认证、支付、邮件和落地页的 SaaS 开发者，提供开箱即用的免费 JS 样板。

billionmail.en: BillionMail is a self-hosted open-source tool for teams that need a mail server, newsletters, and email marketing without monthly fees.
billionmail.zh: BillionMail 是开源自托管工具，面向需要邮件服务器、Newsletter 与邮件营销且不想支付月费的团队。

bluesky.en: For people who want to join the AT Protocol social network, Bluesky offers official Web, iOS, and Android clients.
bluesky.zh: 供 Web、iOS 和 Android 用户接入 AT 社交网络的官方客户端。

beets.en: For people with large music collections, beets manages the library and fills in tags from MusicBrainz.
beets.zh: 面向拥有大量音乐文件的用户，beets 管理音乐库，并从 MusicBrainz 补全标签、整理目录。

orcaslicer.en: A G-code generator for 3D printer users, an enhanced PrusaSlicer fork with more parameter tuning and calibration tools.
orcaslicer.zh: 面向3D打印用户，PrusaSlicer增强分支，提供更多参数调校与校准工具。

pcsx2.en: PCSX2 is a PlayStation 2 emulator for players who want to run PS2 games on a computer, built over two decades.
pcsx2.zh: PCSX2 是 PlayStation 2 模拟器，适合想在电脑上运行 PS2 游戏的玩家，项目已开发二十年。

spree.en: An open source commerce platform for DTC, B2B, marketplace and omnichannel teams that want to self-host, own their data and avoid vendor lock-in.
spree.zh: 面向 DTC、B2B、多商户与全渠道团队的开源电商平台，支持自托管，数据自主，避免供应商锁定。

zigbee2mqtt.en: For smart home users, it bridges Zigbee devices to MQTT so they can drop proprietary Zigbee bridges.
zigbee2mqtt.zh: 面向智能家居用户，把 Zigbee 设备接入 MQTT，摆脱厂商专用网关。

pakeplus.en: For developers who want to ship a webpage or frontend project as desktop and mobile apps, it builds apps under 5M in minutes.
pakeplus.zh: 面向想把网页或前端项目发布为桌面端和移动端 App 的开发者，几分钟内即可构建 5M 以内的应用。

documenso.en: Documenso is an open source alternative to DocuSign, aimed at users who need electronic signatures.
documenso.zh: Documenso 是开源的 DocuSign 替代方案，面向需要电子签名的用户。

dolphin.en: Dolphin is a GameCube and Wii emulator for players who want to run these games on PC with improvements.
dolphin.zh: Dolphin 是 GameCube 和 Wii 模拟器，供想在 PC 上玩这两个平台游戏并获画质提升的玩家使用。

shotcut.en: A cross-platform Qt video editor for people who need to cut and arrange footage in many formats without transcoding first.
shotcut.zh: 面向需要剪辑和编排多种格式素材、且不想先转码的用户，提供跨平台非线性剪辑。

mailinabox.en: Mail-in-a-Box lets individuals deploy a one-click SMTP and mail server to take back control of their email.
mailinabox.zh: Mail-in-a-Box 让个人用户一键部署自有邮件服务器，重新掌控自己的电子邮件。

zitadel.en: For teams building apps, ZITADEL provides identity infrastructure with multi-tenant support to manage authentication and users.
zitadel.zh: 面向需要身份认证的应用团队，ZITADEL 提供多租户友好的身份基础设施，用于管理用户与登录。

supertokens.en: An open source option for developers who need authentication and want an alternative to Auth0, Firebase Auth, or AWS Cognito.
supertokens.zh: 面向需要身份认证的开发者，提供 Auth0、Firebase Auth、AWS Cognito 的开源替代方案。

caprover.en: A PaaS for developers who want to host apps on their own servers, using automated Docker and nginx with a web console.
caprover.zh: 面向希望在自己的服务器上托管应用的开发者，通过自动化 Docker 和 nginx 提供网页控制台。

peertube.en: For teams that want to self-host video sharing, PeerTube is an ActivityPub-federated streaming platform with in-browser P2P delivery.
peertube.zh: 适合自建视频站点的团队：联邦式视频平台，支持浏览器内 P2P 传输。

stalwart.en: Stalwart is an all-in-one mail and collaboration server for teams that need secure, scalable support for IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV, and WebDAV.
stalwart.zh: 面向团队的一体化邮件与协作服务器，安全可扩展，支持多种邮件与协作协议。

whisky.en: A SwiftUI Wine wrapper for macOS that gives users a graphical way to run Windows games and apps on Mac.
whisky.zh: 面向 Mac 用户的 Wine 图形外壳，用图形界面运行 Windows 游戏和应用。

microg.en: For Android users who remove Google apps, microG is a free implementation of Play Services that keeps push working.
microg.zh: 面向去掉谷歌全家桶的安卓用户，microG 是开源的 Google 服务替代实现，可继续使用推送。

seafile.en: For users who need file syncing and sharing, it supports resuming transfers and large files, plus extensible properties and flexible views.
seafile.zh: 面向需要文件同步共享的用户，支持断点续传和大文件，并用扩展属性和灵活视图整理文件。

duplicati.en: Duplicati gives self-hosters and small teams encrypted incremental backups to cloud storage through a web interface.
duplicati.zh: Duplicati 为自建服务用户提供网页界面的增量加密备份，支持多种云存储。

moviepy.en: MoviePy lets developers edit video with Python scripts, which suits batch tasks like adding intros, subtitles, and watermarks.
moviepy.zh: MoviePy 让开发者用 Python 脚本剪视频，适合批量添加片头、字幕和水印。

formatjs.en: A monorepo for FormatJS libraries, most notably react-intl, for developers adding ICU message formatting to apps.
formatjs.zh: FormatJS 系列库的 monorepo，以 react-intl 为代表，帮助开发者为应用加入 ICU 消息格式。

subtitleedit.en: A subtitle editor for video creators and translators, offering auto-translation, waveform alignment, and format conversion.
subtitleedit.zh: 面向视频创作者和译者的字幕编辑工具，支持自动翻译、波形对齐与格式互转。

audiobookshelf.en: For people who listen to audiobooks and podcasts, a self-hosted server that syncs playback progress across devices.
audiobookshelf.zh: 面向有声书和播客听众的自托管服务器，可在不同设备间同步播放进度。

jimp.en: A JavaScript image processing library for Node developers, with zero external or native dependencies.
jimp.zh: 面向 Node 开发者的纯 JS 图像处理库，无需外部或原生依赖。

lemmy.en: Lemmy is a decentralised discussion platform for communities, letting people run their own forums and interest groups.
lemmy.zh: Lemmy 是面向社群运营者的去中心化讨论平台，可自建论坛和兴趣社区。

e2b.en: E2B gives agent developers a secure sandbox where model-generated code runs safely in isolation.
e2b.zh: E2B 为智能体开发者提供安全沙箱，让模型生成的代码在隔离环境中安全执行。

bytebase.en: Bytebase is a database governance platform that controls changes and access across every major database, for human teams and agents.
bytebase.zh: Bytebase 是面向团队和智能体的数据库治理平台，统一管控主流数据库的变更与访问权限。

retroarch.en: A cross-platform frontend for the libretro API, giving retro gaming users one interface to manage many console cores.
retroarch.zh: 面向复古游戏玩家的跨平台 libretro 前端，用一个界面管理多种主机核心。

editor-md.en: A embeddable online Markdown editor for developers and writers who need to add Markdown editing to a web page.
editor-md.zh: 可嵌入的在线 Markdown 编辑器，适合需要在网页中加入 Markdown 编辑功能的开发者和写作者。

nanobrowser.en: Nanobrowser is an open-source AI agent that automates daily web tasks in your real, logged-in browser using your own API key.
nanobrowser.zh: Nanobrowser 是开源 AI 代理，用你自己的 API Key 在已登录的真实浏览器中自动完成日常网页任务。

codelf.en: A search tool for developers who struggle with naming variables and functions, helping them find naming ideas from real GitHub code.
codelf.zh: 面向为变量和函数命名发愁的开发者，帮他们从 GitHub 真实代码中寻找命名灵感。

sponsorblock.en: SponsorBlock is a browser extension for YouTube viewers who want to skip sponsor segments, intros and outros that the community has marked.
sponsorblock.zh: SponsorBlock 是一款浏览器扩展，面向想跳过赞助口播、片头片尾的 YouTube 观众，这些片段由社区标记。

bitwarden.en: Bitwarden offers open-source password manager clients for web, browser extension, desktop, and CLI, helping users store and manage credentials across devices.
bitwarden.zh: Bitwarden 提供网页、浏览器扩展、桌面和命令行等开源密码管理器客户端，帮助用户在各设备上存储和管理各类账号密码。

unleash.en: For product and engineering teams that need to control feature rollouts, Unleash is an open-source feature management platform for gradual releases and region-based toggles.
unleash.zh: 面向需要控制功能上线的产品与研发团队，Unleash 是开源功能管理平台，支持灰度发布和按地区开关。

luanti.en: Luanti, formerly Minetest, is an open source voxel game-creation platform for players and creators who want easy modding and game creation.
luanti.zh: Luanti（原 Minetest）是开源体素游戏创作平台，适合想轻松做模组、建游戏的玩家和创作者。

mealie.en: Mealie is a self hosted recipe manager and meal planner for families, letting you add recipes by URL or with a UI editor.
mealie.zh: Mealie 是自托管的菜谱管理与备餐工具，适合家庭使用，可通过网址导入或手动编辑添加菜谱。

nmap.en: Nmap, the Network Mapper, is a long-standing tool for network scanning and port probing, used by both operations and security teams.
nmap.zh: Nmap（Network Mapper）是用于网络扫描和端口探测的老牌工具，运维和安全人员都在使用。

instaloader.en: For researchers and archivists who need to save Instagram pictures or videos with captions and metadata.
instaloader.zh: 面向研究人员和归档者，用于保存 Instagram 的图片或视频及其配文和元数据。

mailcow.en: A dockerized mail server suite with a complete admin interface for managing email.
mailcow.zh: 面向邮件服务器管理员，提供容器化邮件服务器套件和较完善的管理界面。

firefox.en: For everyday users who want a mainstream browser with independent engine development, privacy protections, and a broad extension ecosystem.
firefox.zh: 面向需要主流浏览器、注重隐私保护与扩展生态的日常用户。

element.en: A web client for teams using the Matrix protocol, offering end-to-end encryption and self-hosted server options.
element.zh: 面向使用 Matrix 协议的团队，提供网页聊天客户端，支持端到端加密和自建服务器。

doocs-md.en: A Markdown editor for WeChat official account writers, with custom themes and multiple image hosts, letting them copy formatted content with one click.
doocs-md.zh: 面向微信公众号作者的 Markdown 排版编辑器，支持自定义主题与多图床，可一键复制排版内容。

logto.en: Logto is authentication and authorization infrastructure for SaaS and AI apps, built on OIDC and OAuth 2.1 with multi-tenancy, SSO, and RBAC.
logto.zh: Logto 帮 SaaS 与 AI 应用解决认证授权问题。
