plantuml.en: A tool for developers to generate UML diagrams from plain text descriptions.
plantuml.zh: 面向开发者的工具，用纯文本描述生成 UML 图。

video-subtitle-remover.en: For video editors and creators, it removes hard-coded subtitles and text watermarks locally with AI, keeping resolution intact.
video-subtitle-remover.zh: 面向视频编辑与创作者，用 AI 在本地去除硬字幕和文字水印，保持原分辨率。

the-odin-project.en: A free open curriculum for people learning web development, built around hands-on projects.
the-odin-project.zh: 面向想学 Web 开发的人，以做项目为主线的免费开源全栈课程。

markmap.en: For people who outline in plain text: it turns Markdown notes into interactive mindmaps.
markmap.zh: 适合用纯文本写大纲的人：把 Markdown 笔记转成可交互思维导图。

formbricks.en: Formbricks is an open source survey tool for product teams that need self-hosted questionnaires and in-product micro-surveys.
formbricks.zh: Formbricks 是开源的问卷工具，适合需要在产品内做微调研并自托管问卷的产品团队。

plasmo.en: Plasmo is a framework for developers building browser extensions, offering hot reload, bundling, and multi-browser publishing.
plasmo.zh: Plasmo 是面向浏览器扩展开发者的框架，提供热更新、打包和多浏览器发布支持。

openreplay.en: OpenReplay is a self-hosted session replay, cobrowsing and product analytics tool for teams that need to reproduce user issues and iterate on their product.
openreplay.zh: OpenReplay 是自托管的会话回放、协同浏览与产品分析工具，适合需要复现用户问题并迭代产品的团队使用。

libretube.en: An alternative YouTube frontend for Android users who want a modern client with SponsorBlock ad skipping.
libretube.zh: 面向想要现代客户端并支持 SponsorBlock 跳过广告的安卓用户的 YouTube 替代前端。

langgpt.en: LangGPT is a structured prompt framework that lets teams write prompts as templates for reuse and version management.
langgpt.zh: LangGPT 是结构化提示词框架，把提示词写成模板，团队可以复用和版本管理。

planka.en: A self-hosted Kanban board for teams that want to track projects on their own servers, with a free Community edition.
planka.zh: 面向希望在自己服务器上管理项目的团队，提供自托管看板和免费的社区版。

cataclysm-dda.en: A turn-based post-apocalyptic survival roguelike for players who want deep crafting, farming, and even building vehicles or fitting prosthetics.
cataclysm-dda.zh: 一款回合制末日生存 roguelike，适合想要深度制作、种田，甚至自己造车和接假肢的玩家。

chainlit.en: A framework for Python developers who need a chat UI for their agents, showing intermediate steps and cited sources with a few lines of code.
chainlit.zh: 面向 Python 开发者，用几行代码就能给智能体加上对话界面，并展示中间步骤和引用来源。

gatus.en: A status page for developers who need automated health checks and incident alerts, configured in one YAML file.
gatus.zh: 面向开发者的状态页工具，用一份 YAML 声明要监控的服务，并提供告警与事件支持。

genact.en: A nonsense activity generator for anyone who wants to look busy, showing endless compile, scan, and hack output on screen.
genact.zh: 假装很忙生成器，面向想显得忙碌的人，屏幕上不停滚动编译、扫描和黑客攻击画面。

marketing-agents.en: A set of ready-to-use agent configurations for marketing, product and operations teams.
marketing-agents.zh: 一套面向营销、产品和运营团队的 agent 配置，拿来就能用。

klipper.en: Klipper is a 3D-printer firmware for printer owners, moving computation to a host to improve speed and accuracy.
klipper.zh: Klipper 是面向 3D 打印机用户的固件，把运算移到上位机，让打印更快更准。

sonic-pi.en: Sonic Pi lets learners compose live music by writing code; change one line and the melody changes, a common choice for music programming classes.
sonic-pi.zh: 给学习音乐编程的人用：用写代码的方式现场作曲，改一行就换一段旋律，音乐编程课常用。

libvips.en: libvips is a fast image processing library with low memory needs, useful for developers who handle large images or build image pipelines.
libvips.zh: libvips 是低内存占用的快速图像处理库，适合需要处理大图或搭建图像处理流程的开发者。

esphome.en: It lets makers control ESP32, ESP8266, BK72xx and RP2040 boards with simple configuration files and manage them remotely through home automation systems.
esphome.zh: 它让开发者用简单的配置文件控制 ESP 芯片，并通过智能家居系统远程管理这些设备。

onefetch.en: For developers working in the terminal, onefetch displays Git repository information in an attractive format.
onefetch.zh: 面向在终端工作的开发者，onefetch 以美观的方式展示 Git 仓库信息。

unciv.en: Open-source Android and desktop remake of Civ V for players who want turn-based strategy on the go.
unciv.zh: 面向想在手机或电脑上玩回合制策略的玩家，这是文明 5 的开源复刻。

owncast.en: For people who want to run their own live stream, Owncast provides self-hosted streaming and chat out of the box.
owncast.zh: 面向想自建直播站的人，Owncast 开箱即用提供直播推流与聊天，不依赖第三方平台。

misskey.en: A free and open federated microblogging platform for people who want emoji reactions and plugins.
misskey.zh: 面向需要表情回应和插件扩展的用户，提供免费开源的联邦微博客平台。

listen1.en: A desktop music player for Windows, Mac, and Linux that aggregates multiple platforms' catalogs so users can listen to music in one place.
listen1.zh: 面向多平台听歌的用户，这款桌面播放器聚合多个平台曲库，在一个播放器里收听音乐。

mcp-inspector.en: For developers building MCP servers: provides deterministic testing tools and visual debugging to develop and troubleshoot connection issues.
mcp-inspector.zh: 面向 MCP 服务器开发者：提供确定性测试与可视化调试，帮助开发和排查连接问题。

dufs.en: A lightweight file server for developers who need to serve, upload, and search files from a directory with a single command.
dufs.zh: 面向需要快速把目录变成可上传下载文件服务的开发者，一条命令即可启动。

kavita.en: For readers who want their own library, Kavita is a fast, cross-platform reading server to host and share collections with friends and family.
kavita.zh: 面向想自建书库并分享的读者，Kavita 是跨平台阅读服务器，支持元数据刮削与阅读进度。

mautic.en: Mautic is open source marketing automation software for teams that need user journeys and segmented outreach.
mautic.zh: Mautic 是开源营销自动化软件，适合需要用户旅程和分层触达的团队。

thumbor.en: Thumbor is an open-source photo thumbnail service from Globo.com, giving developers a way to crop, resize and watermark images through URL parameters, with built-in caching.
thumbor.zh: Thumbor 是 Globo.com 开源的图片缩略图服务，让开发者通过 URL 参数裁剪、缩放和加水印，并自带缓存。

pixelorama.en: For pixel artists and game creators, Pixelorama is an open-source tool for making sprites, tiles, and animations on desktop or web.
pixelorama.zh: Pixelorama 是开源像素画工具，适合游戏素材创作者制作精灵、图块和动画。

self-operating-computer.en: A framework for developers who want a multimodal model to see screenshots and operate the mouse and keyboard.
self-operating-computer.zh: 面向开发者的框架，让多模态模型查看屏幕截图并操作鼠标键盘。

omni-tools.en: For anyone needing everyday utilities: a self-hosted collection of fast, accessible browser tools with no ads or tracking.
omni-tools.zh: 面向需要日常小工具的用户：可自托管的浏览器在线工具集，无广告无跟踪，访问快捷。

typebot.en: For teams collecting form responses, Typebot is a self-hostable builder for conversational forms and chatbots that feel easier to finish.
typebot.zh: 适合收集表单的团队：Typebot 是自托管的对话式表单与聊天机器人搭建工具。

nopcommerce.en: nopCommerce is a free, open-source shopping cart for businesses that need to run an online store on ASP.NET Core.
nopcommerce.zh: nopCommerce 是免费开源的购物车系统，适合需要在 ASP.NET Core 上搭建网店的企业。

akaunting.en: Akaunting is online accounting software for users who need to manage accounts and invoices.
akaunting.zh: Akaunting 是一款在线会计软件，适合需要管理账目和发票的用户。

rubick.en: An Electron-based open source toolbox for developers who want to extend their workflow by integrating and writing plug-ins.
rubick.zh: 基于 Electron 的开源工具箱，适合希望通过集成和自行编写插件来扩展工作流的开发者。

sioyek.en: Sioyek is a PDF viewer for readers of textbooks and research papers, with fast jumps and citation navigation.
sioyek.zh: Sioyek 是一款面向教材与论文读者的 PDF 阅读器，支持快速跳转和引用跳转。

wireshark.en: For network engineers and security analysts, Wireshark captures and analyzes traffic, with broad protocol parsing support.
wireshark.zh: 面向网络工程师和安全分析人员，Wireshark 用于抓包分析，协议解析支持范围很广。

claude-code-action.en: For developers who want Claude Code to work inside GitHub Actions, automating pull request and issue handling.
claude-code-action.zh: 面向希望让 Claude Code 在 GitHub Actions 中运行、自动处理 PR 和 Issue 的开发者。

ufo.en: UFO is a Microsoft Windows agent that helps users complete cross-app GUI tasks, such as changing system settings or organizing files.
ufo.zh: UFO 是微软的 Windows 智能体，帮用户跨应用操作图形界面完成任务，如改系统设置、整理文件。

devilutionx.en: Lets players run Diablo on modern operating systems, including phones and computers, to revisit Tristram.
devilutionx.zh: 让玩家在现代操作系统上运行暗黑破坏神，在手机和电脑上重温崔斯特姆。

grocy.en: Grocy is a self-hosted web tool for households that tracks groceries, expiry dates, and shopping needs.
grocy.zh: Grocy 是自托管的家庭管理工具，帮用户记录库存、查看保质期并整理购物需求。

kanboard.en: For small teams and self-hosters who need simple task tracking, Kanboard is lightweight PHP kanban software that runs on minimal resources.
kanboard.zh: 适合小团队与自部署用户，Kanboard 单程序部署、资源占用低，用于管理看板任务。

transform.en: A web tool for developers that converts between formats such as JSON, YAML, TypeScript, GraphQL, and Protobuf.
transform.zh: 面向开发者，在 JSON、YAML、TypeScript、GraphQL、Protobuf 等格式之间互相转换。

prusaslicer.en: A G-code generator for 3D printer users working with RepRap, Makerbot, Ultimaker and similar machines.
prusaslicer.zh: 面向 3D 打印机用户的开源切片软件，把 3D 模型转成打印机可识别的 G-code 指令。

octoprint.en: OctoPrint gives 3D printer owners a web interface to monitor prints and send jobs remotely.
octoprint.zh: OctoPrint 为 3D 打印机用户提供网页界面，可远程查看打印状态并发送打印任务。

lago.en: Open source metering and usage-based billing API for API and SaaS teams, with consumption tracking, subscriptions, pricing, payments and revenue analytics.
lago.zh: 开源计量与按用量计费API，帮API/SaaS团队管理用量、订阅、定价与支付。

violentmonkey.en: Violentmonkey adds userscript support to WebExtensions browsers, letting users run scripts that change website behavior.
violentmonkey.zh: Violentmonkey 为支持 WebExtensions 的浏览器提供用户脚本支持，让用户运行脚本改变网站行为。

drawio.en: draw.io is a client-side JavaScript editor for general diagramming, aimed at users who need to create diagrams in the browser.
drawio.zh: draw.io 是一款基于 JavaScript 的客户端通用图表编辑器，适合需要在浏览器中绘制图表的用户。

heyform.en: An open-source form builder for anyone who needs to create surveys and sign-up forms by dragging and dropping.
heyform.zh: 开源表单搭建器，适合需要通过拖拽做出问卷和报名表的用户。

miaoyan.en: A local-first Markdown writing app for Mac users who want a quiet, clean space to focus on writing.
miaoyan.zh: 面向 Mac 用户的本地优先 Markdown 写作工具，提供安静的写作环境，帮助专注写好句子。

anytype.en: A local-first knowledge tool for MacOS, Linux and Windows that organizes content as objects and encrypts it end to end.
anytype.zh: 面向需要整理知识的人，本地优先，以对象组织内容，并提供端到端加密。

xagent.en: For developers facing complex tasks, XAgent is an autonomous LLM agent that breaks down steps and reflects on its work.
xagent.zh: 面向需要处理复杂任务的开发者，XAgent 是能自行拆解步骤并反思的自主智能体。

growthbook.en: GrowthBook is an open source platform that gives product teams feature flags, experiments, and product analytics in one tool.
growthbook.zh: GrowthBook 是开源平台，为产品团队在同一工具中提供功能开关、实验和产品分析。

i18next.en: A JavaScript internationalization framework for developers who need to translate their apps into multiple languages.
i18next.zh: 面向需要多语言界面的开发者，i18next 提供学一次即可在各处复用的 JS 国际化方案。

meshtastic.en: Official firmware for Meshtastic, an open-source off-grid mesh communication system for users outside carrier coverage.
meshtastic.zh: 面向没有运营商信号覆盖的用户，Meshtastic 官方固件用 LoRa 组建开源离网通信网。

nb.en: A CLI and local web tool for plain text note-taking, bookmarking, and archiving, with linking, tagging, search, and Git versioning in one portable script.
nb.zh: 面向命令行用户的纯文本笔记、书签和归档工具，在单个可移植脚本中提供链接、标签、搜索和 Git 版本管理。

mumble.en: Mumble is an open-source voice chat tool for gaming groups and communities that need low-latency, high-quality calls.
mumble.zh: Mumble 是开源语音通话工具，适合游戏开黑和社区用户，提供低延迟、高质量的通话。

floorp.en: A Firefox-based browser from a Japanese team, built for users who want extensive customization.
floorp.zh: 日本团队开发的 Firefox 分支，面向需要高度自定义浏览器的用户。

openttd.en: OpenTTD is an open source transport simulation game for players who want to build railways and airports, based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe.
openttd.zh: OpenTTD 是一款开源运输模拟游戏，基于运输大亨豪华版，适合喜欢铺铁路、建机场的玩家。

mockoon.en: For developers who need mock APIs, Mockoon runs them locally in seconds with no account or remote deployment.
mockoon.zh: 为需要本地假接口的开发者准备：几秒启动 mock 服务，无需账号和远程部署。

crater.en: Crater is an open source invoicing solution for individuals and businesses that need to create invoices and manage payments.
crater.zh: Crater 是面向个人与企业的开源发票工具，用于开具发票和管理收款。

snapdom.en: For developers who need to capture or convert DOM elements, snapdom is a high-performance engine that turns them into any format.
snapdom.zh: 面向需要捕获或转换 DOM 元素的开发者，snapdom 是高性能引擎，可将元素转为任意格式。

backgroundremover.en: Background Remover is a free, open source command line tool that uses AI to remove backgrounds from images and video, useful for people preparing material in batches.
backgroundremover.zh: Background Remover 是免费开源的命令行工具，用 AI 为图片和视频去背景，适合需要批量处理素材的人。

librephotos.en: For people who want to manage their own photo library, it offers self-hosted storage with automatic tagging and face grouping.
librephotos.zh: 面向希望自己管理照片库的用户，提供自托管存储，并用机器学习自动打标签和归类人物。

opentoonz.en: OpenToonz is an open-source 2D animation tool for animators who need a full-featured workflow for creating animation.
opentoonz.zh: OpenToonz 是一款开源的 2D 动画制作软件，面向需要完整动画制作流程的动画创作者。

google-indexing-script.en: A script for site owners who want Google to index their pages via the Indexing API within 48 hours.
google-indexing-script.zh: 面向希望借助 Indexing API 让 Google 在 48 小时内收录页面的站长。

buster.en: A browser extension for people who struggle with reCAPTCHA, letting them solve it with one click via speech recognition.
buster.zh: 面向不想一张张点图片过 reCAPTCHA 的用户：点一下用语音识别完成验证。

endless-sky.en: Endless Sky is a free space game for players who want to trade, smuggle, and fight their way up from a small ship.
endless-sky.zh: Endless Sky 是一款免费太空游戏，适合想从一条小船起步、靠跑商、走私和战斗发展的玩家。

veloren.en: An open world voxel RPG in Rust for players who want open source exploration with multiplayer support.
veloren.zh: 用 Rust 编写的开放世界体素 RPG，适合想开源探索并支持多人联机的玩家。

no-more-secrets.en: A command line tool for terminal users who want to recreate the data decryption effect from the 1992 movie Sneakers.
no-more-secrets.zh: 面向想在终端复刻电影《Sneakers》文字乱码还原特效的命令行用户。

exercism.en: Exercism offers practice exercises in many programming languages, with real human mentors reviewing your code.
exercism.zh: Exercism 提供几十种语言的练习题，每道题都有真人导师帮你改代码。

mgba.en: mGBA is a Game Boy Advance emulator for players who want to run GBA games on other devices.
mgba.zh: mGBA 是一款 GBA 模拟器，适合想在其他设备上运行 GBA 游戏的玩家。

hedgedoc.en: HedgeDoc is a real-time collaborative Markdown editor with live preview, suited to teams taking shared meeting notes.
hedgedoc.zh: HedgeDoc 是实时协作的 Markdown 编辑器，支持边写边预览，适合团队共同记录会议内容。

tiny-troupe.en: For researchers and product teams, TinyTroupe simulates LLM-powered multiagent personas to support imagination enhancement and business insights.
tiny-troupe.zh: 面向研究人员和产品团队，TinyTroupe 用 LLM 生成多角色虚拟人群，辅助市场调研推演与业务洞察。

mailu.en: Mailu delivers a mail server as Docker images for users who want to run their own email distribution environment.
mailu.zh: Mailu 以 Docker 镜像形式提供邮件服务器，适合希望自行搭建邮件分发环境的用户。

wiremock.en: Developers who need to test against HTTP services can use WireMock to mock responses.
wiremock.zh: 需要依赖 HTTP 服务做测试的开发者，可以用 WireMock 模拟服务响应。

esearch.en: eSearch is a cross-platform tool for users who need screenshot, offline OCR, search and translate, and screen recording in one app.
esearch.zh: eSearch 是跨平台工具，面向需要截屏、离线 OCR、搜索翻译和录屏的用户，一个工具即可完成多项操作。

gopass.en: A command-line password manager for teams that uses GPG encryption and Git to store and share credentials.
gopass.zh: 面向团队的命令行密码管理器，使用 GPG 加密和 Git 存储与共享凭据。

ffsend.en: For command-line users sharing files, it provides encrypted transfers with configurable expiration times.
ffsend.zh: 面向需要在命令行共享文件的用户，提供加密传输并可设置过期时间。

html-to-image.en: For frontend developers who need to turn a DOM node into an image, it renders that node with HTML5 canvas and SVG.
html-to-image.zh: 面向需要把 DOM 节点转成图片的前端开发者，用 HTML5 canvas 和 SVG 生成图像。

instagrapi.en: A Python library for developers who need programmatic access to Instagram's private API for posting and data tasks.
instagrapi.zh: 面向需要以编程方式访问 Instagram 非官方接口的开发者，用于发帖与数据获取等任务。

pixelfed.en: Pixelfed is open-source photo sharing software for people who want a self-hosted, federated alternative to Instagram.
pixelfed.zh: Pixelfed 是开源的图片分享软件，适合想要可自托管、支持联邦的 Instagram 替代方案的用户。

wesnoth.en: For strategy players who want a free fantasy wargame, it offers turn-based battles with a long campaign story.
wesnoth.zh: 面向喜欢策略游戏的玩家，它提供回合制奇幻战棋和篇幅很长的战役剧情。

rowy.en: A browser-based low-code backend for developers who need to manage a database in a spreadsheet-like UI and build cloud function workflows in JavaScript or TypeScript.
rowy.zh: 面向需要在浏览器中管理数据库、并用 JS/TS 编写云函数工作流的开发者的一款低代码后端面板。

shattered-pixel-dungeon.en: Shattered Pixel Dungeon is an open-source traditional roguelike for players who want randomized dungeon runs with hundreds of items to collect.
shattered-pixel-dungeon.zh: 给喜欢随机地牢的玩家：开源传统 roguelike，随机关卡与敌人，数百件道具可收集。

openmw.en: For players who want to run Morrowind, OpenMW is an open-source open-world RPG engine that supports playing the game.
openmw.zh: 面向想玩《晨风》的玩家，OpenMW 是开源开放世界 RPG 引擎，支持运行该游戏。

flagsmith.en: Flagsmith is an open-source feature flag platform for teams that need remote config, experimentation, and cloud or self-hosted deployment.
flagsmith.zh: Flagsmith 是开源功能开关平台，适合需要远程配置、实验能力以及云端或自托管部署的团队。

openshot.en: OpenShot is a free, open-source video editor for Linux, Mac, and Windows that gives beginners a drag-and-drop timeline for simple edits and animation.
openshot.zh: OpenShot 是免费开源的跨平台视频剪辑器，用拖拽式时间线帮助入门用户完成基础剪辑与动画。

cava.en: For terminal users who want to see their music: Cava draws live audio bars in the terminal.
cava.zh: 给想在终端里看音乐律动的用户：Cava 把音频画成随音乐跳动的柱状图。

fontsource.en: Fontsource packages open source fonts as self-hosted NPM bundles, so developers can load fonts without relying on Google Fonts.
fontsource.zh: Fontsource 把开源字体打包成可自托管的 npm 包，让开发者不依赖 Google Fonts 也能加载字体。

tiktok-api.en: An unofficial Python API wrapper for marketers and content researchers to collect TikTok video, user, and topic data for topic analysis.
tiktok-api.zh: 面向营销和内容研究者，抓 TikTok 视频、用户和话题数据，辅助选题分析。

baserow.en: For teams that need a no-code database, Baserow lets you build databases, automations, apps and agents with AI, on cloud or self-hosted.
baserow.zh: 面向需要无代码数据库的团队，Baserow 支持用 AI 构建数据库、自动化、应用与智能体，可云端使用或自建部署。

iconify.en: For developers and designers who need icons from many open source sets, Iconify offers one syntax and SVG, React, Vue, Svelte components.
iconify.zh: 面向需要多套开源图标集的开发者与设计师，提供统一语法与 SVG、React、Vue、Svelte 组件。

weblate.en: A web based localization tool for teams that need translators to work online while staying tied to version control.
weblate.zh: 面向需要译者在线协作、同时与版本控制保持同步的团队的网页本地化工具。

httpsms.en: Developers and small teams can send and receive SMS through their Android phone via a simple HTTP API.
httpsms.zh: 面向开发者和小团队，通过安卓手机以简单的 HTTP 接口收发短信。

goatcounter.en: GoatCounter is an easy web analytics tool for site owners who want visit stats without tracking personal data.
goatcounter.zh: GoatCounter 是一款极轻量的访问统计工具，适合希望在获取访问数据的同时不追踪个人数据的网站运营者。

pdfarranger.en: A small Python-GTK app that lets users merge or split PDF documents and rotate, crop and rearrange pages through an interactive graphical interface.
pdfarranger.zh: 一款小型 Python-GTK 应用，帮助用户通过交互式图形界面合并或拆分 PDF 文档，并旋转、裁剪和重排页面。

kdenlive.en: A free, open source video editor built on the MLT Framework and KDE Frameworks for multi-track editing.
kdenlive.zh: 基于 MLT 框架和 KDE 框架的免费开源视频剪辑软件，适合需要多轨剪辑的用户。

zammad.en: Zammad is a web-based open source helpdesk system for teams that need to manage customer support requests.
zammad.zh: Zammad 是面向需要管理客户支持请求的团队的 Web 化开源工单与客服系统。

countly.en: Countly is an analytics and engagement platform for product teams that need to understand and optimize customer journeys across mobile, desktop, and IoT apps, with privacy as a priority.
countly.zh: Countly 是面向产品团队的隐私优先分析与互动平台，帮助理解并优化用户在移动、桌面和物联网应用中的旅程。

inpaint-web.en: For people who remove watermarks or clutter and upscale images, this free open-source browser tool runs models locally, keeping files on your device.
inpaint-web.zh: 给需要去水印、清理杂物或放大图片的人：免费开源，模型本地运行，图片不用上传。

android-sms-gateway.en: For developers who need SMS sending and receiving, it exposes an API on the device or via a cloud server.
android-sms-gateway.zh: 面向需要收发短信的开发者，可通过设备端 API 或云服务器调用。

vikunja.en: A self-hosted task manager for people who want to own their tasks, projects and data instead of relying on a hosted service.
vikunja.zh: 面向希望自己掌控任务、项目与数据的用户，用自托管方式管理待办与项目。

agentops.en: A Python SDK for developers building AI agents, offering monitoring, LLM cost tracking, and benchmarking with popular agent frameworks.
agentops.zh: 面向开发 AI 智能体的团队，提供调用监控、LLM 成本追踪与基准测试的 Python SDK。

60s.en: Developers can use 60s API, a free open-source API collection with global CDN acceleration, for daily news, trending lists, prices and weather.
60s.zh: 60s API 是一套免费开源的接口集合，提供全球 CDN 加速，供开发者获取每日资讯、热搜榜、金价油价和天气。

markedit.en: A native Mac Markdown editor for people who want TextEdit-like simplicity.
markedit.zh: 面向希望像用 TextEdit 一样简单的 Mac 用户的 Markdown 编辑器。

komga.en: Komga is a media server for comics, mangas, BDs, magazines and eBooks, with API, OPDS and Kobo/KOReader sync support.
komga.zh: Komga 是面向漫画和电子书读者的媒体服务器，支持 OPDS、Kobo 与 KOReader 同步。

killbill.en: Kill Bill is an open-source subscription billing and payments platform for businesses that need to manage complex plans and trials.
killbill.zh: Kill Bill 是开源订阅计费与支付平台，面向需要管理复杂套餐和试用的企业。

auto-editor.en: A tool for video creators that automatically cuts silent segments to shorten talking-head footage.
auto-editor.zh: 面向视频创作者，自动剪掉静音片段，缩短口播视频时长。

cookieconsent.en: A simple cross-browser vanilla JS plugin for website owners who need to add cookie consent.
cookieconsent.zh: 面向需要添加 Cookie 同意提示的网站开发者，提供简单的跨浏览器原生 JS 插件。

supertuxkart.en: Open-source kart racer for players who want item pickups, drifting, and split-screen multiplayer in one game.
supertuxkart.zh: 面向想玩道具、漂移和分屏多人竞速的玩家，这是一款开源卡丁车游戏。

tinyraytracer.en: A short rendering course for learners who want to write a simple ray tracer by hand over a weekend.
tinyraytracer.zh: 面向想用一个周末手写简易光线追踪器的学习者，配套教程讲解图形渲染基础。

natron.en: Natron is open-source node-graph video compositing software for artists who need a free alternative to After Effects and Nuke.
natron.zh: Natron 是开源节点式视频合成软件，适合需要 After Effects 与 Nuke 类功能的用户。

open-color.en: Open Color provides a color scheme for UI design, helping designers get a systematic palette.
open-color.zh: Open Color 是面向 UI 设计师的配色方案生成器，提供成体系的调色板。

webglstudio.en: A browser-based 3D graphics editor for developers and designers who need scene editing, coding, and graph tools without installing software.
webglstudio.zh: 面向需要在浏览器中完成场景编辑、编码与节点图操作的开发者与设计师的 3D 图形编辑器。

cmatrix.en: For terminal users who want a Matrix-style green code rain effect in their console.
cmatrix.zh: 给想在终端中欣赏黑客帝国同款绿色代码雨的用户。

watermark-removal.en: A machine learning image inpainting tool for people who need to remove watermarks from images, using a task designed to make results resemble the ground truth image.
watermark-removal.zh: 一款面向需要去除图片水印用户的深度学习图像修复工具，目标是让修复结果接近原图。

the-powder-toy.en: A C++/SDL desktop falling-sand physics sandbox for players who want to experiment with air pressure, velocity and heat.
the-powder-toy.zh: 面向动手实验的玩家：一款桌面落沙物理沙盒，模拟气压、速度与热量。

kimai.en: Kimai is an open-source time-tracking app for freelancers and companies to manage timesheets, reports and invoices.
kimai.zh: Kimai 是开源工时统计应用，供自由职业者和企业管理工时、生成报表与发票。

frappe-books.en: Frappe Books is free accounting software for desktop bookkeeping, for anyone who needs to keep accounts on a computer.
frappe-books.zh: Frappe Books 是免费会计软件，面向需要在桌面端记账的用户。

flipt.en: Flipt is an enterprise-ready, Git native feature management solution for teams that want feature management to follow their Git workflows.
flipt.zh: Flipt 是面向企业的 Git 原生功能管理方案，帮助团队用 Git 工作流完成功能管理。

twikit.en: For developers who want to post, search, and track trends on Twitter/X without applying for an API key.
twikit.zh: 面向想发帖、搜索和追踪 Twitter/X 趋势的开发者，无需申请 API 密钥。

memex.en: A browser extension for individuals, teams and communities to curate, annotate and discuss valuable web content.
memex.zh: 面向个人、团队和社区，用来整理、标注和讨论网上有价值内容的浏览器扩展。

freescout.en: FreeScout is a free self-hosted helpdesk for small teams that turns a shared mailbox into an organized support channel.
freescout.zh: FreeScout 是免费自托管的客服工具，帮助小团队把共享邮箱变成有序的客服渠道。

corsixth.en: An open source clone of Theme Hospital for players who want to revisit the classic hospital management game.
corsixth.zh: 面向想重温经典医院经营游戏的玩家，这是《主题医院》的开源重制版。

zmk.en: ZMK Firmware Repository is firmware for wireless split keyboards, built on Zephyr for low power use.
zmk.zh: ZMK Firmware Repository 是面向无线分体键盘的固件，基于 Zephyr，注重低功耗。

wepush.en: A small tool for developers and operators who need to batch push messages across WeChat, SMS, email, and HTTP channels.
wepush.zh: 面向开发与运营人员的批量推送工具，支持公众号、企业微信、短信、邮件和 HTTP 等多渠道推送。

openutau.en: For creators who want to tune virtual singers, OpenUtau is an open-source singing synthesis editor that works with UTAU voicebanks.
openutau.zh: 面向想自己调教虚拟歌手的创作者，OpenUtau 是兼容 UTAU 音源的开源歌声合成编辑器。

kde-connect.en: KDE Connect is a multi-platform app that lets your devices communicate, so you can send files, share clipboard content, and use your phone as a remote.
kde-connect.zh: KDE Connect 是一款多平台应用，让设备之间互通，可传文件、共享剪贴板，并把手机当遥控器使用。

tolgee.en: A web-based localization platform for developers and translators to manage translations directly within the page.
tolgee.zh: 面向开发者与译者的本地化平台，支持在页面内直接管理和翻译内容。

claude-hooks-mastery.en: For Claude Code users who want predictable automation, it shows how to use hooks to manage workflows.
claude-hooks-mastery.zh: 面向希望实现可预期自动化的 Claude Code 用户，介绍如何用钩子管理流程。

surge-xt.en: A free open source hybrid synthesizer plugin for music producers who need a capable main instrument without paid software.
surge-xt.zh: 面向需要一款可当主力使用且无需付费的音乐制作人的免费开源混合合成器插件。

linkstack.en: For people who need a personal profile page, LinkStack lets you host one on your own server and show all your important links in one place.
linkstack.zh: 面向需要个人主页的人，LinkStack 可让你在自己的服务器上搭建页面，把所有重要链接集中放在一处。

mixpost.en: Self-hosted tool for teams that schedule and publish social media content across platforms from one dashboard, without subscriptions.
mixpost.zh: 面向需要多平台排期发帖的团队，自托管部署，一个后台统一管理社媒内容。

opnform.en: A clean open-source form builder for teams that need lightweight forms with logic jumps.
opnform.zh: 面向需要轻量表单与逻辑跳转的团队，提供界面干净的开源表单搭建工具。

pgadmin.en: pgAdmin is an open source administration and development platform for PostgreSQL, offering query, backup and performance analysis tools.
pgadmin.zh: pgAdmin 是 PostgreSQL 的开源管理与开发平台，提供查询、备份和性能分析功能。

fheroes2.en: For players who want to revisit Heroes of Might and Magic II, fheroes2 recreates its game engine with improved AI and high-resolution graphics.
fheroes2.zh: 面向想重温《英雄无敌2》的玩家，fheroes2 重写游戏引擎，并改进 AI 与高清画面。

synapse.en: Synapse is a Matrix homeserver written in Python/Twisted and Rust for people who want to run their own decentralized chat network.
synapse.zh: Synapse 是 Matrix 协议的服务器实现，适合想自己搭建去中心化聊天网络的用户。

cursor-rules-mdc.en: A curated collection of Cursor Rules .mdc files for frontend and backend stacks, helping Cursor users find ready-made rule files.
cursor-rules-mdc.zh: 面向 Cursor 用户，汇集前端后端多种技术栈的 .mdc 规则文件，方便直接查找使用。

espocrm.en: EspoCRM is an open source CRM application for teams that need to manage customer relationships and sales in one place.
espocrm.zh: EspoCRM 是一款功能完整的开源 CRM 应用，适合需要集中管理客户关系与销售流程的团队。

growchief.en: GrowChief is a social media automation tool for outreach, helping teams reach target accounts in batches.
growchief.zh: GrowChief 是社媒自动化外联工具，帮助团队批量触达目标账号。

frappe-helpdesk.en: A free and open source customer service tool for support teams that need modern, streamlined customer service software.
frappe-helpdesk.zh: 面向客服团队的开源客服软件，帮助团队以现代简洁的方式提供客户服务。

surveyjs.en: For developers building React, Angular, Vue, or plain JavaScript apps, this open-source library renders JSON-driven forms, surveys, quizzes, and multi-step wizards.
surveyjs.zh: 开源 JS 表单库，供前端开发者用 JSON 渲染表单、问卷和多步向导。

hollywood.en: For terminal users who want a quick visual joke, it fills the screen with windows scrolling fake data streams like a movie hacker scene.
hollywood.zh: 给想要快速视觉趣味的终端用户：它让一堆窗口同时滚动假数据流，营造电影里的黑客现场。

sandspiel.en: Sandspiel is a creative cellular automata browser game where you drop sand, fire, water, or viruses and watch them react to each other.
sandspiel.zh: Sandspiel 是一款创意沙粒模拟浏览器游戏，放沙、放火、放水或放病毒，看它们互相反应。

fdroid.en: An Android app store client for users who want only free software, as an alternative to Google Play.
fdroid.zh: 面向只想使用自由软件的安卓用户，作为 Google Play 替代的应用商店客户端。

claude-subagents-hub.en: A hub for developers seeking Claude skills, agents, commands, hooks, and plugins to extend Claude Code and related tools.
claude-subagents-hub.zh: 面向需要扩展 Claude Code 等工具的开发者，集中查找 Claude 技能、智能体、命令、钩子和插件。

orkas.en: Orkas gives desktop users an open-source, local-first AI team that turns goals into to-dos and coordinates specialist agents.
orkas.zh: Orkas 为桌面用户提供开源、本地优先的 AI 团队，把目标拆成待办，并协调多个专职智能体。

libredesk.en: A self-hosted support desk for small teams that need a lightweight alternative to hosted chat platforms.
libredesk.zh: 面向需要轻量替代托管客服平台的小团队，提供单二进制自托管客服台。

gzdoom.en: For players running Doom engine games: GZDoom is a ZDoom-based port that adds an OpenGL renderer and scripting capabilities.
gzdoom.zh: 面向 Doom 引擎游戏玩家：GZDoom 基于 ZDoom，新增 OpenGL 渲染器与脚本功能。

pipes-sh.en: For terminal users who want a screen saver, pipes.sh animates growing colored pipes on the screen.
pipes-sh.zh: 给想在终端放屏保的用户：pipes.sh 在屏幕上绘制不断生长的彩色管道动画。

mind-elixir.en: Mind Elixir is a JavaScript, framework-agnostic mind map core for developers who need a lightweight component with online editing and export.
mind-elixir.zh: Mind Elixir 是面向开发者的 JavaScript、框架无关思维导图核心，轻量组件支持在线编辑与导出。

openoutreach.en: For B2B sales teams: a self-hosted CLI agent that finds fitting leads, explains each match, and emails them from your own mailbox.
openoutreach.zh: 面向B2B销售的开源自托管CLI，描述产品找匹配客户、说明理由，用自有邮箱发信。

cskefu.en: An open-source customer service system in Chinese, for teams that need to provide customer service.
cskefu.zh: 面向需要提供客户服务的企业和团队的中文开源客服系统。

scummvm.en: For players who want to run classic adventure games on modern systems, ScummVM lets hundreds of them run again.
scummvm.zh: 给想在现代系统上玩经典冒险游戏的玩家：ScummVM 让几百款这类游戏重新跑起来。

awesome-seo.en: A curated collection for SEO practitioners and site owners, covering technical SEO, AI search discoverability, analytics, and traffic monetization.
awesome-seo.zh: 面向 SEO 从业者与站点运营者的资料合集，涵盖技术 SEO、AI 搜索可发现性、分析与流量变现。

flagr.en: Flagr is a microservice for teams that need feature flags, A/B testing and dynamic configuration.
flagr.zh: Flagr 是一个微服务，帮团队做功能开关、A/B 测试和动态配置。

tab-session-manager.en: A WebExtension for people who lose windows or tabs after crashes, letting them save and restore full session states.
tab-session-manager.zh: 面向浏览器崩溃或误关标签页后会丢失窗口的用户，可保存并整套恢复标签页与窗口状态。

brightbean-studio.en: Open-source, self-hostable social media management platform for teams that need to schedule, publish, and manage content across 10+ platforms from a single dashboard.
brightbean-studio.zh: 面向需要跨平台排期与发布内容的团队，提供可自托管的开源社媒管理平台，在一个面板中管理 10 个以上平台的内容。

openmeter.en: OpenMeter is for teams billing AI, API, and DevOps products; it collects and aggregates usage events in real time for usage-based billing.
openmeter.zh: OpenMeter 面向 AI、API 与 DevOps 产品的团队，实时采集并聚合用量事件，用于按用量计费。

photodemon.en: A free portable photo editor for Windows users who need pro-grade features on older or low-spec machines.
photodemon.zh: 面向需要在老旧或低配电脑上修图的 Windows 用户的免费绿色修图软件。

maizzle.en: A modern email development framework for developers who build HTML emails and want to write styles with Tailwind.
maizzle.zh: 面向编写 HTML 邮件的开发者，用 Tailwind 写邮件样式的现代邮件开发框架。

openxcom.en: OpenXcom is an open-source engine for X-Com fans, fixing many original bugs and adding new features.
openxcom.zh: OpenXcom 是面向 X-COM 玩家的开源引擎，修复原版诸多 bug 并加入新功能。

socialify.en: Socialify helps open source maintainers generate attractive social preview images for their GitHub repository links.
socialify.zh: Socialify 帮助开源项目维护者为 GitHub 仓库链接生成好看的社交分享图。

revolt.en: Revolt is an open-source alternative to Discord, aimed at users who want a familiar chat interface and experience.
revolt.zh: 面向希望获得熟悉聊天体验的用户，Revolt 是界面与体验接近 Discord 的开源替代。

web-archives.en: A browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Safari that lets you view archived and cached versions of web pages.
web-archives.zh: 一款适用于 Chrome、Edge 和 Safari 的浏览器扩展，可查看网页的存档和缓存版本。

klaro.en: Klaro is an open-source consent manager for website owners who need privacy-friendly, compliant control over scripts.
klaro.zh: Klaro 是面向网站运营者的开源同意管理器，帮助合规、友好地精细控制各类脚本。

strudel.en: For musicians and coders who want to live code algorithmic patterns in the browser, with TidalCycles ported to JavaScript.
strudel.zh: 面向想在浏览器里现场编码算法音乐的人，并把 TidalCycles 移植到 JavaScript。

oneko-js.en: A small script that adds a pixel cat chasing your cursor on a website, for site owners who want a playful retro touch.
oneko-js.zh: 一段小脚本，为网页加上追着鼠标跑的像素猫，适合想给网站增添复古趣味的站长。

advertools.en: advertools is a Python toolkit for marketers and analysts who need to crawl SERPs, parse sitemaps, and work with advertising data.
advertools.zh: advertools 是面向营销人员和分析师的 Python 工具集，用于抓取 SERP、解析站点地图和处理广告数据。

asciiquarium.en: For terminal users who want a break, asciiquarium puts an animated ASCII aquarium swimming in your console.
asciiquarium.zh: 适合想在终端里放松的用户：asciiquarium 用字符画做出会游动的鱼缸。

awesome-seo-tools.en: A curated list of SEO tools grouped by use case, for marketers and site owners looking for options.
awesome-seo-tools.zh: 按用途分类整理 SEO 工具清单，适合营销人员和站长为选型提供参考。

linkinator.en: Crawls websites, documentation, and local files to find broken links, helping site owners and developers run SEO audits and CI/CD checks.
linkinator.zh: 面向站长和开发者，检查网站、文档和本地文件中的死链，用于SEO审计与CI/CD。

tarteaucitron.en: Open-source JavaScript cookie consent manager for websites needing GDPR-compliant banners and service-level script controls.
tarteaucitron.zh: 面向需要GDPR合规的网站，提供可定制同意横幅与按服务控制脚本。

watermark-removal-pytorch.en: A PyTorch CNN that removes watermarks using Deep Image Prior, with training code so you can train your own model.
watermark-removal-pytorch.zh: 面向需要去除图片水印的用户，提供基于 PyTorch 的 CNN 去水印代码，并附带可自行训练模型的训练代码。

openpost.en: OpenPost lets social media teams create, adapt, schedule, and track posts, and can be used hosted or self-hosted.
openpost.zh: OpenPost 帮助社媒团队创建、改写、排期并追踪内容，支持托管或自托管使用。

smithery-cli.en: A CLI for developers who need to install, manage, and build MCP servers and skills for agents from one command.
smithery-cli.zh: 一款命令行工具，帮助开发者用一条命令安装、管理和开发供智能体使用的 MCP 服务器与技能。

openserp.en: Self-hosted web search for AI agents and SEO, returning ranked results and clean page Markdown from multiple engines via API, CLI or MCP.
openserp.zh: 面向 AI 代理与 SEO 的自托管搜索服务，返回排名结果和页面 Markdown。

trypost.en: Open-source social media scheduler for AI agents and their teams, letting them create, schedule and publish posts to every network via MCP or the REST API.
trypost.zh: 面向 AI 智能体及其团队的开源社媒排期工具，可通过 MCP 或 REST API 创建、排期并发布到各平台。

geolook.en: Open-source tool for teams doing AI search GEO work: analysis, diagnosis, strategy, tickets, execution, verification.
geolook.zh: 面向做 AI 搜索优化的团队，覆盖状态分析、诊断、策略到执行与验证的开源工具。

hol-guard.en: For teams running AI agents, Hol Guard is open-source antivirus that blocks risky tools, secret access, prompt injection, and malicious packages at runtime.
hol-guard.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供开源杀毒：运行时拦截高风险工具、机密访问、提示词注入和恶意软件包。

seo-audits-toolkit.en: For site owners and SEO teams, it runs bulk Lighthouse and Security Headers audits and extracts sitemaps, keywords, and images.
seo-audits-toolkit.zh: 给站点所有者和SEO人员：批量跑Lighthouse与安全头审计，提取站点地图和关键词。

watermark-js-plus.en: A lightweight, framework-agnostic browser watermark library for developers adding text, image, rich-text, or blind watermarks with grid layouts and tamper protection.
watermark-js-plus.zh: 面向开发者，轻量不绑定框架的浏览器水印库，支持文字、图片、富文本、盲水印及网格布局与防篡改。

hedgewars.en: For players who enjoy Worms-like games, Hedgewars offers hedgehog-themed battles with parabolic shots and many meme-style weapons.
hedgewars.zh: Hedgewars 给百战天虫类玩家：刺猬主题，算抛物线轰炸，表情包武器多。

watermarkremover-ai.en: For users who need to remove watermarks from images or videos, including AI-generated content, using Florence-2 detection and LaMA inpainting via a PyWebview GUI.
watermarkremover-ai.zh: 面向需批量去除图片或视频水印的用户，用 Florence-2 定位、LaMa 修复，带 PyWebview 界面。

marketing-dashboard.en: A local-first control center for marketing teams that centralizes CRM, outreach, content, analytics, approvals, automations, and agent workflows.
marketing-dashboard.zh: 面向营销团队的本地优先操作台，集中管理 CRM、外联、内容、分析、审批、自动化和智能体工作流。

curatedseotools.en: A curated collection of SEO tools for marketers and site owners, covering different stages of SEO work.
curatedseotools.zh: 面向营销人员和站点主的精选 SEO 工具集，覆盖 SEO 工作的各个环节。

stable-signature.en: For developers tracing AI-generated images, Stable Signature is Meta's official implementation that embeds invisible watermarks in latent diffusion model outputs.
stable-signature.zh: 给需要溯源 AI 生成图的开发者：Meta 官方实现，可在潜扩散模型输出嵌入不可见水印。

backlink-pilot.en: A toolkit for indie hackers that automates submitting a product to directory sites, awesome-lists, and search engines with one command.
backlink-pilot.zh: 面向独立开发者的工具包，用一条命令自动把产品提交到目录站、awesome 列表和搜索引擎。

awesome-saas-directories.en: A community-curated list for SaaS founders who need places to launch, find early users, and build SEO backlinks.
awesome-saas-directories.zh: 面向 SaaS 创业者，提供社区维护的发布渠道清单，帮助寻找早期用户并积累 SEO 外链。

awesome-submitlist.en: A curated list for startup founders who need places to promote a launch, with 300+ directories, launch sites and communities plus Domain Rating and traffic data.
awesome-submitlist.zh: 面向需要为产品发布寻找推广渠道的创业者，提供 300 多个目录、发布站和社区，并附带 DR 和流量数据。

free-ai-scheduler.en: A self-hostable scheduler for social media teams that need to plan and queue posts without paid tools.
free-ai-scheduler.zh: 面向社媒团队的自托管排期工具，用于规划并排队发布内容，无需付费工具。

seo-prompt-master.en: For SEOs and site owners: turn Google's SEO docs into an AI prompt that maps pages, audits against Google's rules, and fixes gaps.
seo-prompt-master.zh: 给SEO人员：把Google SEO文档变成AI提示词，梳理路径、按规则查漏补缺。

saas-directories.en: Founders launching a SaaS or AI product use this free, no-signup open list of 921 directories, communities and review sites to plan phased submissions.
saas-directories.zh: 面向发布 SaaS 或 AI 产品的开发者，这份免费、免注册的约 920 个目录开放清单帮助规划分阶段提交。

microsoft-activation-scripts.en: An open-source tool for users who need to activate Windows or Office, offering HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS methods with troubleshooting.
microsoft-activation-scripts.zh: 面向需要激活 Windows 或 Office 的用户，开源工具，提供 HWID、Ohook、TSforge 和 Online KMS 方式及故障排除。

cc-switch.en: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for users of Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build and Hermes Agent.
cc-switch.zh: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Grok Build 和 Hermes Agent 用户的跨平台桌面一体化助手。

agent-reach.en: A CLI for AI agent developers who need web content from Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without API fees.
agent-reach.zh: 面向 AI 智能体开发者，用一个 CLI 免 API 费用地读取和搜索多平台网络内容。

playwright.en: For developers who test web apps, Playwright offers one API to test Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
playwright.zh: Playwright 面向需要测试 Web 应用的开发者，用单一 API 测试 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit。

devops-exercises.en: A DevOps interview question collection for candidates and interviewers covering Linux, Jenkins, AWS, SRE, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and related topics.
devops-exercises.zh: 面向 DevOps 求职者与面试官的面试题集，涵盖 Linux、Jenkins、AWS、SRE、Docker、Kubernetes、Terraform 等主题。

nest.en: A progressive Node.js framework for developers building efficient, scalable, enterprise-grade server-side applications with TypeScript or JavaScript.
nest.zh: 一个渐进式 Node.js 框架，供开发者用 TypeScript/JavaScript 构建高效、可扩展的企业级服务器端应用。

grafana.en: For teams running systems, Grafana visualizes metrics, logs, and traces from sources like Prometheus, Loki, and Elasticsearch in shared dashboards.
grafana.zh: 面向运维与开发团队，Grafana 接入 Prometheus、Loki、Elasticsearch 等数据源，把指标、日志和链路数据做成监控大盘。

codegraph.en: A pre-indexed code knowledge graph that auto-syncs on code changes, built for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor to use fewer tokens and fewer tool calls while running fully locally.
codegraph.zh: 预索引的代码知识图谱，代码变更时自动同步，面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编码代理，帮助减少 token 与工具调用，并完全本地运行。

cl4r1t4s.en: A collection of leaked system prompts from tools like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, for researchers and developers who want to see how AI systems are instructed.
cl4r1t4s.zh: 收录 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等工具泄露系统提示词的资料集，供想了解 AI 系统如何被指示的研究者和开发者参考。

context-mode.en: Context Mode helps AI coding agents on 17 platforms keep context windows small by sandboxing tool output, persisting session memory, and routing via MCP and hooks.
context-mode.zh: Context Mode 面向使用 AI 编程智能体的开发者，通过沙箱化工具输出、持久化会话记忆、借助 MCP 与 hooks 路由，缓解上下文窗口占用问题。

cleanyourtv.en: Cleanyourtv helps Android and Google TV users remove unwanted apps over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
cleanyourtv.zh: Cleanyourtv 帮 Android 或 Google TV 用户通过 Wi-Fi 精简系统，并获得 Apple TV 风格首页。

9router.en: For developers using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Copilot or Antigravity who want free Claude/GPT/Gemini access via 40+ providers with auto-fallback.
9router.zh: 面向 Claude Code、Cursor 等用户，经 40+ 提供商免费接入模型并自动回退。

compound-engineering-plugin.en: For developers using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and similar tools, this provides the official Compound Engineering plugin.
compound-engineering-plugin.zh: 面向使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具的开发者，提供官方 Compound Engineering 插件。

claude-skills.en: For teams using coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor, it offers 380 skills, agents, and plugins across many work domains.
claude-skills.zh: 为使用编程智能体的团队提供覆盖工程、营销、产品等领域的 380 个技能、智能体与插件。

crawl4ai.en: For LLM and AI agent developers, it turns any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown, run yourself or via Cloud.
crawl4ai.zh: 面向 LLM 和 AI 智能体开发者，把任意网站转成干净、可直接供 LLM 使用的 Markdown，可自行运行或使用云服务。

toon.en: TOON is a TypeScript SDK and CLI for developers who need compact, human-readable serialization of JSON data in LLM prompts.
toon.zh: TOON 是面向开发者的 TypeScript SDK 与 CLI，用于把 JSON 数据序列化为 LLM 提示词中紧凑、人类可读的格式。

awesome-nano-banana-images.en: A curated collection of creative Nano Banana image examples, plus the openly released Nano-consistent-150K dataset for community image generation research.
awesome-nano-banana-images.zh: 面向图像生成与统一模型研究者的创意示例合集，并开放 Nano-consistent-150K 数据集支持社区开发。

graphify.en: A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI turns codebases with docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph.
graphify.zh: 为开发者把代码库、文档和配置转成可查询知识图谱的 /graphify 技能。

n8n-mcp.en: An MCP for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Windsurf, and Cursor that builds n8n workflows for you.
n8n-mcp.zh: 一个适用于 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Windsurf 和 Cursor 的 MCP，可为你构建 n8n 工作流。

skillspector.en: For developers installing Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills: scans them before install to flag vulnerabilities and malicious patterns.
skillspector.zh: 面向安装 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 技能的开发者，在安装前扫描漏洞与恶意模式。

omlx.en: A macOS menu bar tool that runs an LLM inference server for Apple Silicon users, with continuous batching and SSD caching.
omlx.zh: 一款面向 Apple Silicon 用户的 macOS 菜单栏工具，可运行 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存。

crawlseo.en: An open-source SEO monitoring dashboard for site owners and marketers. It combines Google Search Console data, a site crawler, and Core Web Vitals in one place.
crawlseo.zh: 面向站长和营销人员的开源 SEO 监控面板，把 Search Console 数据、站点爬虫和 Core Web Vitals 集中在一处查看。

kopia.en: For Windows, macOS and Linux users who need fast incremental backups with end-to-end encryption, compression and deduplication, plus CLI and GUI.
kopia.zh: 为跨平台用户提供快速增量备份、端到端加密与压缩去重，含命令行和图形界面。

anydoc.en: For developers who need document text as Markdown: converts Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, EPUB, and more into clean Markdown.
anydoc.zh: 帮开发者把 Word、Excel、PDF 等文档转成干净的 Markdown。

gstack.en: For developers who want Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup, with 23 opinionated tools covering CEO, Designer, and other roles.
gstack.zh: 面向想复用 Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 配置的开发者，提供 23 个分别担任 CEO、设计师等角色的工具。
